           1	namespace Chemy.Core;
           2
           3	/// <summary>
           4	/// Represents an immutable atomic particle composed of an elemental nucleus (protons and neutrons)
           5	/// and surrounding electron shell. Supports isotopic mass numbers and ionic charge calculations.
           6	/// </summary>
           7	public record Atom
           8	{
           9	    /// <summary>The fundamental chemical element defining the atomic identity and proton count.</summary>
          10	    public Element Element { get; init; }
          11
          12	    /// <summary>Count of neutrons located in the atomic nucleus.</summary>
          13	    public int Neutrons { get; init; }
          14
          15	    /// <summary>Count of electrons occupying electron shells.</summary>
          16	    public int Electrons { get; init; }
          17
          18	    /// <summary>Proton count derived directly from the element's atomic number (Z).</summary>
          19	    public int Protons => Element.AtomicNumber;
          20
          21	    /// <summary>Isotopic mass number (A = Protons + Neutrons).</summary>
          22	    public int MassNumber => Protons + Neutrons;
          23
          24	    /// <summary>Net electrostatic charge (Protons - Electrons).</summary>
          25	    public int NetCharge => Protons - Electrons;
          26
          27	    /// <summary>True if the atom carries a non-zero net electrical charge.</summary>
          28	    public bool IsIon => NetCharge != 0;
          29
          30	    /// <summary>True if net charge is positive (electron deficiency).</summary>
          31	    public bool IsCation => NetCharge > 0;
          32
          33	    /// <summary>True if net charge is negative (electron excess).</summary>
          34	    public bool IsAnion => NetCharge < 0;
          35
          36	    /// <summary>
          37	    /// Constructs a neutral atom with electron count equal to proton count (Z).
          38	    /// </summary>
          39	    /// <param name="element">Elemental identity.</param>
          40	    /// <param name="neutrons">Neutron count in the nucleus.</param>
          41	    public Atom(Element element, int neutrons)
          42	    {
          43	        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegative(neutrons);
          44
          45	        Element = element;
          46	        Neutrons = neutrons;
          47	        Electrons = element.AtomicNumber;
          48	    }
          49
          50	    /// <summary>
          51	    /// Constructs an atom or ion with an explicit electron count.
          52	    /// </summary>
          53	    /// <param name="element">Elemental identity.</param>
          54	    /// <param name="neutrons">Neutron count.</param>
          55	    /// <param name="electrons">Electron count.</param>
          56	    public Atom(Element element, int neutrons, int electrons)
          57	    {
          58	        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegative(neutrons);
          59	        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegative(electrons);
          60
          61	        Element = element;
          62	        Neutrons = neutrons;
          63	        Electrons = electrons;
          64	    }
          65
          66	    /// <summary>
          67	    /// Produces a new atom instance by adding or removing electrons.
          68	    /// </summary>
          69	    /// <param name="deltaElectrons">Electrons removed (positive) or added (negative).</param>
          70	    /// <returns>New ionized Atom instance.</returns>
          71	    public Atom Ionize(int deltaElectrons) => this with { Electrons = Math.Max(0, Electrons - deltaElectrons) };
          72
          73	    /// <summary>
          74	    /// Produces a new isotopic atom instance with modified neutron count.
          75	    /// </summary>
          76	    /// <param name="newNeutronCount">Target neutron count.</param>
          77	    /// <returns>New isotopic Atom instance.</returns>
          78	    public Atom WithNeutrons(int newNeutronCount) => this with { Neutrons = newNeutronCount };
          79
          80	    /// <summary>
          81	    /// Formats the atom in standard IUPAC isotopic notation (e.g. ^12C, ^1H+, ^16O2-).
          82	    /// </summary>
          83	    public override string ToString()
          84	    {
          85	        string chargeStr = NetCharge switch
          86	        {
          87	            0 => string.Empty,
          88	            1 => "+",
          89	            -1 => "-",
          90	            > 0 => $"+{NetCharge}",
          91	            _ => $"{NetCharge}"
          92	        };
          93
          94	        return $"^{MassNumber}{Element.Symbol}{chargeStr}";
          95	    }

          27	/// <summary>
          28	/// Lightweight, zero-allocation stack-allocated struct representing a chemical bond between two atom indices.
          29	/// </summary>
          30	/// <param name="Atom1Index">0-based index of the first bonded atom in the parent molecule.</param>
          31	/// <param name="Atom2Index">0-based index of the second bonded atom in the parent molecule.</param>
          32	/// <param name="Type">Chemical bond classification and order.</param>
          33	public readonly record struct Bond(int Atom1Index, int Atom2Index, BondType Type = BondType.Single)
          34	{
          35	    /// <summary>
          36	    /// Checks whether this bond connects to a specified atom index.
          37	    /// </summary>
          38	    /// <param name="index">0-based atom index to test.</param>
          39	    /// <returns>True if either vertex of the bond matches the index.</returns>
          40	    public bool Connects(int index) => Atom1Index == index || Atom2Index == index;
          41	}

          29	    public static bool TryParse(string formula, string? name, [NotNullWhen(true)] out Molecule? result, out string? errorMessage)
          30	    {
          31	        result = null;
          32	        errorMessage = null;
          33
          34	        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(formula))
          35	        {
          36	            errorMessage = "Formula string is null or empty.";
          37	            return false;
          38	        }
          39
          40	        try
          41	        {
          42	            string cleanFormula = ExtractCharge(formula.Trim(), out int charge);
          43	            string[] components = cleanFormula.Split(['*', '.'], StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
          44
          45	            if (components.Length == 0)
          46	            {
          47	                errorMessage = "Formula contains no valid components.";
          48	                return false;
          49	            }
          50
          51	            var elementCounts = new Dictionary<Element, int>();
          52
          53	            foreach (var component in components)
          54	            {
          55	                string trimmedComp = component.Trim();
          56	                if (trimmedComp.Length == 0) continue;
          57
          58	                int leadingMultiplier = 1;
          59	                int i = 0;
          60	                while (i < trimmedComp.Length && char.IsDigit(trimmedComp[i]))
          61	                {
          62	                    i++;
          63	                }
          64
          65	                if (i > 0)
          66	                {
          67	                    leadingMultiplier = int.Parse(trimmedComp[..i], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
          68	                    trimmedComp = trimmedComp[i..].Trim();
          69	                }
          70
          71	                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(trimmedComp))
          72	                {
          73	                    errorMessage = "Invalid component with multiplier but no chemical formula.";
          74	                    return false;
          75	                }
          76
          77	                var compCounts = ParseSingleFormula(trimmedComp);
          78	                foreach (var (element, count) in compCounts)
          79	                {
          80	                    elementCounts[element] = elementCounts.GetValueOrDefault(element, 0) + count * leadingMultiplier;
          81	                }
          82	            }
          83
          84	            if (elementCounts.Count == 0)
          85	            {
          86	                errorMessage = "No elements found in formula.";
          87	                return false;
          88	            }
          89
          90	            var atoms = new List<Atom>();
          91	            foreach (var (element, count) in elementCounts)
          92	            {
          93	                int defaultNeutrons = Math.Max(0, (int)Math.Round(element.StandardAtomicMass) - element.AtomicNumber);
          94	                for (int c = 0; c < count; c++)
          95	                {
          96	                    atoms.Add(new Atom(element, defaultNeutrons));
          97	                }
          98	            }
          99
         100	            if (charge != 0 && atoms.Count > 0)
         101	            {
         102	                atoms[^1] = atoms[^1].Ionize(charge);
         103	            }
         104
         105	            var bonds = AutoGenerateBonds(atoms);
         106
         107	            result = new Molecule(name ?? formula, atoms, bonds);
         108	            return true;
         109	        }
         110	        catch (Exception ex)
         111	        {
         112	            errorMessage = ex.Message;
         113	            return false;
         114	        }
         115	    }

         117	    private static List<Bond> AutoGenerateBonds(List<Atom> atoms)
         118	    {
         119	        var bonds = new List<Bond>();
         120	        if (atoms.Count <= 1) return bonds;
         121
         122	        var centerAtom = atoms.FirstOrDefault(a => a.Element.Symbol != "H") ?? atoms[0];
         123	        int centerIndex = atoms.IndexOf(centerAtom);
         124
         125	        for (int i = 0; i < atoms.Count; i++)
         126	        {
         127	            if (i != centerIndex)
         128	            {
         129	                bonds.Add(new Bond(centerIndex, i, BondType.Single));
         130	            }
         131	        }
         132
         133	        return bonds;
         134	    }

         136	    private static Dictionary<Element, int> ParseSingleFormula(string formula)
         137	    {
         138	        var stack = new Stack<Dictionary<Element, int>>();
         139	        stack.Push([]);
         140
         141	        int i = 0;
         142	        int len = formula.Length;
         143
         144	        while (i < len)
         145	        {
         146	            char ch = formula[i];
         147
         148	            if (ch is '(' or '[' or '{')
         149	            {
         150	                stack.Push([]);
         151	                i++;
         152	            }
         153	            else if (ch is ')' or ']' or '}')
         154	            {
         155	                if (stack.Count <= 1)
         156	                {
         157	                    throw new FormatException($"Unmatched closing bracket '{ch}' at position {i}.");
         158	                }
         159
         160	                var top = stack.Pop();
         161	                i++;
         162
         163	                int multiplier = ReadNumber(formula, ref i);
         164	                if (multiplier == 0) multiplier = 1;
         165
         166	                var parent = stack.Peek();
         167	                foreach (var (element, count) in top)
         168	                {
         169	                    parent[element] = parent.GetValueOrDefault(element, 0) + count * multiplier;
         170	                }
         171	            }
         172	            else if (char.IsUpper(ch))
         173	            {
         174	                int start = i;
         175	                i++;
         176	                while (i < len && char.IsLower(formula[i]))
         177	                {
         178	                    i++;
         179	                }
         180
         181	                string symbol = formula[start..i];
         182	                Element element;
         183	                try
         184	                {
         185	                    element = Elements.GetBySymbol(symbol);
         186	                }
         187	                catch (KeyNotFoundException)
         188	                {
         189	                    throw new FormatException($"Unknown element symbol '{symbol}' at position {start}.");
         190	                }
         191
         192	                int count = ReadNumber(formula, ref i);
         193	                if (count == 0) count = 1;
         194
         195	                var currentDict = stack.Peek();
         196	                currentDict[element] = currentDict.GetValueOrDefault(element, 0) + count;
         197	            }
         198	            else
         199	            {
         200	                throw new FormatException($"Unexpected character '{ch}' at position {i}.");
         201	            }
         202	        }
         203
         204	        if (stack.Count > 1)
         205	        {
         206	            throw new FormatException("Unmatched opening bracket in formula.");
         207	        }
         208
         209	        return stack.Pop();
         210	    }
         211
         212	    private static int ReadNumber(string formula, ref int index)
         213	    {
         214	        int start = index;
         215	        while (index < formula.Length && char.IsDigit(formula[index]))
         216	        {
         217	            index++;
         218	        }
         219
         220	        return start == index ? 0 : int.Parse(formula[start..index], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
         221	    }

         223	    private static string ExtractCharge(string formula, out int charge)
         224	    {
         225	        charge = 0;
         226
         227	        var match = ChargeRegex.Match(formula);
         228	        if (!match.Success || string.IsNullOrEmpty(match.Groups[1].Value))
         229	        {
         230	            return formula;
         231	        }
         232
         233	        string chargeStr = match.Groups[1].Value;
         234	        int matchIndex = match.Index;
         235
         236	        if (!chargeStr.Contains('^') && !chargeStr.Contains('+') && !chargeStr.Contains('-'))
         237	        {
         238	            return formula;
         239	        }
         240
         241	        if (TryParseChargeString(chargeStr, out int parsedCharge))
         242	        {
         243	            charge = parsedCharge;
         244	            return formula[..matchIndex].Trim();
         245	        }
         246
         247	        return formula;
         248	    }
         249
         250	    private static bool TryParseChargeString(string s, out int charge)
         251	    {
         252	        charge = 0;
         253	        s = s.Trim();
         254
         255	        if (s is "+" or "^+") { charge = 1; return true; }
         256	        if (s is "-" or "^-") { charge = -1; return true; }
         257
         258	        if (s.EndsWith('+'))
         259	        {
         260	            if (int.TryParse(s[..^1], out int val)) { charge = val; return true; }
         261	        }
         262	        else if (s.EndsWith('-'))
         263	        {
         264	            if (int.TryParse(s[..^1], out int val)) { charge = -val; return true; }
         265	        }
         266	        else if (s.StartsWith('+'))
         267	        {
         268	            if (int.TryParse(s[1..], out int val)) { charge = val; return true; }
         269	        }
         270	        else if (s.StartsWith('-'))
         271	        {
         272	            if (int.TryParse(s[1..], out int val)) { charge = -val; return true; }
         273	        }
         274
         275	        return false;
         276	    }

           3	/// <summary>
           4	/// Exact Rational Matrix Solver for Chemical Equation Balancing.
           5	/// Solves the nullspace vector equation M * x = 0 over the rational field Q,
           6	/// using Gaussian elimination with partial pivoting and integer LCM scaling.
           7	/// </summary>
           8	internal static class MatrixSolver
           9	{
          10	    /// <summary>
          11	    /// Computes the minimal strictly positive integer nullspace solution vector for matrix M.
          12	    /// </summary>
          13	    /// <param name="matrix">Stoichiometric element conservation matrix.</param>
          14	    /// <returns>Minimal integer coefficient vector, or null if unbalanceable.</returns>
          15	    public static int[]? SolveNullspaceIntegerVector(int[,] matrix)
          16	    {
          17	        int rows = matrix.GetLength(0);
          18	        int cols = matrix.GetLength(1);
          19
          20	        // Convert integer matrix to exact rational matrix to prevent floating-point drift
          21	        Rational[,] rMatrix = new Rational[rows, cols];
          22	        for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++)
          23	        {
          24	            for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++)
          25	            {
          26	                rMatrix[r, c] = new Rational(matrix[r, c]);
          27	            }
          28	        }
          29
          30	        int pivotRow = 0;
          31	        int[] pivotCols = new int[cols];
          32	        Array.Fill(pivotCols, -1);
          33
          34	        // Gaussian elimination with partial pivoting to compute Reduced Row Echelon Form (RREF)
          35	        for (int c = 0; c < cols && pivotRow < rows; c++)
          36	        {
          37	            int sel = -1;
          38	            for (int r = pivotRow; r < rows; r++)
          39	            {
          40	                if (rMatrix[r, c].Num != 0)
          41	                {
          42	                    sel = r;
          43	                    break;
          44	                }
          45	            }
          46
          47	            if (sel == -1) continue;
          48
          49	            // Swap pivot row
          50	            for (int j = 0; j < cols; j++)
          51	            {
          52	                (rMatrix[pivotRow, j], rMatrix[sel, j]) = (rMatrix[sel, j], rMatrix[pivotRow, j]);
          53	            }
          54
          55	            // Normalize pivot row
          56	            Rational pivotVal = rMatrix[pivotRow, c];
          57	            for (int j = 0; j < cols; j++)
          58	            {
          59	                rMatrix[pivotRow, j] = rMatrix[pivotRow, j] / pivotVal;
          60	            }
          61
          62	            // Eliminate other rows in current column
          63	            for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++)
          64	            {
          65	                if (r != pivotRow && rMatrix[r, c].Num != 0)
          66	                {
          67	                    Rational factor = rMatrix[r, c];
          68	                    for (int j = 0; j < cols; j++)
          69	                    {
          70	                        rMatrix[r, j] = rMatrix[r, j] - factor * rMatrix[pivotRow, j];
          71	                    }
          72	                }
          73	            }
          74
          75	            pivotCols[c] = pivotRow;
          76	            pivotRow++;
          77	        }
          78
          79	        // Identify free variable column
          80	        int freeCol = -1;
          81	        for (int c = cols - 1; c >= 0; c--)
          82	        {
          83	            if (pivotCols[c] == -1)
          84	            {
          85	                freeCol = c;
          86	                break;
          87	            }
          88	        }
          89
          90	        if (freeCol == -1) return null;
          91
          92	        // Assign free variable unit rational value and back-substitute
          93	        Rational[] solution = new Rational[cols];
          94	        solution[freeCol] = new Rational(1);
          95
          96	        for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++)
          97	        {
          98	            if (pivotCols[c] != -1)
          99	            {
         100	                int r = pivotCols[c];
         101	                solution[c] = -rMatrix[r, freeCol];
         102	            }
         103	        }
         104
         105	        // Compute Least Common Multiple (LCM) of denominators to clear fractions
         106	        long lcm = 1;

         120	            Rational scaled = solution[c] * new Rational(lcm);
         121	            int val = (int)(scaled.Num / scaled.Den);
         122	            if (val <= 0) allPositive = false;
         123	            intVector[c] = val;
         124	        }
         125
         126	        if (!allPositive)
         127	        {
         128	            for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++)
         129	            {
         130	                intVector[c] = -intVector[c];
         131	                if (intVector[c] <= 0) return null;
         132	            }
         133	        }
         134
         135	        // Reduce by Greatest Common Divisor (GCD) to minimal primitive integers
         136	        long commonGcd = intVector[0];
         137	        for (int c = 1; c < cols; c++)
         138	        {
         139	            commonGcd = Gcd(commonGcd, intVector[c]);
         140	        }
         141
         142	        if (commonGcd > 1)
         143	        {
         144	            for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++)
         145	            {
         146	                intVector[c] /= (int)commonGcd;
         147	            }
         148	        }
         149
         150	        return intVector;
         151	    }
         152
         153	    /// <summary>Calculates Greatest Common Divisor (Euclidean algorithm).</summary>
         154	    private static long Gcd(long a, long b)
         155	    {
         156	        a = Math.Abs(a);
         157	        b = Math.Abs(b);
         158	        while (b != 0)
         159	        {
         160	            long temp = b;
         161	            b = a % b;
         162	            a = temp;
         163	        }
         164	        return a == 0 ? 1 : a;
         165	    }
         166
         167	    /// <summary>Calculates Least Common Multiple.</summary>
         168	    private static long Lcm(long a, long b) => (a / Gcd(a, b)) * b;
         169	}
         170
         171	/// <summary>
         172	/// Immutable, exact rational number struct with automatic GCD reduction.
         173	/// </summary>
         174	internal readonly struct Rational
         175	{
         176	    public long Num { get; }
         177	    public long Den { get; }
         178
         179	    public Rational(long num, long den = 1)
         180	    {
         181	        if (den == 0) throw new DivideByZeroException("Rational denominator cannot be zero.");
         182
         183	        if (den < 0)
         184	        {
         185	            num = -num;
         186	            den = -den;
         187	        }
         188
         189	        long g = Gcd(num, den);
         190	        Num = num / g;
         191	        Den = den / g;
         192	    }
         193
         194	    public static Rational operator +(Rational a, Rational b) => new(a.Num * b.Den + b.Num * a.Den, a.Den * b.Den);
         195	    public static Rational operator -(Rational a, Rational b) => new(a.Num * b.Den - b.Num * a.Den, a.Den * b.Den);
         196	    public static Rational operator -(Rational a) => new(-a.Num, a.Den);
         197	    public static Rational operator *(Rational a, Rational b) => new(a.Num * b.Num, a.Den * b.Den);
         198	    public static Rational operator /(Rational a, Rational b) => new(a.Num * b.Den, a.Den * b.Num);
         199
         200	    private static long Gcd(long a, long b)
         201	    {
         202	        a = Math.Abs(a);
         203	        b = Math.Abs(b);
         204	        while (b != 0)
         205	        {
         206	            long temp = b;
         207	            b = a % b;
         208	            a = temp;
         209	        }
         210	        return a == 0 ? 1 : a;
         211	    }
         212	}

          12	/// Immutable chemical reaction entity encapsulating reactants, products, stoichiometric balancing,
          13	/// educational step explanations, Hess's Law thermodynamics, and vector SVG diagram rendering.

          16	{
          17	    /// <summary>Immutable list of reactant components.</summary>

          23	    /// <summary>
          24	    /// Evaluates whether the Law of Conservation of Mass is satisfied
          25	    /// (total atom count for each element is identical on reactant and product sides).
          26	    /// </summary>
          27	    public bool IsBalanced
          28	    {
          29	        get
          30	        {
          31	            var reactantCounts = GetElementCounts(Reactants);
          32	            var productCounts = GetElementCounts(Products);
          33
          34	            if (reactantCounts.Count != productCounts.Count) return false;
          35
          36	            foreach (var (element, count) in reactantCounts)
          37	            {
          38	                if (!productCounts.TryGetValue(element, out int prodCount) || count != prodCount)
          39	                {
          40	                    return false;
          41	                }
          42	            }
          43
          44	            int reactantCharge = Reactants.Sum(r => r.Coefficient * r.Molecule.NetCharge);
          45	            int productCharge = Products.Sum(p => p.Coefficient * p.Molecule.NetCharge);
          46	            if (reactantCharge != productCharge) return false;
          47
          48	            return true;
          49	        }
          50	    }

          52	    /// <summary>
          53	    /// Constructs a Reaction instance with validated reactant and product lists.
          54	    /// </summary>
          55	    /// <param name="reactants">Collection of reactant components.</param>
          56	    /// <param name="products">Collection of product components.</param>
          57	    public Reaction(IEnumerable<ReactionComponent> reactants, IEnumerable<ReactionComponent> products)
          58	    {
          59	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(reactants);
          60	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(products);

          62	        Reactants = reactants.ToImmutableList();
          63	        Products = products.ToImmutableList();

          65	        if (Reactants.Count == 0 || Products.Count == 0)
          66	        {
          67	            throw new ArgumentException("Reaction must have at least one reactant and one product.");

          71	    /// <summary>
          72	    /// Balances the chemical equation using exact rational Gaussian elimination nullspace algebra.
          73	    /// Computes the minimal integer stoichiometric coefficients satisfying M * x = 0 with mass and charge conservation.
          74	    /// </summary>
          75	    /// <returns>New balanced Reaction instance.</returns>
          76	    public Reaction Balance()
          77	    {
          78	        if (IsBalanced) return this;
          79
          80	        var allComponents = Reactants.Concat(Products).ToList();
          81	        var allElements = allComponents
          82	            .SelectMany(c => c.Molecule.Atoms.Select(a => a.Element))
          83	            .Distinct()
          84	            .ToList();
          85
          86	        bool hasCharges = allComponents.Any(c => c.Molecule.NetCharge != 0);
          87	        int rows = allElements.Count + (hasCharges ? 1 : 0);
          88	        int cols = allComponents.Count;
          89	        int[,] matrix = new int[rows, cols];
          90
          91	        // Formulate stoichiometric conservation matrix M
          92	        for (int r = 0; r < allElements.Count; r++)
          93	        {
          94	            var elem = allElements[r];
          95	            for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++)
          96	            {
          97	                int atomCount = allComponents[c].Molecule.Atoms.Count(a => a.Element == elem);
          98	                matrix[r, c] = c < Reactants.Count ? atomCount : -atomCount;
          99	            }
         100	        }
         101
         102	        // Add net charge conservation row for ionic redox reactions
         103	        if (hasCharges)
         104	        {
         105	            int chargeRow = allElements.Count;
         106	            for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++)
         107	            {
         108	                int charge = allComponents[c].Molecule.NetCharge;
         109	                matrix[chargeRow, c] = c < Reactants.Count ? charge : -charge;
         110	            }
         111	        }
         112
         113	        var coefficients = MatrixSolver.SolveNullspaceIntegerVector(matrix);
         114	        if (coefficients == null || coefficients.Length != cols)
         115	        {
         116	            throw new InvalidOperationException("Could not balance reaction automatically.");
         117	        }
         118
         119	        var balancedReactants = Reactants.Select((c, i) => new ReactionComponent(c.Molecule, coefficients[i]));
         120	        var balancedProducts = Products.Select((c, i) => new ReactionComponent(c.Molecule, coefficients[Reactants.Count + i]));
         121
         122	        return new Reaction(balancedReactants, balancedProducts);
         123	    }

         143	    /// <summary>Parses a chemical equation string (e.g. 'CH4 + O2 -> CO2 + H2O').</summary>
         144	    public static Reaction Parse(string equation)
         145	    {
         146	        if (!TryParse(equation, out var reaction, out var error))
         147	        {

         149	        }

         154	    /// <summary>Attempts to parse a chemical equation string.</summary>
         155	    public static bool TryParse(string equation, [NotNullWhen(true)] out Reaction? reaction) =>
         156	        TryParse(equation, out reaction, out _);
         157
         158	    /// <summary>Attempts to parse a chemical equation string, returning syntax error messages if invalid.</summary>
         159	    public static bool TryParse(string equation, [NotNullWhen(true)] out Reaction? reaction, out string? errorMessage)
         160	    {
         161	        reaction = null;
         162	        errorMessage = null;
         163
         164	        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(equation))
         165	        {
         166	            errorMessage = "Equation string is null or empty.";
         167	            return false;
         168	        }
         169
         170	        string[] sideSeparators = ["-->", "->", "=>", "=", "⇌"];
         171	        string[] sides = Array.Empty<string>();
         172
         173	        foreach (var sep in sideSeparators)
         174	        {
         175	            if (equation.Contains(sep))
         176	            {
         177	                sides = equation.Split(sep, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
         178	                break;
         179	            }
         180	        }
         181
         182	        if (sides.Length != 2)
         183	        {
         184	            errorMessage = "Equation must contain a valid arrow separator ('->', '=', '=>', '-->', '⇌').";
         185	            return false;
         186	        }
         187
         188	        try
         189	        {
         190	            var reactants = ParseSide(sides[0]);
         191	            var products = ParseSide(sides[1]);
         192
         193	            reaction = new Reaction(reactants, products);
         194	            return true;
         195	        }
         196	        catch (Exception ex)
         197	        {
         198	            errorMessage = ex.Message;
         199	            return false;
         200	        }
         201	    }
         202
         203	    /// <summary>Parses one side (reactants or products) of a reaction equation.</summary>
         204	    private static List<ReactionComponent> ParseSide(string sideStr)
         205	    {
         206	        string[] terms = sideStr.Split('+', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
         207	        var components = new List<ReactionComponent>();
         208
         209	        foreach (var term in terms)
         210	        {
         211	            string trimmed = term.Trim();
         212	            if (trimmed.Length == 0) continue;
         213
         214	            int i = 0;
         215	            while (i < trimmed.Length && char.IsDigit(trimmed[i]))
         216	            {
         217	                i++;
         218	            }
         219
         220	            int coefficient = 1;
         221	            string formulaStr = trimmed;
         222
         223	            if (i > 0)
         224	            {
         225	                coefficient = int.Parse(trimmed[..i]);
         226	                formulaStr = trimmed[i..].Trim();
         227	            }
         228
         229	            var molecule = FormulaParser.Parse(formulaStr);
         230	            components.Add(new ReactionComponent(molecule, coefficient));
         231	        }
         232
         233	        return components;
         234	    }
         235
         236	    /// <summary>Audits total count of atoms per element across components.</summary>
         237	    private static Dictionary<Element, int> GetElementCounts(IEnumerable<ReactionComponent> components)
         238	    {
         239	        var counts = new Dictionary<Element, int>();
         240	        foreach (var comp in components)
         241	        {
         242	            foreach (var atom in comp.Molecule.Atoms)
         243	            {
         244	                counts[atom.Element] = counts.GetValueOrDefault(atom.Element, 0) + comp.Coefficient;
         245	            }
         246	        }
         247
         248	        return counts;
         249	    }

         252	    public override string ToString() =>
         253	        $"{string.Join(" + ", Reactants)} -> {string.Join(" + ", Products)}";
         254	}

           4	    Molecule Reactant,

          13	    ReactionComponent LimitingReactant,

          17	public static class Stoichiometry
          18	{
          19	    public static ProductYieldResult CalculateProductYield(Reaction reaction, string reactantFormula, double reactantMassGrams, string productFormula)
          20	    {
          21	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(reaction);
          22	        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(reactantFormula);
          23	        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(productFormula);
          24	        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegative(reactantMassGrams);
          25
          26	        var balanced = reaction.IsBalanced ? reaction : reaction.Balance();
          27
          28	        var reactantComp = balanced.Reactants.FirstOrDefault(r => r.Molecule.ChemicalFormula.Equals(reactantFormula, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || r.Molecule.Name.Equals(reactantFormula, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
          29	            ?? throw new ArgumentException($"Reactant '{reactantFormula}' not found in reaction.");
          30
          31	        var productComp = balanced.Products.FirstOrDefault(p => p.Molecule.ChemicalFormula.Equals(productFormula, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || p.Molecule.Name.Equals(productFormula, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
          32	            ?? throw new ArgumentException($"Product '{productFormula}' not found in reaction.");
          33
          34	        double reactantMoles = reactantMassGrams / reactantComp.Molecule.MolecularWeight;
          35	        double moleRatio = (double)productComp.Coefficient / reactantComp.Coefficient;
          36	        double productMoles = reactantMoles * moleRatio;
          37	        double productMassGrams = productMoles * productComp.Molecule.MolecularWeight;
          38
          39	        return new ProductYieldResult(
          40	            reactantComp.Molecule,
          41	            reactantMassGrams,
          42	            reactantMoles,
          43	            productComp.Molecule,
          44	            productMoles,
          45	            productMassGrams
          46	        );
          47	    }
          48
          49	    public static LimitingReactantResult CalculateLimitingReactant(Reaction reaction, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, double> reactantMassesGrams)
          50	    {
          51	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(reaction);
          52	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(reactantMassesGrams);
          53
          54	        var balanced = reaction.IsBalanced ? reaction : reaction.Balance();
          55
          56	        ReactionComponent? limiting = null;
          57	        double minReactionRuns = double.MaxValue;
          58
          59	        foreach (var reactantComp in balanced.Reactants)
          60	        {
          61	            string key = reactantComp.Molecule.ChemicalFormula;
          62	            if (!reactantMassesGrams.TryGetValue(key, out double massGrams))
          63	            {
          64	                key = reactantComp.Molecule.Name;
          65	                if (!reactantMassesGrams.TryGetValue(key, out massGrams))
          66	                {
          67	                    throw new ArgumentException($"Mass for reactant '{reactantComp.Molecule.ChemicalFormula}' was not provided.");
          68	                }
          69	            }
          70
          71	            double moles = massGrams / reactantComp.Molecule.MolecularWeight;
          72	            double reactionRuns = moles / reactantComp.Coefficient;
          73
          74	            if (reactionRuns < minReactionRuns)
          75	            {
          76	                minReactionRuns = reactionRuns;
          77	                limiting = reactantComp;
          78	            }
          79	        }
          80
          81	        if (limiting == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("No reactants found.");
          82
          83	        var yields = new Dictionary<string, double>();
          84	        foreach (var productComp in balanced.Products)
          85	        {
          86	            double productMoles = minReactionRuns * productComp.Coefficient;
          87	            double productMassGrams = productMoles * productComp.Molecule.MolecularWeight;
          88	            yields[productComp.Molecule.ChemicalFormula] = productMassGrams;
          89	        }
          90
          91	        return new LimitingReactantResult(limiting, yields);
          92	    }
          93	}

          45	/// <summary>
          46	/// Industrial-Grade Solutions Chemistry &amp; Acid-Base Equilibria Engine.
          47	/// Solves aqueous pH, pOH, strong/weak acid dissociations, and Henderson-Hasselbalch buffer equations.
          48	/// </summary>
          49	public static class SolutionsEngine
          50	{
          51	    /// <summary>
          52	    /// Calculates pH, pOH, [H+], and [OH-] for a monoprotic strong acid including water autodissociation (Kw = 1.0e-14).
          53	    /// Exact quadratic equilibrium formula: [H+] = (C + sqrt(C^2 + 4*Kw)) / 2.
          54	    /// </summary>
          55	    /// <param name="concentrationMolar">Analytical acid concentration in Molar (M).</param>
          56	    /// <returns>PhResult record.</returns>
          57	    public static PhResult CalculateStrongAcidPh(double concentrationMolar)
          58	    {
          59	        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegativeOrZero(concentrationMolar);
          60
          61	        const double Kw = 1.0e-14;
          62	        double hConc = (concentrationMolar + Math.Sqrt((concentrationMolar * concentrationMolar) + (4.0 * Kw))) / 2.0;
          63	        double ph = -Math.Log10(hConc);
          64	        double poh = 14.0 - ph;
          65	        double ohConc = Kw / hConc;
          66
          67	        return new PhResult(ph, poh, hConc, ohConc, ph < 7.0, ph > 7.0, Math.Abs(ph - 7.0) < 0.01);
          68	    }
          69
          70	    /// <summary>
          71	    /// Calculates pH for a weak acid via exact cubic polynomial equilibrium solver:
          72	    /// [H+]³ + Ka*[H+]² - (Kw + Ka*C)*[H+] - Ka*Kw = 0.
          73	    /// Solves the full equilibrium considering both acid dissociation and water autoionization across all dilutions.
          74	    /// </summary>
          75	    /// <param name="concentrationMolar">Analytical acid concentration in Molar (M).</param>
          76	    /// <param name="ka">Acid dissociation constant Ka.</param>
          77	    /// <returns>PhResult record.</returns>
          78	    public static PhResult CalculateWeakAcidPh(double concentrationMolar, double ka)
          79	    {
          80	        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegativeOrZero(concentrationMolar);
          81	        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegativeOrZero(ka);
          82
          83	        const double Kw = 1.0e-14;
          84
          85	        // Solve cubic: f(x) = x³ + Ka*x² - (Kw + Ka*C)*x - Ka*Kw = 0
          86	        // Initial estimate from Ostwald dilution or water autoionization
          87	        double x = Math.Max(1e-7, (-ka + Math.Sqrt((ka * ka) + (4.0 * ka * concentrationMolar))) / 2.0);
          88
          89	        // Halley's high-order root-finding method for cubic equilibrium
          90	        for (int iter = 0; iter < 20; iter++)
          91	        {
          92	            double f = (x * x * x) + (ka * x * x) - ((Kw + ka * concentrationMolar) * x) - (ka * Kw);
          93	            double df = (3.0 * x * x) + (2.0 * ka * x) - (Kw + ka * concentrationMolar);
          94	            double d2f = (6.0 * x) + (2.0 * ka);
          95
          96	            double step = (2.0 * f * df) / ((2.0 * df * df) - (f * d2f));
          97	            x -= step;
          98
          99	            if (Math.Abs(step) < 1e-15 * x || Math.Abs(f) < 1e-25)
         100	            {
         101	                break;
         102	            }
         103	        }
         104
         105	        double hConc = Math.Max(1e-14, x);
         106	        double ph = -Math.Log10(hConc);
         107	        double poh = 14.0 - ph;
         108	        double ohConc = Kw / hConc;
         109
         110	        return new PhResult(ph, poh, hConc, ohConc, ph < 7.0, ph > 7.0, Math.Abs(ph - 7.0) < 0.01);
         111	    }
         112
         113	    /// <summary>
         114	    /// Solves the Henderson-Hasselbalch buffer equation: pH = pKa + log10([A-] / [HA]).
         115	    /// </summary>
         116	    /// <param name="pka">Acid dissociation constant pKa.</param>
         117	    /// <param name="acidConcentrationMolar">Weak acid concentration [HA] (M).</param>
         118	    /// <param name="conjugateBaseConcentrationMolar">Conjugate base concentration [A-] (M).</param>
         119	    /// <returns>BufferResult record.</returns>
         120	    public static BufferResult CalculateBufferPh(double pka, double acidConcentrationMolar, double conjugateBaseConcentrationMolar)
         121	    {
         122	        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegativeOrZero(acidConcentrationMolar);
         123	        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegativeOrZero(conjugateBaseConcentrationMolar);
         124
         125	        double ph = pka + Math.Log10(conjugateBaseConcentrationMolar / acidConcentrationMolar);
         126
         127	        return new BufferResult(ph, pka, acidConcentrationMolar, conjugateBaseConcentrationMolar);
         128	    }

          25	/// <summary>
          26	/// Industrial-Grade Electrochemistry &amp; Nernst Cell Potential Engine.
          27	/// Calculates non-standard cell potentials ($E_{\text{cell}}$), Faraday redox transfer, and galvanic spontaneity.
          28	/// </summary>
          29	public static class ElectrochemistryEngine
          30	{
          31	    /// <summary>Ideal gas constant R in J/(mol·K).</summary>
          32	    private const double GasConstantR = 8.314462618;
          33
          34	    /// <summary>Faraday constant F in Coulombs per mole of electrons (C/mol).</summary>
          35	    private const double FaradayConstantF = 96485.33212;
          36
          37	    /// <summary>
          38	    /// Calculates the non-standard electromotive cell potential (E_cell) via the Nernst equation:
          39	    /// E = E° - (RT / nF) * ln(Q).
          40	    /// </summary>
          41	    /// <param name="standardCellPotentialVolts">Standard cell potential E° (V).</param>
          42	    /// <param name="electronsTransferred">Moles of electrons transferred (n).</param>
          43	    /// <param name="reactionQuotientQ">Reaction quotient Q = [Products]^p / [Reactants]^r.</param>
          44	    /// <param name="temperatureKelvin">Absolute temperature in Kelvin (default: 298.15 K).</param>
          45	    /// <returns>NernstResult record.</returns>
          46	    public static NernstResult CalculateNernstPotential(
          47	        double standardCellPotentialVolts,
          48	        int electronsTransferred,
          49	        double reactionQuotientQ,
          50	        double temperatureKelvin = 298.15
          51	    )
          52	    {
          53	        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegativeOrZero(electronsTransferred);
          54	        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegativeOrZero(reactionQuotientQ);
          55	        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegative(temperatureKelvin);
          56
          57	        double nernstTerm = (GasConstantR * temperatureKelvin / (electronsTransferred * FaradayConstantF)) * Math.Log(reactionQuotientQ);
          58	        double eCell = standardCellPotentialVolts - nernstTerm;
          59
          60	        return new NernstResult(
          61	            eCell,
          62	            standardCellPotentialVolts,
          63	            electronsTransferred,
          64	            reactionQuotientQ,
          65	            temperatureKelvin,
          66	            IsSpontaneousGalvanic: eCell > 0
          67	        );
          68	    }
          69	}

          26	/// <param name="ActivationEnergykJPerMol">Activation energy Ea in kJ/mol.</param>
          27	/// <param name="TemperatureKelvin">Temperature in Kelvin (K).</param>
          28	public record ArrheniusResult(
          29	    double RateConstantK,
          30	    double PreExponentialFactorA,
          31	    double ActivationEnergykJPerMol,
          32	    double TemperatureKelvin
          33	)
          34	{

          39	/// <summary>
          40	/// Runge-Kutta 4th Order (RK4) Differential Numerical Solver &amp; Cascade Simulator.
          41	/// Solves integrated rate laws (0th, 1st, 2nd order), half-lives, and Arrhenius activation energy equations.
          42	/// </summary>
          43	public static class KineticsEngine
          44	{
          45	    /// <summary>Ideal gas constant R in J/(mol·K).</summary>
          46	    private const double GasConstantR = 8.314462618;
          47
          48	    /// <summary>
          49	    /// Calculates the half-life (t_1/2) for a given reaction order and rate constant.
          50	    /// </summary>
          51	    /// <param name="order">Reaction order (0 for [A]0/2k, 1 for ln(2)/k, 2 for 1/(k[A]0)).</param>
          52	    /// <param name="rateConstantK">Rate constant k (units depend on reaction order).</param>
          53	    /// <param name="initialConcentrationMolar">Initial concentration [A]0 (M).</param>
          54	    /// <returns>HalfLifeResult record.</returns>
          55	    public static HalfLifeResult CalculateHalfLife(int order, double rateConstantK, double initialConcentrationMolar = 1.0)
          56	    {
          57	        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegativeOrZero(rateConstantK);
          58	        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegativeOrZero(initialConcentrationMolar);
          59
          60	        double halfLife = order switch
          61	        {
          62	            0 => initialConcentrationMolar / (2.0 * rateConstantK),
          63	            1 => Math.Log(2.0) / rateConstantK,
          64	            2 => 1.0 / (rateConstantK * initialConcentrationMolar),
          65	            _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(order), "Reaction order must be 0, 1, or 2.")
          66	        };
          67
          68	        return new HalfLifeResult(halfLife, order, rateConstantK, initialConcentrationMolar);
          69	    }
          70
          71	    /// <summary>
          72	    /// Calculates the Arrhenius rate constant k = A * exp(-Ea / RT).
          73	    /// </summary>
          74	    /// <param name="preExponentialFactorA">Pre-exponential collision frequency factor A.</param>
          75	    /// <param name="activationEnergykJPerMol">Activation energy Ea in kJ/mol.</param>
          76	    /// <param name="temperatureKelvin">Absolute temperature in Kelvin (K).</param>
          77	    /// <returns>ArrheniusResult record.</returns>
          78	    public static ArrheniusResult CalculateRateConstant(double preExponentialFactorA, double activationEnergykJPerMol, double temperatureKelvin)
          79	    {
          80	        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegativeOrZero(preExponentialFactorA);
          81	        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegative(activationEnergykJPerMol);
          82	        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegativeOrZero(temperatureKelvin);
          83
          84	        double eaJoules = activationEnergykJPerMol * 1000.0;
          85	        double k = preExponentialFactorA * Math.Exp(-eaJoules / (GasConstantR * temperatureKelvin));
          86
          87	        return new ArrheniusResult(k, preExponentialFactorA, activationEnergykJPerMol, temperatureKelvin);
          88	    }
          89
          90	    /// <summary>
          91	    /// Calculates the activation energy (Ea) from rate constants measured at two distinct temperatures.
          92	    /// Formula: Ea = R * (T1 * T2 / (T2 - T1)) * ln(k2 / k1)
          93	    /// </summary>
          94	    public static double CalculateActivationEnergy(double k1, double temperatureKelvin1, double k2, double temperatureKelvin2)
          95	    {
          96	        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegativeOrZero(k1);
          97	        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegativeOrZero(k2);
          98	        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegativeOrZero(temperatureKelvin1);
          99	        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegativeOrZero(temperatureKelvin2);
         100
         101	        if (Math.Abs(temperatureKelvin1 - temperatureKelvin2) < 0.001)
         102	        {
         103	            throw new ArgumentException("Temperatures must be distinct.");
         104	        }
         105
         106	        double eaJoules = (GasConstantR * temperatureKelvin1 * temperatureKelvin2 / (temperatureKelvin2 - temperatureKelvin1)) * Math.Log(k2 / k1);
         107	        return eaJoules / 1000.0;
         108	    }
         109	}

           3	/// <summary>
           4	/// Represents instantaneous concentrations of species in a multi-step reaction network at time t.
           5	/// </summary>
           6	/// <param name="TimeSeconds">Time in seconds from reaction initiation.</param>
           7	/// <param name="ConcentrationA">Concentration of initial reactant A (M).</param>
           8	/// <param name="ConcentrationB">Concentration of intermediate species B (M).</param>
           9	/// <param name="ConcentrationC">Concentration of final product species C (M).</param>
          10	public record TimeStepPoint(double TimeSeconds, double ConcentrationA, double ConcentrationB, double ConcentrationC);
          11
          12	/// <summary>
          13	/// Encapsulates the results of a numerical differential equation integration run for reaction kinetics.
          14	/// </summary>
          15	/// <param name="CascadeType">Type of reaction cascade mechanism (e.g. Consecutive A -> B -> C).</param>
          16	/// <param name="RateConstantK1">Forward rate constant for step 1 (A -> B).</param>
          17	/// <param name="RateConstantK2">Forward rate constant for step 2 (B -> C).</param>
          18	/// <param name="DurationSeconds">Total simulation duration in seconds.</param>
          19	/// <param name="Points">Discrete time-series concentration trajectory points.</param>
          20	public record ReactionNetworkSimulationResult(
          21	    string CascadeType,
          22	    double RateConstantK1,
          23	    double RateConstantK2,
          24	    double DurationSeconds,
          25	    IReadOnlyList<TimeStepPoint> Points
          26	);
          27
          28	/// <summary>
          29	/// Multi-Step Reaction Network Kinetics Engine.
          30	/// Solves coupled non-linear ordinary differential equations (ODEs) describing chemical kinetics
          31	/// cascades using the 4th-Order Runge-Kutta (RK4) numerical integration algorithm.
          32	/// </summary>
          33	public static class ReactionNetworkEngine
          34	{
          35	    /// <summary>
          36	    /// Numerically integrates a consecutive reaction cascade (A -> B -> C) via 4th-order Runge-Kutta.
          37	    /// Rate laws: dA/dt = -k1*A, dB/dt = k1*A - k2*B, dC/dt = k2*B.
          38	    /// </summary>
          39	    /// <param name="initialConcA">Initial concentration of reactant A in Molar (M).</param>
          40	    /// <param name="k1">First-order rate constant for A -> B (s⁻¹).</param>
          41	    /// <param name="k2">First-order rate constant for B -> C (s⁻¹).</param>
          42	    /// <param name="totalTime">Total simulation time in seconds.</param>
          43	    /// <param name="steps">Number of discrete integration time steps.</param>
          44	    /// <returns>Trajectory of concentrations over time.</returns>
          45	    public static ReactionNetworkSimulationResult SimulateConsecutiveCascade(
          46	        double initialConcA = 1.0,
          47	        double k1 = 0.5,
          48	        double k2 = 0.2,
          49	        double totalTime = 10.0,
          50	        int steps = 50)
          51	    {
          52	        var points = new List<TimeStepPoint>();
          53	        double dt = totalTime / steps;
          54
          55	        double a = initialConcA;
          56	        double b = 0.0;
          57	        double c = 0.0;
          58	        double t = 0.0;
          59
          60	        points.Add(new TimeStepPoint(t, a, b, c));
          61
          62	        // RK4 Butcher Tableau integration steps
          63	        for (int i = 0; i < steps; i++)
          64	        {
          65	            // k1 slope evaluation at beginning of interval
          66	            double da1 = -k1 * a;
          67	            double db1 = k1 * a - k2 * b;
          68	            double dc1 = k2 * b;
          69
          70	            // k2 slope evaluation at midpoint with Euler step
          71	            double da2 = -k1 * (a + 0.5 * dt * da1);
          72	            double db2 = k1 * (a + 0.5 * dt * da1) - k2 * (b + 0.5 * dt * db1);
          73	            double dc2 = k2 * (b + 0.5 * dt * db1);
          74
          75	            // k3 slope evaluation at midpoint with improved Euler step
          76	            double da3 = -k1 * (a + 0.5 * dt * da2);
          77	            double db3 = k1 * (a + 0.5 * dt * da2) - k2 * (b + 0.5 * dt * db2);
          78	            double dc3 = k2 * (b + 0.5 * dt * db2);
          79
          80	            // k4 slope evaluation at end of interval
          81	            double da4 = -k1 * (a + dt * da3);
          82	            double db4 = k1 * (a + dt * da3) - k2 * (b + dt * db3);
          83	            double dc4 = k2 * (b + dt * db3);
          84
          85	            // Weighted RK4 Simpson rule combination
          86	            a += (dt / 6.0) * (da1 + 2 * da2 + 2 * da3 + da4);
          87	            b += (dt / 6.0) * (db1 + 2 * db2 + 2 * db3 + db4);
          88	            c += (dt / 6.0) * (dc1 + 2 * dc2 + 2 * dc3 + dc4);
          89	            t += dt;
          90
          91	            points.Add(new TimeStepPoint(
          92	                Math.Round(t, 2),
          93	                Math.Round(Math.Max(0, a), 4),
          94	                Math.Round(Math.Max(0, b), 4),
          95	                Math.Round(Math.Max(0, c), 4)
          96	            ));
          97	        }
          98
          99	        return new ReactionNetworkSimulationResult("Consecutive Cascade (A -> B -> C)", k1, k2, totalTime, points);
         100	    }
         101
         102	    /// <summary>
         103	    /// Numerically integrates an arbitrary N-species reaction network ODE system: dC/dt = f(C, t) via RK4.
         104	    /// </summary>
         105	    /// <param name="initialConcentrations">Array of initial concentrations for all N chemical species.</param>
         106	    /// <param name="rateLaw">Delegate calculating the time derivatives dC/dt given current state C.</param>
         107	    /// <param name="totalTime">Total simulation duration in seconds.</param>
         108	    /// <param name="steps">Number of discrete time steps.</param>
         109	    /// <returns>Matrix of trajectories [steps + 1, N species].</returns>
         110	    public static (double[] Time, double[][] Trajectories) SimulateGeneralNetwork(
         111	        double[] initialConcentrations,
         112	        Func<double[], double[]> rateLaw,
         113	        double totalTime = 10.0,
         114	        int steps = 100)
         115	    {
         116	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(initialConcentrations);
         117	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(rateLaw);
         118	        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegativeOrZero(totalTime);
         119	        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegativeOrZero(steps);
         120
         121	        int n = initialConcentrations.Length;
         122	        double dt = totalTime / steps;
         123
         124	        double[] time = new double[steps + 1];
         125	        double[][] trajectories = new double[steps + 1][];
         126
         127	        double[] c = (double[])initialConcentrations.Clone();
         128	        time[0] = 0.0;
         129	        trajectories[0] = (double[])c.Clone();
         130
         131	        for (int step = 0; step < steps; step++)
         132	        {
         133	            // k1 = f(c)
         134	            double[] k1 = rateLaw(c);
         135
         136	            // k2 = f(c + 0.5*dt*k1)
         137	            double[] c_k1 = new double[n];
         138	            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) c_k1[i] = Math.Max(0.0, c[i] + 0.5 * dt * k1[i]);
         139	            double[] k2 = rateLaw(c_k1);
         140
         141	            // k3 = f(c + 0.5*dt*k2)
         142	            double[] c_k2 = new double[n];
         143	            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) c_k2[i] = Math.Max(0.0, c[i] + 0.5 * dt * k2[i]);
         144	            double[] k3 = rateLaw(c_k2);
         145
         146	            // k4 = f(c + dt*k3)
         147	            double[] c_k3 = new double[n];
         148	            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) c_k3[i] = Math.Max(0.0, c[i] + dt * k3[i]);
         149	            double[] k4 = rateLaw(c_k3);
         150
         151	            // c_{new} = c + (dt/6) * (k1 + 2*k2 + 2*k3 + k4)
         152	            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
         153	            {
         154	                c[i] = Math.Max(0.0, c[i] + (dt / 6.0) * (k1[i] + (2.0 * k2[i]) + (2.0 * k3[i]) + k4[i]));
         155	            }
         156
         157	            time[step + 1] = Math.Round((step + 1) * dt, 4);
         158	            trajectories[step + 1] = (double[])c.Clone();
         159	        }
         160
         161	        return (time, trajectories);
         162	    }
         163	}

           3	/// <summary>
           4	/// Exact Rational Matrix Solver for Chemical Equation Balancing.
           5	/// Solves the nullspace vector equation M * x = 0 over the rational field Q,
           6	/// using Gaussian elimination with partial pivoting and integer LCM scaling.
           7	/// </summary>
           8	internal static class MatrixSolver
           9	{
          10	    /// <summary>
          11	    /// Computes the minimal strictly positive integer nullspace solution vector for matrix M.
          12	    /// </summary>
          13	    /// <param name="matrix">Stoichiometric element conservation matrix.</param>
          14	    /// <returns>Minimal integer coefficient vector, or null if unbalanceable.</returns>
          15	    public static int[]? SolveNullspaceIntegerVector(int[,] matrix)
          16	    {
          17	        int rows = matrix.GetLength(0);
          18	        int cols = matrix.GetLength(1);
          19
          20	        // Convert integer matrix to exact rational matrix to prevent floating-point drift
          21	        Rational[,] rMatrix = new Rational[rows, cols];
          22	        for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++)
          23	        {
          24	            for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++)
          25	            {
          26	                rMatrix[r, c] = new Rational(matrix[r, c]);
          27	            }
          28	        }
          29
          30	        int pivotRow = 0;
          31	        int[] pivotCols = new int[cols];
          32	        Array.Fill(pivotCols, -1);
          33
          34	        // Gaussian elimination with partial pivoting to compute Reduced Row Echelon Form (RREF)
          35	        for (int c = 0; c < cols && pivotRow < rows; c++)
          36	        {
          37	            int sel = -1;
          38	            for (int r = pivotRow; r < rows; r++)
          39	            {
          40	                if (rMatrix[r, c].Num != 0)
          41	                {
          42	                    sel = r;
          43	                    break;
          44	                }
          45	            }
          46
          47	            if (sel == -1) continue;
          48
          49	            // Swap pivot row
          50	            for (int j = 0; j < cols; j++)
          51	            {
          52	                (rMatrix[pivotRow, j], rMatrix[sel, j]) = (rMatrix[sel, j], rMatrix[pivotRow, j]);
          53	            }
          54
          55	            // Normalize pivot row
          56	            Rational pivotVal = rMatrix[pivotRow, c];
          57	            for (int j = 0; j < cols; j++)
          58	            {
          59	                rMatrix[pivotRow, j] = rMatrix[pivotRow, j] / pivotVal;
          60	            }
          61
          62	            // Eliminate other rows in current column
          63	            for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++)
          64	            {
          65	                if (r != pivotRow && rMatrix[r, c].Num != 0)
          66	                {
          67	                    Rational factor = rMatrix[r, c];
          68	                    for (int j = 0; j < cols; j++)
          69	                    {
          70	                        rMatrix[r, j] = rMatrix[r, j] - factor * rMatrix[pivotRow, j];
          71	                    }
          72	                }
          73	            }
          74
          75	            pivotCols[c] = pivotRow;
          76	            pivotRow++;
          77	        }
          78
          79	        // Identify free variable column
          80	        int freeCol = -1;
          81	        for (int c = cols - 1; c >= 0; c--)
          82	        {
          83	            if (pivotCols[c] == -1)
          84	            {
          85	                freeCol = c;
          86	                break;
          87	            }
          88	        }
          89
          90	        if (freeCol == -1) return null;
          91
          92	        // Assign free variable unit rational value and back-substitute
          93	        Rational[] solution = new Rational[cols];
          94	        solution[freeCol] = new Rational(1);
          95
          96	        for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++)
          97	        {
          98	            if (pivotCols[c] != -1)
          99	            {
         100	                int r = pivotCols[c];
         101	                solution[c] = -rMatrix[r, freeCol];
         102	            }
         103	        }
         104
         105	        // Compute Least Common Multiple (LCM) of denominators to clear fractions
         106	        long lcm = 1;
         107	        foreach (var rat in solution)
         108	        {
         109	            if (rat.Num != 0)
         110	            {
         111	                lcm = Lcm(lcm, rat.Den);
         112	            }
         113	        }
         114
         115	        // Scale by LCM into integer solution
         116	        int[] intVector = new int[cols];
         117	        bool allPositive = true;
         118	        for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++)
         119	        {
         120	            Rational scaled = solution[c] * new Rational(lcm);
         121	            int val = (int)(scaled.Num / scaled.Den);
         122	            if (val <= 0) allPositive = false;
         123	            intVector[c] = val;
         124	        }
         125
         126	        if (!allPositive)
         127	        {
         128	            for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++)
         129	            {
         130	                intVector[c] = -intVector[c];
         131	                if (intVector[c] <= 0) return null;
         132	            }
         133	        }
         134
         135	        // Reduce by Greatest Common Divisor (GCD) to minimal primitive integers
         136	        long commonGcd = intVector[0];
         137	        for (int c = 1; c < cols; c++)
         138	        {
         139	            commonGcd = Gcd(commonGcd, intVector[c]);
         140	        }
         141
         142	        if (commonGcd > 1)
         143	        {
         144	            for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++)
         145	            {
         146	                intVector[c] /= (int)commonGcd;
         147	            }
         148	        }
         149
         150	        return intVector;
         151	    }
         152
         153	    /// <summary>Calculates Greatest Common Divisor (Euclidean algorithm).</summary>
         154	    private static long Gcd(long a, long b)
         155	    {
         156	        a = Math.Abs(a);
         157	        b = Math.Abs(b);
         158	        while (b != 0)
         159	        {
         160	            long temp = b;
         161	            b = a % b;
         162	            a = temp;
         163	        }
         164	        return a == 0 ? 1 : a;
         165	    }
         166
         167	    /// <summary>Calculates Least Common Multiple.</summary>
         168	    private static long Lcm(long a, long b) => (a / Gcd(a, b)) * b;
         169	}

         171	/// <summary>
         172	/// Immutable, exact rational number struct with automatic GCD reduction.
         173	/// </summary>
         174	internal readonly struct Rational
         175	{
         176	    public long Num { get; }
         177	    public long Den { get; }
         178
         179	    public Rational(long num, long den = 1)
         180	    {
         181	        if (den == 0) throw new DivideByZeroException("Rational denominator cannot be zero.");
         182
         183	        if (den < 0)
         184	        {
         185	            num = -num;
         186	            den = -den;
         187	        }
         188
         189	        long g = Gcd(num, den);
         190	        Num = num / g;
         191	        Den = den / g;
         192	    }
         193
         194	    public static Rational operator +(Rational a, Rational b) => new(a.Num * b.Den + b.Num * a.Den, a.Den * b.Den);
         195	    public static Rational operator -(Rational a, Rational b) => new(a.Num * b.Den - b.Num * a.Den, a.Den * b.Den);
         196	    public static Rational operator -(Rational a) => new(-a.Num, a.Den);
         197	    public static Rational operator *(Rational a, Rational b) => new(a.Num * b.Num, a.Den * b.Den);
         198	    public static Rational operator /(Rational a, Rational b) => new(a.Num * b.Den, a.Den * b.Num);
         199
         200	    private static long Gcd(long a, long b)
         201	    {
         202	        a = Math.Abs(a);
         203	        b = Math.Abs(b);
         204	        while (b != 0)
         205	        {
         206	            long temp = b;
         207	            b = a % b;
         208	            a = temp;
         209	        }
         210	        return a == 0 ? 1 : a;
         211	    }
         212	}

          23	    /// <summary>
          24	    /// Evaluates whether the Law of Conservation of Mass is satisfied
          25	    /// (total atom count for each element is identical on reactant and product sides).
          26	    /// </summary>
          27	    public bool IsBalanced
          28	    {
          29	        get
          30	        {
          31	            var reactantCounts = GetElementCounts(Reactants);
          32	            var productCounts = GetElementCounts(Products);
          33
          34	            if (reactantCounts.Count != productCounts.Count) return false;
          35
          36	            foreach (var (element, count) in reactantCounts)
          37	            {
          38	                if (!productCounts.TryGetValue(element, out int prodCount) || count != prodCount)
          39	                {
          40	                    return false;
          41	                }
          42	            }
          43
          44	            int reactantCharge = Reactants.Sum(r => r.Coefficient * r.Molecule.NetCharge);
          45	            int productCharge = Products.Sum(p => p.Coefficient * p.Molecule.NetCharge);
          46	            if (reactantCharge != productCharge) return false;
          47
          48	            return true;
          49	        }
          50	    }

          71	    /// <summary>
          72	    /// Balances the chemical equation using exact rational Gaussian elimination nullspace algebra.
          73	    /// Computes the minimal integer stoichiometric coefficients satisfying M * x = 0 with mass and charge conservation.
          74	    /// </summary>
          75	    /// <returns>New balanced Reaction instance.</returns>
          76	    public Reaction Balance()
          77	    {
          78	        if (IsBalanced) return this;
          79
          80	        var allComponents = Reactants.Concat(Products).ToList();
          81	        var allElements = allComponents
          82	            .SelectMany(c => c.Molecule.Atoms.Select(a => a.Element))
          83	            .Distinct()
          84	            .ToList();
          85
          86	        bool hasCharges = allComponents.Any(c => c.Molecule.NetCharge != 0);
          87	        int rows = allElements.Count + (hasCharges ? 1 : 0);
          88	        int cols = allComponents.Count;
          89	        int[,] matrix = new int[rows, cols];
          90
          91	        // Formulate stoichiometric conservation matrix M
          92	        for (int r = 0; r < allElements.Count; r++)
          93	        {
          94	            var elem = allElements[r];
          95	            for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++)
          96	            {
          97	                int atomCount = allComponents[c].Molecule.Atoms.Count(a => a.Element == elem);
          98	                matrix[r, c] = c < Reactants.Count ? atomCount : -atomCount;
          99	            }
         100	        }
         101
         102	        // Add net charge conservation row for ionic redox reactions
         103	        if (hasCharges)
         104	        {
         105	            int chargeRow = allElements.Count;
         106	            for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++)
         107	            {
         108	                int charge = allComponents[c].Molecule.NetCharge;
         109	                matrix[chargeRow, c] = c < Reactants.Count ? charge : -charge;
         110	            }
         111	        }
         112
         113	        var coefficients = MatrixSolver.SolveNullspaceIntegerVector(matrix);
         114	        if (coefficients == null || coefficients.Length != cols)
         115	        {
         116	            throw new InvalidOperationException("Could not balance reaction automatically.");
         117	        }
         118
         119	        var balancedReactants = Reactants.Select((c, i) => new ReactionComponent(c.Molecule, coefficients[i]));
         120	        var balancedProducts = Products.Select((c, i) => new ReactionComponent(c.Molecule, coefficients[Reactants.Count + i]));
         121
         122	        return new Reaction(balancedReactants, balancedProducts);
         123	    }

         158	    /// <summary>Attempts to parse a chemical equation string, returning syntax error messages if invalid.</summary>
         159	    public static bool TryParse(string equation, [NotNullWhen(true)] out Reaction? reaction, out string? errorMessage)
         160	    {
         161	        reaction = null;
         162	        errorMessage = null;
         163
         164	        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(equation))
         165	        {
         166	            errorMessage = "Equation string is null or empty.";
         167	            return false;
         168	        }
         169
         170	        string[] sideSeparators = ["-->", "->", "=>", "=", "⇌"];
         171	        string[] sides = Array.Empty<string>();
         172
         173	        foreach (var sep in sideSeparators)
         174	        {
         175	            if (equation.Contains(sep))
         176	            {
         177	                sides = equation.Split(sep, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
         178	                break;
         179	            }
         180	        }
         181
         182	        if (sides.Length != 2)
         183	        {
         184	            errorMessage = "Equation must contain a valid arrow separator ('->', '=', '=>', '-->', '⇌').";
         185	            return false;
         186	        }
         187
         188	        try
         189	        {
         190	            var reactants = ParseSide(sides[0]);
         191	            var products = ParseSide(sides[1]);
         192
         193	            reaction = new Reaction(reactants, products);
         194	            return true;
         195	        }
         196	        catch (Exception ex)
         197	        {
         198	            errorMessage = ex.Message;
         199	            return false;
         200	        }
         201	    }
         202
         203	    /// <summary>Parses one side (reactants or products) of a reaction equation.</summary>
         204	    private static List<ReactionComponent> ParseSide(string sideStr)
         205	    {
         206	        string[] terms = sideStr.Split('+', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
         207	        var components = new List<ReactionComponent>();
         208
         209	        foreach (var term in terms)
         210	        {
         211	            string trimmed = term.Trim();
         212	            if (trimmed.Length == 0) continue;
         213
         214	            int i = 0;
         215	            while (i < trimmed.Length && char.IsDigit(trimmed[i]))
         216	            {
         217	                i++;
         218	            }
         219
         220	            int coefficient = 1;
         221	            string formulaStr = trimmed;
         222
         223	            if (i > 0)
         224	            {
         225	                coefficient = int.Parse(trimmed[..i]);
         226	                formulaStr = trimmed[i..].Trim();
         227	            }
         228
         229	            var molecule = FormulaParser.Parse(formulaStr);
         230	            components.Add(new ReactionComponent(molecule, coefficient));
         231	        }
         232
         233	        return components;
         234	    }

         236	    /// <summary>Audits total count of atoms per element across components.</summary>
         237	    private static Dictionary<Element, int> GetElementCounts(IEnumerable<ReactionComponent> components)
         238	    {

         240	        foreach (var comp in components)
         241	        {
         242	            foreach (var atom in comp.Molecule.Atoms)
         243	            {
         244	                counts[atom.Element] = counts.GetValueOrDefault(atom.Element, 0) + comp.Coefficient;
         245	            }
         246	        }
         247
         248	        return counts;
         249	    }
