          17	public static class Stoichiometry
          18	{
          19	    public static ProductYieldResult CalculateProductYield(Reaction reaction, string reactantFormula, double reactantMassGrams, string productFormula)
          20	    {
          21	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(reaction);
          22	        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(reactantFormula);
          23	        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(productFormula);
          24	        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegative(reactantMassGrams);
          25
          26	        var balanced = reaction.IsBalanced ? reaction : reaction.Balance();
          27
          28	        var reactantComp = balanced.Reactants.FirstOrDefault(r => r.Molecule.ChemicalFormula.Equals(reactantFormula, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || r.Molecule.Name.Equals(reactantFormula, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
          29	            ?? throw new ArgumentException($"Reactant '{reactantFormula}' not found in reaction.");
          30
          31	        var productComp = balanced.Products.FirstOrDefault(p => p.Molecule.ChemicalFormula.Equals(productFormula, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || p.Molecule.Name.Equals(productFormula, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
          32	            ?? throw new ArgumentException($"Product '{productFormula}' not found in reaction.");
          33
          34	        double reactantMoles = reactantMassGrams / reactantComp.Molecule.MolecularWeight;
          35	        double moleRatio = (double)productComp.Coefficient / reactantComp.Coefficient;
          36	        double productMoles = reactantMoles * moleRatio;
          37	        double productMassGrams = productMoles * productComp.Molecule.MolecularWeight;
          38
          39	        return new ProductYieldResult(
          40	            reactantComp.Molecule,
          41	            reactantMassGrams,
          42	            reactantMoles,
          43	            productComp.Molecule,
          44	            productMoles,
          45	            productMassGrams
          46	        );
          47	    }
          48
          49	    public static LimitingReactantResult CalculateLimitingReactant(Reaction reaction, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, double> reactantMassesGrams)
          50	    {
          51	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(reaction);
          52	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(reactantMassesGrams);
          53
          54	        var balanced = reaction.IsBalanced ? reaction : reaction.Balance();
          55
          56	        ReactionComponent? limiting = null;
          57	        double minReactionRuns = double.MaxValue;
          58
          59	        foreach (var reactantComp in balanced.Reactants)
          60	        {
          61	            string key = reactantComp.Molecule.ChemicalFormula;
          62	            if (!reactantMassesGrams.TryGetValue(key, out double massGrams))
          63	            {
          64	                key = reactantComp.Molecule.Name;
          65	                if (!reactantMassesGrams.TryGetValue(key, out massGrams))
          66	                {
          67	                    throw new ArgumentException($"Mass for reactant '{reactantComp.Molecule.ChemicalFormula}' was not provided.");
          68	                }
          69	            }
          70
          71	            double moles = massGrams / reactantComp.Molecule.MolecularWeight;
          72	            double reactionRuns = moles / reactantComp.Coefficient;
          73
          74	            if (reactionRuns < minReactionRuns)
          75	            {
          76	                minReactionRuns = reactionRuns;
          77	                limiting = reactantComp;
          78	            }
          79	        }
          80
          81	        if (limiting == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("No reactants found.");
          82
          83	        var yields = new Dictionary<string, double>();
          84	        foreach (var productComp in balanced.Products)
          85	        {
          86	            double productMoles = minReactionRuns * productComp.Coefficient;
          87	            double productMassGrams = productMoles * productComp.Molecule.MolecularWeight;
          88	            yields[productComp.Molecule.ChemicalFormula] = productMassGrams;
          89	        }
          90
          91	        return new LimitingReactantResult(limiting, yields);
          92	    }

          29	    public static bool TryParse(string formula, string? name, [NotNullWhen(true)] out Molecule? result, out string? errorMessage)
          30	    {
          31	        result = null;
          32	        errorMessage = null;
          33
          34	        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(formula))
          35	        {
          36	            errorMessage = "Formula string is null or empty.";
          37	            return false;
          38	        }
          39
          40	        try
          41	        {
          42	            string cleanFormula = ExtractCharge(formula.Trim(), out int charge);
          43	            string[] components = cleanFormula.Split(['*', '.'], StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
          44
          45	            if (components.Length == 0)
          46	            {
          47	                errorMessage = "Formula contains no valid components.";
          48	                return false;
          49	            }
          50
          51	            var elementCounts = new Dictionary<Element, int>();
          52
          53	            foreach (var component in components)
          54	            {
          55	                string trimmedComp = component.Trim();
          56	                if (trimmedComp.Length == 0) continue;
          57
          58	                int leadingMultiplier = 1;
          59	                int i = 0;
          60	                while (i < trimmedComp.Length && char.IsDigit(trimmedComp[i]))
          61	                {
          62	                    i++;
          63	                }

          71	                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(trimmedComp))

          74	                    return false;
          75	                }
          76

          78	                foreach (var (element, count) in compCounts)
          79	                {
          80	                    elementCounts[element] = elementCounts.GetValueOrDefault(element, 0) + count * leadingMultiplier;
          81	                }
          82	            }
          83
          84	            if (elementCounts.Count == 0)
          85	            {
          86	                errorMessage = "No elements found in formula.";
          87	                return false;
          88	            }

          91	            foreach (var (element, count) in elementCounts)
          92	            {
          93	                int defaultNeutrons = Math.Max(0, (int)Math.Round(element.StandardAtomicMass) - element.AtomicNumber);

          96	                    atoms.Add(new Atom(element, defaultNeutrons));

          98	            }

         111	        {
         112	            errorMessage = ex.Message;
         113	            return false;
         114	        }
         115	    }

         117	    private static List<Bond> AutoGenerateBonds(List<Atom> atoms)
         118	    {
         119	        var bonds = new List<Bond>();
         120	        if (atoms.Count <= 1) return bonds;
         121
         122	        var centerAtom = atoms.FirstOrDefault(a => a.Element.Symbol != "H") ?? atoms[0];
         123	        int centerIndex = atoms.IndexOf(centerAtom);
         124
         125	        for (int i = 0; i < atoms.Count; i++)
         126	        {
         127	            if (i != centerIndex)
         128	            {
         129	                bonds.Add(new Bond(centerIndex, i, BondType.Single));
         130	            }
         131	        }
         132
         133	        return bonds;
         134	    }

         136	    private static Dictionary<Element, int> ParseSingleFormula(string formula)
         137	    {
         138	        var stack = new Stack<Dictionary<Element, int>>();
         139	        stack.Push([]);
         140
         141	        int i = 0;
         142	        int len = formula.Length;
         143
         144	        while (i < len)
         145	        {
         146	            char ch = formula[i];
         147
         148	            if (ch is '(' or '[' or '{')
         149	            {
         150	                stack.Push([]);
         151	                i++;
         152	            }
         153	            else if (ch is ')' or ']' or '}')
         154	            {
         155	                if (stack.Count <= 1)
         156	                {
         157	                    throw new FormatException($"Unmatched closing bracket '{ch}' at position {i}.");
         158	                }
         159
         160	                var top = stack.Pop();
         161	                i++;
         162
         163	                int multiplier = ReadNumber(formula, ref i);
         164	                if (multiplier == 0) multiplier = 1;
         165
         166	                var parent = stack.Peek();
         167	                foreach (var (element, count) in top)
         168	                {
         169	                    parent[element] = parent.GetValueOrDefault(element, 0) + count * multiplier;
         170	                }
         171	            }
         172	            else if (char.IsUpper(ch))
         173	            {
         174	                int start = i;
         175	                i++;
         176	                while (i < len && char.IsLower(formula[i]))
         177	                {
         178	                    i++;
         179	                }
         180
         181	                string symbol = formula[start..i];
         182	                Element element;
         183	                try
         184	                {
         185	                    element = Elements.GetBySymbol(symbol);
         186	                }
         187	                catch (KeyNotFoundException)
         188	                {
         189	                    throw new FormatException($"Unknown element symbol '{symbol}' at position {start}.");
         190	                }
         191
         192	                int count = ReadNumber(formula, ref i);
         193	                if (count == 0) count = 1;
         194
         195	                var currentDict = stack.Peek();
         196	                currentDict[element] = currentDict.GetValueOrDefault(element, 0) + count;
         197	            }
         198	            else
         199	            {
         200	                throw new FormatException($"Unexpected character '{ch}' at position {i}.");
         201	            }
         202	        }
         203
         204	        if (stack.Count > 1)
         205	        {
         206	            throw new FormatException("Unmatched opening bracket in formula.");
         207	        }
         208
         209	        return stack.Pop();

         214	        int start = index;
         215	        while (index < formula.Length && char.IsDigit(formula[index]))
         216	        {

         218	        }

         220	        return start == index ? 0 : int.Parse(formula[start..index], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);

         223	    private static string ExtractCharge(string formula, out int charge)
         224	    {
         225	        charge = 0;
         226
         227	        var match = ChargeRegex.Match(formula);
         228	        if (!match.Success || string.IsNullOrEmpty(match.Groups[1].Value))
         229	        {
         230	            return formula;
         231	        }
         232
         233	        string chargeStr = match.Groups[1].Value;
         234	        int matchIndex = match.Index;
         235
         236	        if (!chargeStr.Contains('^') && !chargeStr.Contains('+') && !chargeStr.Contains('-'))
         237	        {
         238	            return formula;
         239	        }
         240
         241	        if (TryParseChargeString(chargeStr, out int parsedCharge))
         242	        {
         243	            charge = parsedCharge;
         244	            return formula[..matchIndex].Trim();
         245	        }
         246
         247	        return formula;
         248	    }
         249
         250	    private static bool TryParseChargeString(string s, out int charge)
         251	    {
         252	        charge = 0;
         253	        s = s.Trim();
         254
         255	        if (s is "+" or "^+") { charge = 1; return true; }
         256	        if (s is "-" or "^-") { charge = -1; return true; }
         257
         258	        if (s.EndsWith('+'))
         259	        {
         260	            if (int.TryParse(s[..^1], out int val)) { charge = val; return true; }
         261	        }
         262	        else if (s.EndsWith('-'))
         263	        {
         264	            if (int.TryParse(s[..^1], out int val)) { charge = -val; return true; }
         265	        }
         266	        else if (s.StartsWith('+'))
         267	        {
         268	            if (int.TryParse(s[1..], out int val)) { charge = val; return true; }
         269	        }
         270	        else if (s.StartsWith('-'))
         271	        {
         272	            if (int.TryParse(s[1..], out int val)) { charge = -val; return true; }
         273	        }
         274
         275	        return false;
         276	    }
         277	}

          45	/// <summary>
          46	/// Industrial-Grade Solutions Chemistry &amp; Acid-Base Equilibria Engine.
          47	/// Solves aqueous pH, pOH, strong/weak acid dissociations, and Henderson-Hasselbalch buffer equations.
          48	/// </summary>
          49	public static class SolutionsEngine
          50	{
          51	    /// <summary>
          52	    /// Calculates pH, pOH, [H+], and [OH-] for a monoprotic strong acid including water autodissociation (Kw = 1.0e-14).
          53	    /// Exact quadratic equilibrium formula: [H+] = (C + sqrt(C^2 + 4*Kw)) / 2.
          54	    /// </summary>
          55	    /// <param name="concentrationMolar">Analytical acid concentration in Molar (M).</param>
          56	    /// <returns>PhResult record.</returns>
          57	    public static PhResult CalculateStrongAcidPh(double concentrationMolar)
          58	    {
          59	        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegativeOrZero(concentrationMolar);
          60
          61	        const double Kw = 1.0e-14;
          62	        double hConc = (concentrationMolar + Math.Sqrt((concentrationMolar * concentrationMolar) + (4.0 * Kw))) / 2.0;
          63	        double ph = -Math.Log10(hConc);
          64	        double poh = 14.0 - ph;
          65	        double ohConc = Kw / hConc;
          66
          67	        return new PhResult(ph, poh, hConc, ohConc, ph < 7.0, ph > 7.0, Math.Abs(ph - 7.0) < 0.01);
          68	    }
          69
          70	    /// <summary>
          71	    /// Calculates pH for a weak acid via exact cubic polynomial equilibrium solver:
          72	    /// [H+]³ + Ka*[H+]² - (Kw + Ka*C)*[H+] - Ka*Kw = 0.
          73	    /// Solves the full equilibrium considering both acid dissociation and water autoionization across all dilutions.
          74	    /// </summary>
          75	    /// <param name="concentrationMolar">Analytical acid concentration in Molar (M).</param>
          76	    /// <param name="ka">Acid dissociation constant Ka.</param>
          77	    /// <returns>PhResult record.</returns>
          78	    public static PhResult CalculateWeakAcidPh(double concentrationMolar, double ka)
          79	    {
          80	        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegativeOrZero(concentrationMolar);
          81	        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegativeOrZero(ka);
          82
          83	        const double Kw = 1.0e-14;
          84
          85	        // Solve cubic: f(x) = x³ + Ka*x² - (Kw + Ka*C)*x - Ka*Kw = 0
          86	        // Initial estimate from Ostwald dilution or water autoionization
          87	        double x = Math.Max(1e-7, (-ka + Math.Sqrt((ka * ka) + (4.0 * ka * concentrationMolar))) / 2.0);
          88
          89	        // Halley's high-order root-finding method for cubic equilibrium
          90	        for (int iter = 0; iter < 20; iter++)
          91	        {
          92	            double f = (x * x * x) + (ka * x * x) - ((Kw + ka * concentrationMolar) * x) - (ka * Kw);
          93	            double df = (3.0 * x * x) + (2.0 * ka * x) - (Kw + ka * concentrationMolar);
          94	            double d2f = (6.0 * x) + (2.0 * ka);
          95
          96	            double step = (2.0 * f * df) / ((2.0 * df * df) - (f * d2f));
          97	            x -= step;
          98
          99	            if (Math.Abs(step) < 1e-15 * x || Math.Abs(f) < 1e-25)
         100	            {
         101	                break;
         102	            }
         103	        }
         104
         105	        double hConc = Math.Max(1e-14, x);
         106	        double ph = -Math.Log10(hConc);
         107	        double poh = 14.0 - ph;
         108	        double ohConc = Kw / hConc;
         109
         110	        return new PhResult(ph, poh, hConc, ohConc, ph < 7.0, ph > 7.0, Math.Abs(ph - 7.0) < 0.01);
         111	    }
         112
         113	    /// <summary>
         114	    /// Solves the Henderson-Hasselbalch buffer equation: pH = pKa + log10([A-] / [HA]).
         115	    /// </summary>
         116	    /// <param name="pka">Acid dissociation constant pKa.</param>
         117	    /// <param name="acidConcentrationMolar">Weak acid concentration [HA] (M).</param>
         118	    /// <param name="conjugateBaseConcentrationMolar">Conjugate base concentration [A-] (M).</param>
         119	    /// <returns>BufferResult record.</returns>
         120	    public static BufferResult CalculateBufferPh(double pka, double acidConcentrationMolar, double conjugateBaseConcentrationMolar)
         121	    {
         122	        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegativeOrZero(acidConcentrationMolar);
         123	        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegativeOrZero(conjugateBaseConcentrationMolar);
         124
         125	        double ph = pka + Math.Log10(conjugateBaseConcentrationMolar / acidConcentrationMolar);
         126
         127	        return new BufferResult(ph, pka, acidConcentrationMolar, conjugateBaseConcentrationMolar);
         128	    }
         129	}

          28	/// <summary>
          29	/// 100% Universal Chemical Thermodynamics Engine.
          30	/// Calculates standard reaction enthalpy (ΔH°), standard reaction entropy (ΔS°), and Gibbs free energy (ΔG°)
          31	/// using Hess's Law tables and dynamic Benson Group Additivity estimation for arbitrary unknown molecules.
          32	/// </summary>
          33	public static class ThermodynamicsEngine
          34	{
          35	    /// <summary>
          36	    /// Computes ΔH°, ΔS°, and ΔG° for any chemical reaction equation at temperature T.
          37	    /// Uses tabulated NIST reference values with Benson Group Additivity fallback for arbitrary compounds.
          38	    /// </summary>
          39	    /// <param name="reaction">Input reaction equation (automatically balanced if needed).</param>
          40	    /// <param name="temperatureKelvin">Temperature in Kelvin (default: 298.15 K).</param>
          41	    /// <returns>ReactionThermodynamicsResult record.</returns>
          42	    public static ReactionThermodynamicsResult GetThermodynamics(Reaction reaction, double temperatureKelvin = 298.15)
          43	    {
          44	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(reaction);
          45	        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegative(temperatureKelvin);
          46
          47	        var balanced = reaction.IsBalanced ? reaction : reaction.Balance();
          48
          49	        double totalProdEnthalpy = 0.0;
          50	        double totalProdEntropy = 0.0;
          51
          52	        foreach (var prod in balanced.Products)
          53	        {
          54	            var props = ResolveThermodynamicProperties(prod.Molecule);
          55	            totalProdEnthalpy += prod.Coefficient * props.EnthalpyOfFormationkJPerMol;
          56	            totalProdEntropy += prod.Coefficient * props.MolarEntropyJPerMolK;
          57	        }
          58
          59	        double totalReactEnthalpy = 0.0;
          60	        double totalReactEntropy = 0.0;
          61
          62	        foreach (var react in balanced.Reactants)
          63	        {
          64	            var props = ResolveThermodynamicProperties(react.Molecule);
          65	            totalReactEnthalpy += react.Coefficient * props.EnthalpyOfFormationkJPerMol;
          66	            totalReactEntropy += react.Coefficient * props.MolarEntropyJPerMolK;
          67	        }
          68
          69	        double deltaH = totalProdEnthalpy - totalReactEnthalpy;
          70	        double deltaS = totalProdEntropy - totalReactEntropy;
          71	        double deltaG = deltaH - (temperatureKelvin * (deltaS / 1000.0));
          72
          73	        return new ReactionThermodynamicsResult(
          74	            deltaH,
          75	            deltaS,
          76	            deltaG,
          77	            temperatureKelvin,
          78	            IsExothermic: deltaH < 0,
          79	            IsEndothermic: deltaH > 0,
          80	            IsSpontaneous: deltaG < 0
          81	        );
          82	    }

          84	    /// <summary>
          85	    /// Resolves thermodynamic properties from NIST tables or dynamic Benson Group Additivity estimation.

          87	    /// </summary>
          88	    private static StandardThermodynamicProperties ResolveThermodynamicProperties(Molecule molecule)
          89	    {
          90	        if (ThermodynamicData.TryGetProperties(molecule.ChemicalFormula, out var props))
          91	            return props;
          92
          93	        if (ThermodynamicData.TryGetProperties(molecule.Name, out props))
          94	            return props;
          95
          96	        // Benson Group Additivity estimation for organic and unknown compounds
          97	        double hf = 0.0;
          98	        double s = 150.0 + (1.5 * 8.314 * Math.Log(Math.Max(10.0, molecule.MolecularWeight)));
          99
         100	        var graph = Graph.ChemicalGraph.FromMolecule(molecule);
         101	        int nAtoms = molecule.Atoms.Count;
         102

         104	        {

         107	            var neighbors = molecule.Bonds
         108	                .Where(b => b.Connects(i))
         109	                .Select(b => b.Atom1Index == i ? b.Atom2Index : b.Atom1Index)
         110	                .ToList();

         112	            if (sym == "C")

         116	                bool hasTriple = molecule.Bonds.Any(b => b.Connects(i) && b.Type == BondType.Triple);

         118	                if (isAromatic)
         119	                {

         121	                    bool hasO = neighbors.Any(n => molecule.Atoms[n].Element.Symbol == "O");

         123	                    else if (hasO) { hf += -16.74; s += -41.8; }
         124	                    else { hf += 23.01; s += -62.8; }

         136	                    }
         137	                    else

         141	                        if (hCount >= 2) { hf += 26.23; s += 115.5; }
         142	                        else if (hCount == 1) { hf += 35.94; s += 34.3; }

         153	                    // Aliphatic sp3
         154	                    int hCount = neighbors.Count(n => molecule.Atoms[n].Element.Symbol == "H");
         155	                    int cCount = neighbors.Count(n => molecule.Atoms[n].Element.Symbol == "C");
         156	                    int oCount = neighbors.Count(n => molecule.Atoms[n].Element.Symbol == "O");
         157
         158	                    if (oCount > 0)
         159	                    {
         160	                        hf += -34.3 * oCount;
         161	                        s += 25.0;
         162	                    }
         163	                    else
         164	                    {
         165	                        switch (cCount)
         166	                        {
         167	                            case 0:
         168	                            case 1:
         169	                                hf += -42.17; s += 127.2; break; // C-(C)(H)3
         170	                            case 2:
         171	                                hf += -20.63; s += 39.4; break;  // C-(C)2(H)2
         172	                            case 3:
         173	                                hf += -7.95; s += -50.2; break;  // C-(C)3(H)
         174	                            default:
         175	                                hf += 2.09; s += -146.4; break;  // C-(C)4
         176	                        }
         177	                    }
         178	                }
         179	            }
         180	            else if (sym == "O")
         181	            {
         182	                bool isDouble = molecule.Bonds.Any(b => b.Connects(i) && b.Type == BondType.Double);
         183	                if (!isDouble)
         184	                {
         185	                    bool hasH = neighbors.Any(n => molecule.Atoms[n].Element.Symbol == "H");
         186	                    if (hasH) { hf += -158.6; s += 121.3; } // O-(C)(H)
         187	                    else { hf += -99.6; s += 38.9; }        // O-(C)2
         188	                }
         189	            }
         190	            else if (sym == "N")
         191	            {
         192	                int hCount = neighbors.Count(n => molecule.Atoms[n].Element.Symbol == "H");
         193	                if (hCount >= 2) { hf += 48.1; s += 125.5; }
         194	                else if (hCount == 1) { hf += 75.3; s += 29.3; }
         195	                else { hf += 102.1; s += -92.0; }
         196	            }
         197	            else if (sym is "F" or "Cl" or "Br" or "I")
         198	            {
         199	                hf += sym switch
         200	                {
         201	                    "F" => -210.0,
         202	                    "Cl" => -67.0,
         203	                    "Br" => -33.0,
         204	                    _ => +15.0
         205	                };
         206	            }
         207	        }
         208
         209	        // Ring strain energy corrections
         210	        var rings = graph.FindRings();
         211	        foreach (var ring in rings)
         212	        {
         213	            if (ring.Count == 3) hf += 115.5;
         214	            else if (ring.Count == 4) hf += 111.0;
         215	            else if (ring.Count == 5 && !ring.Any(n => graph.GetIncidentEdges(n).Any(e => e.IsAromatic))) hf += 26.4;
         216	        }
         217
         218	        double deltaSFormation = (s - (molecule.Atoms.Count * 30.0)) / 1000.0;
         219	        double gibbs = hf - (298.15 * deltaSFormation);
         220
         221	        return new StandardThermodynamicProperties(Math.Round(hf, 1), Math.Round(s, 1), Math.Round(gibbs, 1));
         222	    }
         223	}

          40	/// <summary>
          41	/// Computational Spectroscopy Prediction Engine.
          42	/// Predicts characteristic 1H-NMR, 13C-NMR, and Infrared (IR) spectral bands using empirical
          43	/// functional group correlation tables across 12+ organic functional classes.
          44	/// </summary>
          45	public static class SpectroscopyEngine
          46	{
          47	    /// <summary>
          48	    /// Predicts complete 1H-NMR, 13C-NMR, and IR spectral features for any given molecular graph.
          49	    /// </summary>
          50	    /// <param name="molecule">Target molecule.</param>
          51	    /// <returns>Complete SpectroscopyPrediction record.</returns>
          52	    public static SpectroscopyPrediction Predict(Molecule molecule)
          53	    {
          54	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(molecule);
          55
          56	        var h1Peaks = PredictH1Nmr(molecule);
          57	        var c13Peaks = PredictC13Nmr(molecule);
          58	        var irBands = PredictIr(molecule);
          59
          60	        return new SpectroscopyPrediction(molecule.ChemicalFormula, h1Peaks, c13Peaks, irBands);
          61	    }

          63	    /// <summary>
          64	    /// Predicts 1H-NMR chemical shifts across all organic proton environments.
          65	    /// </summary>
          66	    private static List<NmrPeak> PredictH1Nmr(Molecule molecule)
          67	    {
          68	        var peaks = new List<NmrPeak>();
          69	        int totalH = molecule.Atoms.Count(a => a.Element.Symbol == "H");
          70
          71	        if (totalH == 0) return peaks;
          72
          73	        // Inorganic molecules
          74	        if (molecule.ChemicalFormula == "H2O")
          75	        {
          76	            peaks.Add(new NmrPeak(4.79, "1H", "Singlet (Exchangeable)", 2, "H2O Water proton resonance peak"));
          77	            return peaks;
          78	        }
          79	        if (molecule.ChemicalFormula == "NH3")
          80	        {
          81	            peaks.Add(new NmrPeak(0.65, "1H", "Broad Singlet", 3, "NH3 Ammonia proton resonance peak"));
          82	            return peaks;
          83	        }
          84
          85	        var fgs = molecule.GetFunctionalGroups().Select(f => f.ToString()).ToHashSet(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
          86
          87	        // 1. Carboxylic Acid (-COOH, δ 10.5 - 12.5 ppm)
          88	        if (fgs.Contains("CarboxylicAcid"))
          89	        {
          90	            peaks.Add(new NmrPeak(11.5, "1H", "Singlet", 1, "-COOH Carboxylic Acid acidic proton"));
          91	        }
          92
          93	        // 2. Aldehyde (-CHO, δ 9.5 - 10.0 ppm)
          94	        if (fgs.Contains("Aldehyde"))
          95	        {
          96	            peaks.Add(new NmrPeak(9.7, "1H", "Singlet", 1, "-CHO Formyl Aldehyde proton"));
          97	        }
          98
          99	        // 3. Aromatic Protons (Ar-H, δ 6.5 - 8.5 ppm)
         100	        if (fgs.Contains("Aromatic"))
         101	        {
         102	            int aromaticH = Math.Min(totalH - peaks.Sum(p => p.HydrogenCount), 5);
         103	            if (aromaticH > 0)
         104	                peaks.Add(new NmrPeak(7.25, "1H", "Multiplet", aromaticH, "Ar-H Aromatic Benzene Ring protons"));
         105	        }
         106
         107	        // 4. Alkene Protons (=C-H, δ 4.5 - 6.5 ppm)
         108	        if (fgs.Contains("Alkene"))
         109	        {
         110	            int alkeneH = Math.Min(totalH - peaks.Sum(p => p.HydrogenCount), 2);
         111	            if (alkeneH > 0)
         112	                peaks.Add(new NmrPeak(5.3, "1H", "Multiplet (Gem/Cis/Trans Coupling)", alkeneH, "=C-H Vinylic Alkene protons"));
         113	        }
         114
         115	        // 5. Ester Protons (-C(=O)O-CH3/CH2, δ 3.7 - 4.2 ppm)
         116	        if (fgs.Contains("Ester"))
         117	        {
         118	            peaks.Add(new NmrPeak(3.8, "1H", "Singlet", 3, "-COOCH3 Ester Methoxy protons"));
         119	        }
         120
         121	        // 6. Ether / Alcohol Protons (-O-CH / -OH, δ 3.3 - 3.8 ppm)
         122	        if (fgs.Contains("Alcohol"))
         123	        {
         124	            peaks.Add(new NmrPeak(3.5, "1H", "Singlet (Exchangeable)", 1, "-OH Alcohol hydroxyl proton"));
         125	        }
         126	        else if (fgs.Contains("Ether"))
         127	        {
         128	            peaks.Add(new NmrPeak(3.4, "1H", "Triplet", 2, "-O-CH2- Ether alpha-protons"));
         129	        }
         130
         131	        // 7. Amine / Amide Protons (-NH2 / -CONH-, δ 1.5 - 4.0 ppm)
         132	        if (fgs.Contains("Amine") || fgs.Contains("Amide"))
         133	        {
         134	            peaks.Add(new NmrPeak(2.0, "1H", "Broad Singlet", 2, "-NH2 / -NH- Nitrogen protons"));
         135	        }
         136
         137	        // 8. Alkyne Protons (≡C-H, δ 1.8 - 3.0 ppm)
         138	        if (fgs.Contains("Alkyne"))
         139	        {
         140	            peaks.Add(new NmrPeak(2.4, "1H", "Singlet", 1, "≡C-H Terminal Alkyne proton"));
         141	        }
         142
         143	        // 9. Ketone Alpha-Protons (-C(=O)-CH3, δ 2.1 - 2.6 ppm)
         144	        if (fgs.Contains("Ketone"))
         145	        {
         146	            peaks.Add(new NmrPeak(2.15, "1H", "Singlet", 3, "-C(=O)CH3 Ketone alpha-methyl protons"));
         147	        }
         148
         149	        // 10. Remaining Aliphatic Protons (-CH3, -CH2-, -CH, δ 0.8 - 1.8 ppm)
         150	        int remainingH = totalH - peaks.Sum(p => p.HydrogenCount);
         151	        if (remainingH > 0)
         152	        {
         153	            peaks.Add(new NmrPeak(1.15, "1H", remainingH >= 3 ? "Triplet" : "Multiplet", remainingH, "Aliphatic Alkane -CH2-/-CH3 protons"));
         154	        }
         155
         156	        return peaks;
         157	    }

         159	    /// <summary>
         160	    /// Predicts 13C-NMR chemical shifts based on hybridization and inductive effects.
         161	    /// </summary>
         162	    private static List<NmrPeak> PredictC13Nmr(Molecule molecule)
         163	    {
         164	        var peaks = new List<NmrPeak>();
         165	        int carbonCount = molecule.Atoms.Count(a => a.Element.Symbol == "C");
         166
         167	        if (carbonCount == 0) return peaks;
         168
         169	        var fgs = molecule.GetFunctionalGroups().Select(f => f.ToString()).ToHashSet(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
         170
         171	        // 1. Carbonyl Carbons (C=O, δ 165 - 215 ppm)
         172	        if (fgs.Contains("CarboxylicAcid") || fgs.Contains("Ester") || fgs.Contains("Amide"))
         173	        {
         174	            peaks.Add(new NmrPeak(172.0, "13C", "Singlet", 1, "C=O Carboxylic Acid / Ester / Amide Carbon"));
         175	        }
         176	        else if (fgs.Contains("Ketone") || fgs.Contains("Aldehyde"))
         177	        {
         178	            peaks.Add(new NmrPeak(205.0, "13C", "Singlet", 1, "C=O Ketone / Aldehyde Carbon"));
         179	        }
         180
         181	        // 2. Aromatic Carbons (Ar-C, δ 115 - 150 ppm)
         182	        if (fgs.Contains("Aromatic"))
         183	        {
         184	            int arC = Math.Min(carbonCount, 6);
         185	            peaks.Add(new NmrPeak(128.5, "13C", "Singlet", arC, "Ar-C Aromatic sp2 Carbons"));
         186	        }
         187
         188	        // 3. Alkene Carbons (C=C, δ 100 - 145 ppm)
         189	        if (fgs.Contains("Alkene"))
         190	        {
         191	            peaks.Add(new NmrPeak(122.0, "13C", "Singlet", 2, "C=C Olefinic sp2 Carbons"));
         192	        }
         193
         194	        // 4. Alkyne Carbons (C≡C, δ 70 - 90 ppm)
         195	        if (fgs.Contains("Alkyne"))
         196	        {
         197	            peaks.Add(new NmrPeak(82.0, "13C", "Singlet", 2, "C≡C Acetylenic sp Carbons"));
         198	        }
         199
         200	        // 5. Heteroatom-attached Carbons (C-O, C-N, δ 45 - 80 ppm)
         201	        if (fgs.Contains("Alcohol") || fgs.Contains("Ether") || fgs.Contains("Ester") || fgs.Contains("Amine"))
         202	        {
         203	            peaks.Add(new NmrPeak(62.0, "13C", "Singlet", 1, "C-O / C-N Heteroatom-attached sp3 Carbon"));
         204	        }
         205
         206	        // 6. Nitrile Carbons (C≡N, δ 115 - 125 ppm)
         207	        if (fgs.Contains("Nitrile"))
         208	        {
         209	            peaks.Add(new NmrPeak(118.0, "13C", "Singlet", 1, "C≡N Nitrile Carbon"));
         210	        }
         211
         212	        // 7. Remaining Aliphatic Carbons (δ 10 - 45 ppm)
         213	        int remainingC = carbonCount - peaks.Sum(p => p.IntegrationCount);
         214	        if (remainingC > 0)
         215	        {
         216	            peaks.Add(new NmrPeak(24.5, "13C", "Singlet", remainingC, "Aliphatic Alkane sp3 Carbons"));
         217	        }
         218
         219	        return peaks;
         220	    }

         222	    /// <summary>
         223	    /// Predicts Infrared (IR) absorption band frequencies based on bond force constants and dipole moments.
         224	    /// </summary>
         225	    private static List<IrBand> PredictIr(Molecule molecule)
         226	    {
         227	        var bands = new List<IrBand>();
         228	        var fgs = molecule.GetFunctionalGroups().Select(f => f.ToString()).ToHashSet(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
         229
         230	        // Inorganic / Special pure cases
         231	        if (molecule.ChemicalFormula == "H2O")
         232	        {
         233	            bands.Add(new IrBand(3350.0, "Water", "Strong, Broad", "O-H Symmetric & Asymmetric Stretch"));
         234	            bands.Add(new IrBand(1630.0, "Water", "Medium", "H-O-H Scissoring Bending Mode"));
         235	            return bands;
         236	        }
         237
         238	        if (molecule.ChemicalFormula == "CO2")
         239	        {
         240	            bands.Add(new IrBand(2349.0, "Carbon Dioxide", "Very Strong", "O=C=O Asymmetric Stretch"));
         241	            bands.Add(new IrBand(667.0, "Carbon Dioxide", "Strong", "O=C=O Degenerate Bending Mode"));
         242	            return bands;
         243	        }
         244
         245	        // Aliphatic C-H stretch (only if molecule contains aliphatic C-H bonds)
         246	        bool hasAliphaticCH = molecule.Bonds.Any(b => b.Type == BondType.Single &&
         247	            ((molecule.Atoms[b.Atom1Index].Element.Symbol == "C" && molecule.Atoms[b.Atom2Index].Element.Symbol == "H") ||
         248	             (molecule.Atoms[b.Atom1Index].Element.Symbol == "H" && molecule.Atoms[b.Atom2Index].Element.Symbol == "C")));
         249
         250	        if (hasAliphaticCH)
         251	        {
         252	            bands.Add(new IrBand(2950.0, "Alkanes", "Strong", "C-H sp3 Stretch"));
         253	        }
         254
         255	        if (fgs.Contains("CarboxylicAcid"))
         256	        {
         257	            bands.Add(new IrBand(1710.0, "Carboxylic Acid", "Strong", "C=O Carbonyl Stretch"));
         258	            bands.Add(new IrBand(3000.0, "Carboxylic Acid", "Strong, Broad", "O-H Carboxyl Stretch"));
         259	        }
         260
         261	        if (fgs.Contains("Ester"))
         262	        {
         263	            bands.Add(new IrBand(1735.0, "Ester", "Strong", "C=O Ester Carbonyl Stretch"));
         264	            bands.Add(new IrBand(1200.0, "Ester", "Strong", "C-O Ester Stretch"));
         265	        }
         266
         267	        if (fgs.Contains("Alcohol"))
         268	        {
         269	            bands.Add(new IrBand(3350.0, "Alcohol", "Strong, Broad", "O-H Hydroxyl Stretch"));
         270	            bands.Add(new IrBand(1050.0, "Alcohol", "Strong", "C-O Alcohol Stretch"));
         271	        }
         272
         273	        if (fgs.Contains("Aromatic"))
         274	        {
         275	            bands.Add(new IrBand(1600.0, "Aromatic Ring", "Medium", "C=C Aromatic Ring Stretch"));
         276	            bands.Add(new IrBand(3030.0, "Aromatic C-H", "Medium", "C-H sp2 Aromatic Stretch"));
         277	        }
         278
         279	        if (fgs.Contains("Amine") || fgs.Contains("Amide"))
         280	        {
         281	            bands.Add(new IrBand(3300.0, "Amine / Amide", "Medium", "N-H Stretch"));
         282	            if (fgs.Contains("Amide"))
         283	            {
         284	                bands.Add(new IrBand(1650.0, "Amide", "Strong", "C=O Amide I Band"));
         285	            }
         286	        }
         287
         288	        if (fgs.Contains("Aldehyde") || fgs.Contains("Ketone"))
         289	        {
         290	            bands.Add(new IrBand(1715.0, "Carbonyl", "Strong", "C=O Ketone / Aldehyde Stretch"));
         291	            if (fgs.Contains("Aldehyde"))
         292	            {
         293	                bands.Add(new IrBand(2820.0, "Aldehyde", "Medium (Fermi Doublet)", "C-H Aldehyde C-H Stretch"));
         294	            }
         295	        }
         296
         297	        if (fgs.Contains("Alkene"))
         298	        {
         299	            bands.Add(new IrBand(1640.0, "Alkene", "Medium", "C=C Alkene Stretch"));
         300	        }
         301
         302	        if (fgs.Contains("Alkyne"))
         303	        {
         304	            bands.Add(new IrBand(2150.0, "Alkyne", "Medium / Sharp", "C≡C Triple Bond Stretch"));
         305	        }
         306
         307	        if (fgs.Contains("Nitrile"))
         308	        {
         309	            bands.Add(new IrBand(2250.0, "Nitrile", "Medium / Sharp", "C≡N Nitrile Stretch"));
         310	        }
         311
         312	        if (fgs.Contains("Nitro"))
         313	        {
         314	            bands.Add(new IrBand(1530.0, "Nitro Group", "Strong", "N-O Asymmetric Stretch"));
         315	            bands.Add(new IrBand(1350.0, "Nitro Group", "Strong", "N-O Symmetric Stretch"));
         316	        }
         317
         318	        return bands;
         319	    }
         320	}

          25	/// <summary>
          26	/// Represents a molecule positioned in 3D Euclidean space with VSEPR geometry classification,
          27	/// ideal bond angles, and Cartesian coordinate exporters (.xyz and .pdb).
          28	/// </summary>
          29	/// <param name="Name">Molecular name.</param>
          30	/// <param name="ChemicalFormula">Chemical formula.</param>
          31	/// <param name="VseprShape">VSEPR geometry name (e.g. Linear, Tetrahedral, Octahedral).</param>
          32	/// <param name="IdealBondAngleDegrees">Ideal valence bond angle in degrees (°).</param>
          33	/// <param name="Atoms">List of atoms with assigned 3D Cartesian coordinates.</param>
          34	/// <param name="SourceMolecule">Original 2D/topological Molecule instance.</param>
          35	public record Molecule3D(
          36	    string Name,
          37	    string ChemicalFormula,
          38	    string VseprShape,
          39	    double IdealBondAngleDegrees,
          40	    IReadOnlyList<Atom3D> Atoms,
          41	    Molecule SourceMolecule
          42	)
          43	{
          44	    /// <summary>
          45	    /// Exports the 3D molecular structure in standard .xyz Cartesian coordinate format.
          46	    /// </summary>
          47	    /// <returns>.xyz file content as a string.</returns>
          48	    public string ToXyz()
          49	    {
          50	        var sb = new StringBuilder();
          51	        sb.AppendLine(Atoms.Count.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
          52	        sb.AppendLine($"{Name} ({ChemicalFormula}) - VSEPR: {VseprShape}");
          53	        foreach (var a in Atoms)
          54	        {
          55	            sb.AppendLine(string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0,-3} {1,10:F4} {2,10:F4} {3,10:F4}", a.Atom.Element.Symbol, a.Position.X, a.Position.Y, a.Position.Z));
          56	        }
          57	        return sb.ToString();
          58	    }
          59
          60	    /// <summary>
          61	    /// Exports the 3D molecular structure in standard Protein Data Bank (.pdb) format with HETATM and CONECT records.
          62	    /// </summary>
          63	    /// <returns>.pdb file content as a string.</returns>
          64	    public string ToPdb()
          65	    {
          66	        var sb = new StringBuilder();
          67	        sb.AppendLine($"HEADER    {Name.ToUpperInvariant()}");
          68	        sb.AppendLine($"COMPND    {ChemicalFormula}");
          69
          70	        for (int i = 0; i < Atoms.Count; i++)
          71	        {
          72	            var a = Atoms[i];
          73	            string atomName = a.Atom.Element.Symbol.Length == 1 ? $" {a.Atom.Element.Symbol}  " : $"{a.Atom.Element.Symbol,-4}";
          74	            string elemSymbol = $"{a.Atom.Element.Symbol,2}";
          75
          76	            sb.AppendLine(string.Format(
          77	                CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
          78	                "HETATM{0,5} {1} MOL A   1    {2,8:F3}{3,8:F3}{4,8:F3}  1.00  0.00          {5}",
          79	                i + 1,
          80	                atomName,
          81	                a.Position.X,
          82	                a.Position.Y,
          83	                a.Position.Z,
          84	                elemSymbol
          85	            ));
          86	        }
          87
          88	        // Add CONECT records for explicit bond connectivity
          89	        for (int i = 0; i < Atoms.Count; i++)
          90	        {
          91	            var connected = SourceMolecule.Bonds
          92	                .Where(b => b.Connects(i))
          93	                .Select(b => b.Atom1Index == i ? b.Atom2Index + 1 : b.Atom1Index + 1)
          94	                .Distinct()
          95	                .ToList();
          96
          97	            if (connected.Count > 0)
          98	            {
          99	                sb.AppendLine($"CONECT{i + 1,5}{string.Join("", connected.Select(idx => $"{idx,5}"))}");
         100	            }
         101	        }
         102
         103	        sb.AppendLine("END");
         104	        return sb.ToString();
         105	    }
         106	}

         108	/// <summary>
         109	/// 3D Spatial Geometry Engine.
         110	/// Computes 3D Cartesian coordinates based on Valence Shell Electron Pair Repulsion (VSEPR) theory
         111	/// and steric number calculations. Supports 8 fundamental geometric shapes: Linear, Bent, Trigonal Planar,
         112	/// Trigonal Pyramidal, Tetrahedral, Square Planar, Trigonal Bipyramidal, and Octahedral.
         113	/// </summary>
         114	public static class Geometry3DEngine
         115	{
         116	    /// <summary>
         117	    /// Generates 3D Cartesian coordinates for a molecule.
         118	    /// </summary>
         119	    /// <param name="molecule">Input molecule.</param>
         120	    /// <param name="overrideShape">Optional VSEPR shape override (e.g. "Linear", "Tetrahedral").</param>
         121	    /// <returns>Molecule3D with assigned atomic Cartesian positions.</returns>
         122	    public static Molecule3D Generate3D(Molecule molecule, string? overrideShape = null)
         123	    {
         124	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(molecule);
         125
         126	        // Case 1: Monatomic species
         127	        if (molecule.Atoms.Count <= 1)
         128	        {
         129	            var singleAtomList = molecule.Atoms.Select(a => new Atom3D(a, new Vector3D(0, 0, 0))).ToList();
         130	            return new Molecule3D(molecule.Name, molecule.ChemicalFormula, "Monatomic", 0.0, singleAtomList, molecule);
         131	        }
         132
         133	        // Case 2: Diatomic species (Linear, 180°)
         134	        if (molecule.Atoms.Count == 2)
         135	        {
         136	            var diatomicList = new List<Atom3D>
         137	            {
         138	                new(molecule.Atoms[0], new Vector3D(-0.6, 0, 0)),
         139	                new(molecule.Atoms[1], new Vector3D(0.6, 0, 0))
         140	            };
         141	            return new Molecule3D(molecule.Name, molecule.ChemicalFormula, "Linear", 180.0, diatomicList, molecule);
         142	        }
         143
         144	        // Case 3: Single-center small polyatomic species vs Multi-center organic molecule
         145	        int heavyAtomCount = molecule.Atoms.Count(a => a.Element.Symbol != "H");
         146	        bool isAuto = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(overrideShape) || overrideShape.Equals("Auto", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
         147
         148	        if (heavyAtomCount > 1 && isAuto)
         149	        {
         150	            return GenerateMultiCenter3D(molecule);
         151	        }
         152
         153	        var centerAtom = molecule.Atoms.FirstOrDefault(a => a.Element.Symbol != "H") ?? molecule.Atoms[0];
         154	        int centerIndex = molecule.Atoms.IndexOf(centerAtom);
         155
         156	        var outerAtoms = molecule.Atoms.Where((_, idx) => idx != centerIndex).ToList();
         157	        int n = outerAtoms.Count;
         158
         159	        string shape;
         160	        double angle;
         161	        var positions = new List<Vector3D> { new(0, 0, 0) };
         162
         163	        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(overrideShape) && overrideShape != "Auto")
         164	        {
         165	            shape = overrideShape;
         166	            (angle, positions) = CalculatePositionsForShape(overrideShape, n);
         167	        }
         168	        else
         169	        {
         170	            if (n == 2)
         171	            {
         172	                if (centerAtom.Element.Symbol is "O" or "S")
         173	                {
         174	                    shape = "Bent";
         175	                    angle = 104.5;
         176	                    double rad = (180.0 - angle) * Math.PI / 360.0;
         177	                    positions.Add(new Vector3D(-Math.Cos(rad) * 0.96, -Math.Sin(rad) * 0.96, 0));
         178	                    positions.Add(new Vector3D(Math.Cos(rad) * 0.96, -Math.Sin(rad) * 0.96, 0));
         179	                }
         180	                else
         181	                {
         182	                    shape = "Linear";
         183	                    angle = 180.0;
         184	                    positions.Add(new Vector3D(-1.1, 0, 0));
         185	                    positions.Add(new Vector3D(1.1, 0, 0));
         186	                }
         187	            }
         188	            else if (n == 3)
         189	            {
         190	                if (centerAtom.Element.Symbol is "N" or "P")
         191	                {
         192	                    shape = "Trigonal Pyramidal";
         193	                    angle = 107.0;
         194	                    positions.Add(new Vector3D(0, 0.94, -0.35));
         195	                    positions.Add(new Vector3D(-0.81, -0.47, -0.35));
         196	                    positions.Add(new Vector3D(0.81, -0.47, -0.35));
         197	                }
         198	                else
         199	                {
         200	                    shape = "Trigonal Planar";
         201	                    angle = 120.0;
         202	                    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
         203	                    {
         204	                        double aRad = i * 2.0 * Math.PI / 3.0;
         205	                        positions.Add(new Vector3D(Math.Cos(aRad), Math.Sin(aRad), 0));
         206	                    }
         207	                }
         208	            }
         209	            else if (n == 4)
         210	            {
         211	                shape = "Tetrahedral";
         212	                angle = 109.5;
         213	                positions.Add(new Vector3D(0, 1.0, 0));
         214	                positions.Add(new Vector3D(0.943, -0.333, 0));
         215	                positions.Add(new Vector3D(-0.471, -0.333, 0.816));
         216	                positions.Add(new Vector3D(-0.471, -0.333, -0.816));
         217	            }
         218	            else if (n == 5)
         219	            {
         220	                shape = "Trigonal Bipyramidal";
         221	                angle = 90.0;
         222	                positions.Add(new Vector3D(0, 1.1, 0));
         223	                positions.Add(new Vector3D(0, -1.1, 0));
         224	                positions.Add(new Vector3D(1.0, 0, 0));
         225	                positions.Add(new Vector3D(-0.5, 0, 0.866));
         226	                positions.Add(new Vector3D(-0.5, 0, -0.866));
         227	            }
         228	            else
         229	            {
         230	                shape = "Octahedral";
         231	                angle = 90.0;
         232	                positions.Add(new Vector3D(0, 1.1, 0));
         233	                positions.Add(new Vector3D(0, -1.1, 0));
         234	                positions.Add(new Vector3D(1.1, 0, 0));
         235	                positions.Add(new Vector3D(-1.1, 0, 0));
         236	                positions.Add(new Vector3D(0, 0, 1.1));
         237	                positions.Add(new Vector3D(0, 0, -1.1));
         238
         239	                for (int i = 6; i < n; i++)
         240	                {
         241	                    positions.Add(new Vector3D((i % 2 == 0 ? 1 : -1) * 0.8, -0.8, (i % 3 == 0 ? 1 : -1) * 0.8));
         242	                }
         243	            }
         244	        }
         245
         246	        var outerAtomIndices = molecule.Atoms.Select((atom, idx) => (atom, idx)).Where(x => x.idx != centerIndex).ToList();
         247
         248	        var atom3DArray = new Atom3D[molecule.Atoms.Count];
         249	        atom3DArray[centerIndex] = new Atom3D(centerAtom, positions[0]);
         250
         251	        for (int i = 0; i < outerAtomIndices.Count; i++)
         252	        {
         253	            var pos = (i + 1 < positions.Count) ? positions[i + 1] : new Vector3D((i % 2 == 0 ? 1 : -1) * 0.8, -0.8, (i % 3 == 0 ? 1 : -1) * 0.8);
         254	            int origIdx = outerAtomIndices[i].idx;
         255	            atom3DArray[origIdx] = new Atom3D(outerAtomIndices[i].atom, pos);
         256	        }
         257
         258	        var unoptimized = new Molecule3D(molecule.Name, molecule.ChemicalFormula, shape, angle, atom3DArray, molecule);
         259	        return Physics.ForceFieldEngine.MinimizeEnergy(unoptimized, 80).MinimizedMolecule;
         260	    }
         261
         262	    /// <summary>
         263	    /// Embeds realistic, energy-minimized 3D coordinates for arbitrary branched, cyclic, or polycyclic organic molecules
         264	    /// using ring-scaffold template embedding, valence-directed tetrahedral branching, and Universal Force Field (UFF) relaxation.
         265	    /// </summary>
         266	    private static Molecule3D GenerateMultiCenter3D(Molecule molecule)
         267	    {
         268	        int nAtoms = molecule.Atoms.Count;
         269	        var coords = new Vector3D?[nAtoms];
         270	        var visited = new HashSet<int>();
         271	        var queue = new Queue<int>();
         272	        var parentDirections = new Dictionary<int, Vector3D>();
         273
         274	        // 1. Detect cyclic scaffolds in the molecular graph
         275	        var graph = Chemy.Core.Graph.ChemicalGraph.FromMolecule(molecule);
         276	        var rings = graph.FindRings();
         277
         278	        if (rings.Count > 0)
         279	        {
         280	            // Embed the primary ring scaffold centered at (0, 0, 0) in the XY plane
         281	            var primaryRing = rings.OrderByDescending(r => r.Count).First();
         282	            int ringSize = primaryRing.Count;
         283	            double bondLength = ringSize == 6 ? 1.395 : 1.40; // Aromatic C-C vs conjugated ring bond length
         284	            double radius = bondLength / (2.0 * Math.Sin(Math.PI / ringSize));
         285
         286	            for (int k = 0; k < ringSize; k++)
         287	            {
         288	                int atomIdx = primaryRing[k];
         289	                // Start along X axis and rotate counter-clockwise
         290	                double theta = 2.0 * Math.PI * k / ringSize;
         291	                var ringPos = new Vector3D(
         292	                    Math.Round(radius * Math.Cos(theta), 4),
         293	                    Math.Round(radius * Math.Sin(theta), 4),
         294	                    0.0
         295	                );
         296	                coords[atomIdx] = ringPos;
         297	                visited.Add(atomIdx);
         298
         299	                // Radial outward vector for substituent attachment
         300	                var radialDir = Normalize(ringPos);
         301	                parentDirections[atomIdx] = radialDir;
         302	                queue.Enqueue(atomIdx);
         303	            }
         304	        }
         305	        else
         306	        {
         307	            // Acyclic: Find root heavy atom with maximum connectivity
         308	            int rootIndex = 0;
         309	            int maxDegree = -1;
         310	            for (int i = 0; i < nAtoms; i++)
         311	            {
         312	                if (molecule.Atoms[i].Element.Symbol != "H")
         313	                {
         314	                    int deg = molecule.Bonds.Count(b => b.Connects(i));
         315	                    if (deg > maxDegree)
         316	                    {
         317	                        maxDegree = deg;
         318	                        rootIndex = i;
         319	                    }
         320	                }
         321	            }
         322
         323	            coords[rootIndex] = new Vector3D(0, 0, 0);
         324	            visited.Add(rootIndex);
         325	            parentDirections[rootIndex] = new Vector3D(1, 0, 0);
         326	            queue.Enqueue(rootIndex);
         327	        }
         328
         329	        // 2. Propagate substituents, aliphatic branches, and functional groups via valence geometry
         330	        while (queue.Count > 0)
         331	        {
         332	            int current = queue.Dequeue();
         333	            var currentPos = coords[current]!;
         334	            var refDir = parentDirections.TryGetValue(current, out var pd) ? pd : new Vector3D(1, 0, 0);
         335
         336	            var unplacedNeighbors = molecule.Bonds
         337	                .Where(b => b.Connects(current))
         338	                .Select(b => b.Atom1Index == current ? b.Atom2Index : b.Atom1Index)
         339	                .Where(nbr => !visited.Contains(nbr))
         340	                .ToList();
         341
         342	            var heavyNeighbors = unplacedNeighbors.Where(n => molecule.Atoms[n].Element.Symbol != "H").ToList();
         343	            var hNeighbors = unplacedNeighbors.Where(n => molecule.Atoms[n].Element.Symbol == "H").ToList();
         344
         345	            var ortho1 = GetOrthogonalVector(refDir);
         346	            var ortho2 = Normalize(Cross(refDir, ortho1));
         347
         348	            // Place heavy substituent neighbors with tetrahedral (109.5°) / trigonal (120°) geometry
         349	            int numHeavy = heavyNeighbors.Count;
         350	            for (int j = 0; j < numHeavy; j++)
         351	            {
         352	                int neighbor = heavyNeighbors[j];
         353	                double bondLen = 1.51; // Standard C-C / C-O single bond length
         354
         355	                Vector3D outDir;
         356	                if (numHeavy == 1)
         357	                {
         358	                    // Linear chain continuation: tetrahedral bend (109.5°) alternating torsion
         359	                    double bendAngle = (180.0 - 109.5) * Math.PI / 180.0;
         360	                    double torsion = (current % 2 == 0) ? 0.0 : Math.PI;
         361	                    outDir = Normalize(new Vector3D(
         362	                        Math.Cos(bendAngle) * refDir.X + Math.Sin(bendAngle) * (Math.Cos(torsion) * ortho1.X + Math.Sin(torsion) * ortho2.X),
         363	                        Math.Cos(bendAngle) * refDir.Y + Math.Sin(bendAngle) * (Math.Cos(torsion) * ortho1.Y + Math.Sin(torsion) * ortho2.Y),
         364	                        Math.Cos(bendAngle) * refDir.Z + Math.Sin(bendAngle) * (Math.Cos(torsion) * ortho1.Z + Math.Sin(torsion) * ortho2.Z)
         365	                    ));
         366	                }
         367	                else if (numHeavy == 2)
         368	                {
         369	                    // Tetrahedral branching (e.g. isopropyl fork or propionic acid branch)
         370	                    double bendAngle = (180.0 - 109.5) * Math.PI / 180.0;
         371	                    double phi = (j == 0) ? (Math.PI / 3.0) : (-Math.PI / 3.0);
         372	                    outDir = Normalize(new Vector3D(
         373	                        Math.Cos(bendAngle) * refDir.X + Math.Sin(bendAngle) * (Math.Cos(phi) * ortho1.X + Math.Sin(phi) * ortho2.X),
         374	                        Math.Cos(bendAngle) * refDir.Y + Math.Sin(bendAngle) * (Math.Cos(phi) * ortho1.Y + Math.Sin(phi) * ortho2.Y),
         375	                        Math.Cos(bendAngle) * refDir.Z + Math.Sin(bendAngle) * (Math.Cos(phi) * ortho1.Z + Math.Sin(phi) * ortho2.Z)
         376	                    ));
         377	                }
         378	                else
         379	                {
         380	                    // Quaternary tripod
         381	                    double coneAngle = 70.5 * Math.PI / 180.0;
         382	                    double rot = j * 2.0 * Math.PI / numHeavy;
         383	                    outDir = Normalize(new Vector3D(
         384	                        Math.Cos(coneAngle) * refDir.X + Math.Sin(coneAngle) * (Math.Cos(rot) * ortho1.X + Math.Sin(rot) * ortho2.X),
         385	                        Math.Cos(coneAngle) * refDir.Y + Math.Sin(coneAngle) * (Math.Cos(rot) * ortho1.Y + Math.Sin(rot) * ortho2.Y),
         386	                        Math.Cos(coneAngle) * refDir.Z + Math.Sin(coneAngle) * (Math.Cos(rot) * ortho1.Z + Math.Sin(rot) * ortho2.Z)
         387	                    ));
         388	                }
         389
         390	                coords[neighbor] = new Vector3D(
         391	                    Math.Round(currentPos.X + outDir.X * bondLen, 4),
         392	                    Math.Round(currentPos.Y + outDir.Y * bondLen, 4),
         393	                    Math.Round(currentPos.Z + outDir.Z * bondLen, 4)
         394	                );
         395
         396	                visited.Add(neighbor);
         397	                parentDirections[neighbor] = outDir;
         398	                queue.Enqueue(neighbor);
         399	            }
         400
         401	            // Place hydrogen atoms symmetrically around the heavy atom
         402	            int numH = hNeighbors.Count;
         403	            for (int h = 0; h < numH; h++)
         404	            {
         405	                int hIdx = hNeighbors[h];
         406	                double hDist = 1.09;
         407	                Vector3D hDir;
         408
         409	                if (numHeavy == 0)
         410	                {
         411	                    // Terminal methyl / methane tripod
         412	                    double coneAngle = 70.5 * Math.PI / 180.0;
         413	                    double rot = h * 2.0 * Math.PI / Math.Max(1, numH);
         414	                    hDir = Normalize(new Vector3D(
         415	                        Math.Cos(coneAngle) * refDir.X + Math.Sin(coneAngle) * (Math.Cos(rot) * ortho1.X + Math.Sin(rot) * ortho2.X),
         416	                        Math.Cos(coneAngle) * refDir.Y + Math.Sin(coneAngle) * (Math.Cos(rot) * ortho1.Y + Math.Sin(rot) * ortho2.Y),
         417	                        Math.Cos(coneAngle) * refDir.Z + Math.Sin(coneAngle) * (Math.Cos(rot) * ortho1.Z + Math.Sin(rot) * ortho2.Z)
         418	                    ));
         419	                }
         420	                else if (numHeavy == 1)
         421	                {
         422	                    // Methylene (-CH2-) or methine: straddle perpendicular to the bond plane
         423	                    double bendAngle = (180.0 - 109.5) * Math.PI / 180.0;
         424	                    double hRot = (h == 0) ? (Math.PI * 2.0 / 3.0) : (-Math.PI * 2.0 / 3.0);
         425	                    hDir = Normalize(new Vector3D(
         426	                        Math.Cos(bendAngle) * refDir.X + Math.Sin(bendAngle) * (Math.Cos(hRot) * ortho1.X + Math.Sin(hRot) * ortho2.X),
         427	                        Math.Cos(bendAngle) * refDir.Y + Math.Sin(bendAngle) * (Math.Cos(hRot) * ortho1.Y + Math.Sin(hRot) * ortho2.Y),
         428	                        Math.Cos(bendAngle) * refDir.Z + Math.Sin(bendAngle) * (Math.Cos(hRot) * ortho1.Z + Math.Sin(hRot) * ortho2.Z)
         429	                    ));
         430	                }
         431	                else
         432	                {
         433	                    // Methine (-CH<) single hydrogen opposite to branches
         434	                    hDir = Normalize(new Vector3D(
         435	                        -refDir.X * 0.5 + ortho2.X * 0.866,
         436	                        -refDir.Y * 0.5 + ortho2.Y * 0.866,
         437	                        -refDir.Z * 0.5 + ortho2.Z * 0.866
         438	                    ));
         439	                }
         440
         441	                coords[hIdx] = new Vector3D(
         442	                    Math.Round(currentPos.X + hDir.X * hDist, 4),
         443	                    Math.Round(currentPos.Y + hDir.Y * hDist, 4),
         444	                    Math.Round(currentPos.Z + hDir.Z * hDist, 4)
         445	                );
         446	                visited.Add(hIdx);
         447	            }
         448	        }
         449
         450	        // Place any remaining unplaced atoms
         451	        for (int i = 0; i < nAtoms; i++)
         452	        {
         453	            if (coords[i] == null)
         454	            {
         455	                coords[i] = new Vector3D(i * 1.2, 0, 0);
         456	            }
         457	        }
         458
         459	        var atom3DList = new List<Atom3D>(nAtoms);
         460	        for (int i = 0; i < nAtoms; i++)
         461	        {
         462	            atom3DList.Add(new Atom3D(molecule.Atoms[i], coords[i]!));
         463	        }
         464
         465	        var unoptimized = new Molecule3D(molecule.Name, molecule.ChemicalFormula, "Conformer", 109.5, atom3DList, molecule);
         466
         467	        // Relax coordinates with Universal Force Field minimization (150 iterations)
         468	        return Physics.ForceFieldEngine.MinimizeEnergy(unoptimized, 150).MinimizedMolecule;
         469	    }
         470
         471	    private static Vector3D GetOrthogonalVector(Vector3D v)
         472	    {
         473	        var other = Math.Abs(v.X) < 0.8 ? new Vector3D(1, 0, 0) : new Vector3D(0, 1, 0);
         474	        return Normalize(Cross(v, other));
         475	    }
         476
         477	    private static Vector3D Cross(Vector3D a, Vector3D b) =>
         478	        new(a.Y * b.Z - a.Z * b.Y, a.Z * b.X - a.X * b.Z, a.X * b.Y - a.Y * b.X);
         479
         480	    private static Vector3D Normalize(Vector3D v)
         481	    {
         482	        double len = Math.Sqrt(v.X * v.X + v.Y * v.Y + v.Z * v.Z);
         483	        return len < 1e-6 ? new Vector3D(0, 1, 0) : new Vector3D(v.X / len, v.Y / len, v.Z / len);
         484	    }
         485
         486	    /// <summary>
         487	    /// Computes spatial coordinates based on an explicit VSEPR geometric shape name.
         488	    /// </summary>
         489	    private static (double Angle, List<Vector3D> Positions) CalculatePositionsForShape(string shape, int outerAtomCount)
         490	    {
         491	        var pos = new List<Vector3D> { new(0, 0, 0) };
         492	        double angle;
         493
         494	        switch (shape)
         495	        {
         496	            case "Linear":
         497	                angle = 180.0;
         498	                pos.Add(new Vector3D(-1.1, 0, 0));
         499	                pos.Add(new Vector3D(1.1, 0, 0));
         500	                break;
         501
         502	            case "Bent":
         503	                angle = 104.5;
         504	                double bentRad = (180.0 - angle) * Math.PI / 360.0;
         505	                pos.Add(new Vector3D(-Math.Cos(bentRad) * 0.96, -Math.Sin(bentRad) * 0.96, 0));
         506	                pos.Add(new Vector3D(Math.Cos(bentRad) * 0.96, -Math.Sin(bentRad) * 0.96, 0));
         507	                break;
         508
         509	            case "Trigonal Planar":
         510	                angle = 120.0;
         511	                for (int i = 0; i < Math.Max(3, outerAtomCount); i++)
         512	                {
         513	                    double aRad = i * 2.0 * Math.PI / 3.0;
         514	                    pos.Add(new Vector3D(Math.Cos(aRad), Math.Sin(aRad), 0));
         515	                }
         516	                break;
         517
         518	            case "Trigonal Pyramidal":
         519	                angle = 107.0;
         520	                pos.Add(new Vector3D(0, 0.94, -0.35));
         521	                pos.Add(new Vector3D(-0.81, -0.47, -0.35));
         522	                pos.Add(new Vector3D(0.81, -0.47, -0.35));
         523	                break;
         524
         525	            case "Square Planar":
         526	                angle = 90.0;
         527	                pos.Add(new Vector3D(1.0, 0, 0));
         528	                pos.Add(new Vector3D(-1.0, 0, 0));
         529	                pos.Add(new Vector3D(0, 1.0, 0));
         530	                pos.Add(new Vector3D(0, -1.0, 0));
         531	                break;
         532
         533	            case "Trigonal Bipyramidal":
         534	                angle = 90.0;
         535	                pos.Add(new Vector3D(0, 1.1, 0));
         536	                pos.Add(new Vector3D(0, -1.1, 0));
         537	                pos.Add(new Vector3D(1.0, 0, 0));
         538	                pos.Add(new Vector3D(-0.5, 0, 0.866));
         539	                pos.Add(new Vector3D(-0.5, 0, -0.866));
         540	                break;
         541
         542	            case "Octahedral":
         543	                angle = 90.0;
         544	                pos.Add(new Vector3D(0, 1.1, 0));
         545	                pos.Add(new Vector3D(0, -1.1, 0));
         546	                pos.Add(new Vector3D(1.1, 0, 0));
         547	                pos.Add(new Vector3D(-1.1, 0, 0));
         548	                pos.Add(new Vector3D(0, 0, 1.1));
         549	                pos.Add(new Vector3D(0, 0, -1.1));
         550	                break;
         551
         552	            case "Tetrahedral":
         553	            default:
         554	                angle = 109.5;
         555	                pos.Add(new Vector3D(0, 1.0, 0));
         556	                pos.Add(new Vector3D(0.943, -0.333, 0));
         557	                pos.Add(new Vector3D(-0.471, -0.333, 0.816));
