         565	    /// <summary>
         566	    /// Generates a planar 2D structural diagram representation of the molecule embedded in 3D space with Z = 0.0.
         567	    /// Provides clear, uncluttered textbook ChemDraw-style layouts (regular polygon rings, 120° angles, zigzag chains)
         568	    /// while retaining full 3D spatial rotation, lighting, and rendering in 3Dmol.js / WebGL.
         569	    /// </summary>
         570	    /// <param name="molecule">Input molecule.</param>
         571	    /// <returns>Molecule3D with all atomic positions having Z = 0.0.</returns>
         572	    public static Molecule3D GeneratePlanar3D(Molecule molecule)
         573	    {
         574	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(molecule);
         575
         576	        int atomCount = molecule.Atoms.Count;
         577	        if (atomCount == 0)
         578	        {
         579	            return new Molecule3D(molecule.Name, molecule.ChemicalFormula, "Planar 2D", 120.0, Array.Empty<Atom3D>(), molecule);
         580	        }
         581
         582	        if (atomCount == 1)
         583	        {
         584	            return new Molecule3D(molecule.Name, molecule.ChemicalFormula, "Planar 2D (Monatomic)", 0.0,
         585	                new List<Atom3D> { new(molecule.Atoms[0], new Vector3D(0, 0, 0)) }, molecule);
         586	        }
         587
         588	        if (atomCount == 2)
         589	        {
         590	            return new Molecule3D(molecule.Name, molecule.ChemicalFormula, "Planar 2D (Linear)", 180.0,
         591	                new List<Atom3D>
         592	                {
         593	                    new(molecule.Atoms[0], new Vector3D(-0.7, 0, 0)),
         594	                    new(molecule.Atoms[1], new Vector3D(0.7, 0, 0))
         595	                }, molecule);
         596	        }
         597
         598	        var coords = new Vector3D[atomCount];
         599	        var placed = new bool[atomCount];
         600
         601	        // 1. Detect rings in the chemical graph
         602	        var graph = Chemy.Core.Graph.ChemicalGraph.FromMolecule(molecule);
         603	        var rings = graph.FindRings();
         604	        var primaryRing = rings.Count > 0 ? rings.OrderByDescending(r => r.Count).First() : new List<int>();
         605
         606	        // If there are rings, place the primary ring first centered at origin
         607	        if (rings.Count > 0)
         608	        {
         609	            int ringSize = primaryRing.Count;
         610	            double radius = 1.40 / (2.0 * Math.Sin(Math.PI / ringSize)); // Regular polygon circumradius with edge ~1.40Å
         611
         612	            for (int k = 0; k < ringSize; k++)
         613	            {
         614	                int atomIdx = primaryRing[k];
         615	                // Start from top and rotate clockwise in XY plane
         616	                double theta = (Math.PI / 2.0) - (2.0 * Math.PI * k / ringSize);
         617	                coords[atomIdx] = new Vector3D(
         618	                    Math.Round(radius * Math.Cos(theta), 4),
         619	                    Math.Round(radius * Math.Sin(theta), 4),
         620	                    0.0
         621	                );
         622	                placed[atomIdx] = true;
         623	            }
         624	        }
         625	        else
         626	        {
         627	            // No rings: Place first heavy atom at (0, 0, 0)
         628	            int firstIdx = 0;
         629	            for (int i = 0; i < atomCount; i++)
         630	            {
         631	                if (molecule.Atoms[i].Element.Symbol != "H") { firstIdx = i; break; }
         632	            }
         633	            coords[firstIdx] = new Vector3D(0, 0, 0);
         634	            placed[firstIdx] = true;
         635	        }
         636
         637	        // 2. Breadth-first layout of remaining heavy atoms in planar zigzag / radial patterns
         638	        var queue = new Queue<int>();
         639	        for (int i = 0; i < atomCount; i++)
         640	        {
         641	            if (placed[i]) queue.Enqueue(i);
         642	        }
         643
         644	        // Keep track of parent directional angles
         645	        var parentAngles = new Dictionary<int, double>();
         646
         647	        while (queue.Count > 0)
         648	        {
         649	            int current = queue.Dequeue();
         650	            var currentPos = coords[current];
         651
         652	            // Get unplaced neighbors
         653	            var neighbors = molecule.Bonds
         654	                .Where(b => b.Connects(current))
         655	                .Select(b => b.Atom1Index == current ? b.Atom2Index : b.Atom1Index)
         656	                .Where(n => !placed[n])
         657	                .ToList();
         658
         659	            var heavyNeighbors = neighbors.Where(n => molecule.Atoms[n].Element.Symbol != "H").ToList();
         660	            var hNeighbors = neighbors.Where(n => molecule.Atoms[n].Element.Symbol == "H").ToList();
         661
         662	            double baseAngle = parentAngles.TryGetValue(current, out var pa) ? pa : 0.0;
         663	            if (rings.Count > 0 && primaryRing.Contains(current))
         664	            {
         665	                // Radiate outward from ring center
         666	                baseAngle = Math.Atan2(currentPos.Y, currentPos.X);
         667	            }
         668
         669	            // Place heavy neighbors at 120° / 60° / zigzag offsets
         670	            for (int j = 0; j < heavyNeighbors.Count; j++)
         671	            {
         672	                int neighbor = heavyNeighbors[j];
         673	                double angleOffset;
         674	                if (heavyNeighbors.Count == 1)
         675	                {
         676	                    // Zigzag alternating +/- 60 degrees from parent orientation for standard 120° angles
         677	                    angleOffset = (current % 2 == 0) ? (Math.PI / 3.0) : (-Math.PI / 3.0);
         678	                }
         679	                else if (heavyNeighbors.Count == 2)
         680	                {
         681	                    // Branching fork (e.g. isopropyl or propionic acid)
         682	                    angleOffset = (j == 0) ? (Math.PI / 3.0) : (-Math.PI / 3.0);
         683	                }
         684	                else
         685	                {
         686	                    double span = Math.PI * 0.8;
         687	                    angleOffset = -span / 2.0 + (span * (j + 0.5) / heavyNeighbors.Count);
         688	                }
         689
         690	                double angle = baseAngle + angleOffset;
         691	                double bondLen = 1.45;
         692
         693	                coords[neighbor] = new Vector3D(
         694	                    Math.Round(currentPos.X + bondLen * Math.Cos(angle), 4),
         695	                    Math.Round(currentPos.Y + bondLen * Math.Sin(angle), 4),
         696	                    0.0
         697	                );
         698	                placed[neighbor] = true;
         699	                parentAngles[neighbor] = angle;
         700	                queue.Enqueue(neighbor);
         701	            }
         702
         703	            // Place hydrogens around parent atom symmetrically on the XY plane
         704	            for (int h = 0; h < hNeighbors.Count; h++)
         705	            {
         706	                int hIdx = hNeighbors[h];
         707	                double hAngle;
         708	                if (heavyNeighbors.Count == 0)
         709	                {
         710	                    hAngle = baseAngle + (2.0 * Math.PI * h / Math.Max(1, hNeighbors.Count));
         711	                }
         712	                else
         713	                {
         714	                    double hSpan = Math.PI * 0.7;
         715	                    hAngle = baseAngle + Math.PI - (hSpan / 2.0) + (hSpan * (h + 0.5) / hNeighbors.Count);
         716	                }
         717
         718	                double hDist = 1.00;
         719	                coords[hIdx] = new Vector3D(
         720	                    Math.Round(currentPos.X + hDist * Math.Cos(hAngle), 4),
         721	                    Math.Round(currentPos.Y + hDist * Math.Sin(hAngle), 4),
         722	                    0.0
         723	                );
         724	                placed[hIdx] = true;
         725	            }
         726	        }
         727
         728	        // Place any remaining unplaced disconnected atoms
         729	        for (int i = 0; i < atomCount; i++)
         730	        {
         731	            if (!placed[i])
         732	            {
         733	                coords[i] = new Vector3D(i * 1.5, 0, 0);
         734	                placed[i] = true;
         735	            }
         736	        }
         737
         738	        // 3. Center planar coordinates at centroid (0, 0, 0)
         739	        double cx = coords.Average(p => p.X);
         740	        double cy = coords.Average(p => p.Y);
         741
         742	        var atom3dList = new List<Atom3D>(atomCount);
         743	        for (int i = 0; i < atomCount; i++)
         744	        {
         745	            atom3dList.Add(new Atom3D(
         746	                molecule.Atoms[i],
         747	                new Vector3D(
         748	                    Math.Round(coords[i].X - cx, 4),
         749	                    Math.Round(coords[i].Y - cy, 4),
         750	                    0.0
         751	                )
         752	            ));
         753	        }
         754
         755	        return new Molecule3D(
         756	            molecule.Name,
         757	            molecule.ChemicalFormula,
         758	            "Planar 2D (ChemDraw Style)",
         759	            120.0,
         760	            atom3dList,
         761	            molecule
         762	        );
         763	    }
         764	}

          26	/// <summary>

          30	public class ChemicalGraph
          31	{
          32	    private readonly ImmutableList<GraphNode> _nodes;
          33	    private readonly ImmutableList<GraphEdge> _edges;
          34	    private readonly ImmutableDictionary<int, ImmutableList<GraphEdge>> _adjacency;

          48	    /// <summary>
          49	    /// Constructs an immutable ChemicalGraph instance from nodes and edges.
          50	    /// </summary>
          51	    public ChemicalGraph(IEnumerable<GraphNode> nodes, IEnumerable<GraphEdge> edges)
          52	    {
          53	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(nodes);
          54	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(edges);
          55
          56	        _nodes = nodes.ToImmutableList();
          57	        _edges = edges.ToImmutableList();
          58
          59	        var adjBuilder = new Dictionary<int, List<GraphEdge>>();
          60	        foreach (var node in _nodes)
          61	        {
          62	            adjBuilder[node.Id] = new List<GraphEdge>();
          63	        }
          64
          65	        foreach (var edge in _edges)
          66	        {
          67	            if (adjBuilder.TryGetValue(edge.SourceId, out var srcList))
          68	                srcList.Add(edge);
          69
          70	            if (adjBuilder.TryGetValue(edge.TargetId, out var tgtList))
          71	                tgtList.Add(edge);
          72	        }
          73
          74	        _adjacency = adjBuilder.ToImmutableDictionary(k => k.Key, v => v.Value.ToImmutableList());
          75	    }

         100	        GetIncidentEdges(nodeId).Select(e => e.Other(nodeId)).ToList();

         106
         107	    /// <summary>
         108	    /// Detects all fundamental cycles (rings) in the molecular graph using Depth-First Search (DFS).
         109	    /// </summary>
         110	    public IReadOnlyList<IReadOnlyList<int>> FindRings()
         111	    {
         112	        var rings = new List<IReadOnlyList<int>>();
         113	        var visited = new HashSet<int>();
         114	        var parent = new Dictionary<int, int>();
         115	        var stack = new List<int>();
         116
         117	        foreach (var node in _nodes)
         118	        {
         119	            if (!visited.Contains(node.Id))
         120	            {
         121	                DfsCycle(node.Id, -1, visited, parent, stack, rings);
         122	            }
         123	        }
         124
         125	        return rings;
         126	    }
         127
         128	    private void DfsCycle(int current, int p, HashSet<int> visited, Dictionary<int, int> parent, List<int> stack, List<IReadOnlyList<int>> rings)
         129	    {
         130	        visited.Add(current);
         131	        parent[current] = p;
         132	        stack.Add(current);
         133
         134	        foreach (var neighbor in GetNeighbors(current))
         135	        {
         136	            if (neighbor == p) continue;
         137
         138	            if (stack.Contains(neighbor))
         139	            {
         140	                // Found back-edge, extract cycle
         141	                int startIndex = stack.IndexOf(neighbor);
         142	                var cycle = stack.Skip(startIndex).ToList();
         143	                if (cycle.Count >= 3)
         144	                {
         145	                    // Avoid duplicate permutations of the same cycle
         146	                    var normalized = NormalizeCycle(cycle);
         147	                    if (!rings.Any(r => AreCyclesEqual(r, normalized)))
         148	                    {
         149	                        rings.Add(normalized);
         150	                    }
         151	                }
         152	            }
         153	            else if (!visited.Contains(neighbor))
         154	            {
         155	                DfsCycle(neighbor, current, visited, parent, stack, rings);
         156	            }
         157	        }
         158
         159	        stack.RemoveAt(stack.Count - 1);
         160	    }
         161
         162	    private static List<int> NormalizeCycle(List<int> cycle)
         163	    {
         164	        int minVal = cycle.Min();
         165	        int minIdx = cycle.IndexOf(minVal);
         166	        var rotated = cycle.Skip(minIdx).Concat(cycle.Take(minIdx)).ToList();
         167	        return rotated;
         168	    }
         169
         170	    private static bool AreCyclesEqual(IReadOnlyList<int> c1, IReadOnlyList<int> c2)
         171	    {
         172	        if (c1.Count != c2.Count) return false;
         173	        return c1.SequenceEqual(c2) || c1.SequenceEqual(c2.Reverse());
         174	    }
         175	}

          53	    /// <summary>
          54	    /// Searches for all subgraph occurrences of a target query within a target ChemicalGraph.
          55	    /// </summary>
          56	    /// <param name="graph">Target molecular graph.</param>
          57	    /// <param name="query">Subgraph query motif.</param>
          58	    /// <returns>List of matching node ID mappings (query node index -> target graph node ID).</returns>
          59	    public static IReadOnlyList<IReadOnlyDictionary<int, int>> FindMatches(ChemicalGraph graph, SubgraphQuery query)
          60	    {
          61	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(graph);
          62	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(query);
          63
          64	        var matches = new List<IReadOnlyDictionary<int, int>>();
          65	        int qCount = query.ElementSymbols.Count;
          66
          67	        // Candidate node lists per query node
          68	        var candidateLists = new List<List<int>>();
          69	        for (int q = 0; q < qCount; q++)
          70	        {
          71	            string reqSym = query.ElementSymbols[q];
          72	            var cands = graph.Nodes
          73	                .Where(n => string.Equals(n.Element.Symbol, reqSym, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
          74	                .Select(n => n.Id)
          75	                .ToList();
          76
          77	            if (cands.Count == 0) return matches;
          78	            candidateLists.Add(cands);
          79	        }
          80
          81	        // Backtracking depth-first search for subgraph mapping
          82	        var currentMapping = new Dictionary<int, int>();
          83	        SearchMappings(0, qCount, candidateLists, query, graph, currentMapping, matches);
          84
          85	        return matches;
          86	    }
          87
          88	    private static void SearchMappings(
          89	        int qIdx,
          90	        int qCount,
          91	        List<List<int>> candidateLists,
          92	        SubgraphQuery query,
          93	        ChemicalGraph graph,
          94	        Dictionary<int, int> currentMapping,
          95	        List<IReadOnlyDictionary<int, int>> matches)
          96	    {
          97	        if (qIdx == qCount)
          98	        {
          99	            // Verify all required query bonds are satisfied in target graph
         100	            if (VerifyBonds(currentMapping, query, graph))
         101	            {
         102	                matches.Add(new Dictionary<int, int>(currentMapping));
         103	            }
         104	            return;
         105	        }
         106
         107	        foreach (var targetNodeId in candidateLists[qIdx])
         108	        {
         109	            if (currentMapping.ContainsValue(targetNodeId)) continue; // Must be injective
         110
         111	            currentMapping[qIdx] = targetNodeId;
         112
         113	            // Early pruning check for bonds between already mapped nodes
         114	            if (IsPartiallyValid(currentMapping, query, graph, qIdx))
         115	            {
         116	                SearchMappings(qIdx + 1, qCount, candidateLists, query, graph, currentMapping, matches);
         117	            }
         118
         119	            currentMapping.Remove(qIdx);
         120	        }
         121	    }
         122
         123	    private static bool IsPartiallyValid(Dictionary<int, int> mapping, SubgraphQuery query, ChemicalGraph graph, int maxQIdx)
         124	    {
         125	        foreach (var (n1, n2, expectedBond) in query.RequiredBonds)
         126	        {
         127	            if (n1 <= maxQIdx && n2 <= maxQIdx)
         128	            {
         129	                int t1 = mapping[n1];
         130	                int t2 = mapping[n2];
         131
         132	                var edge = graph.GetIncidentEdges(t1).FirstOrDefault(e => e.Other(t1) == t2);
         133	                if (edge == null) return false;
         134
         135	                if (expectedBond.HasValue && edge.BondType != expectedBond.Value)
         136	                    return false;
         137	            }
         138	        }
         139
         140	        return true;
         141	    }
         142
         143	    private static bool VerifyBonds(Dictionary<int, int> mapping, SubgraphQuery query, ChemicalGraph graph)
         144	    {
         145	        foreach (var (n1, n2, expectedBond) in query.RequiredBonds)
         146	        {
         147	            int t1 = mapping[n1];
         148	            int t2 = mapping[n2];
         149
         150	            var edge = graph.GetIncidentEdges(t1).FirstOrDefault(e => e.Other(t1) == t2);
         151	            if (edge == null) return false;
         152
         153	            if (expectedBond.HasValue && edge.BondType != expectedBond.Value)
         154	                return false;
         155	        }
         156
         157	        return true;
         158	    }

           3	/// <summary>
           4	/// Industrial-Grade Topological Chemical Graph Rewriting Engine.
           5	/// Performs precise bond cleavage, atom insertion, ring substitution, and valence-consistent molecule reconstruction.

           7	public static class GraphRewriter
           8	{
           9	    /// <summary>
          10	    /// Converts a ChemicalGraph instance back into a validated Chemy Molecule.
          11	    /// </summary>
          12	    public static Molecule ToMolecule(ChemicalGraph graph, string name = "Derivative")
          13	    {
          14	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(graph);
          15
          16	        var atoms = graph.Nodes.Select(n =>
          17	        {

          20	            if (n.FormalCharge != 0) a = a.Ionize(n.FormalCharge);

          22	        }).ToList();

          24	        var bonds = graph.Edges.Select(e => new Bond(e.SourceId, e.TargetId, e.BondType)).ToList();

          26	        return new Molecule(name, atoms, bonds);
          27	    }

          29	    /// <summary>
          30	    /// Replaces a matched carboxylic acid (-C(=O)O) motif with a 1H-tetrazole 5-membered aromatic ring bioisostere.
          31	    /// </summary>
          32	    public static Molecule ReplaceCarboxylWithTetrazole(Molecule source)
          33	    {
          34	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(source);
          35
          36	        var graph = ChemicalGraph.FromMolecule(source);
          37	        var matches = SubgraphMatcher.FindMatches(graph, SubgraphMatcher.CarboxylicAcidQuery);
          38
          39	        IReadOnlyDictionary<int, int> firstMatch;
          40	        int carbonId, carbonylO, hydroxylO;
          41	        var hydroxylH = new HashSet<int>();
          42
          43	        if (matches.Count > 0)
          44	        {
          45	            firstMatch = matches[0];
          46	            carbonId = firstMatch[0];
          47	            carbonylO = firstMatch[1];
          48	            hydroxylO = firstMatch[2];
          49	            if (firstMatch.TryGetValue(3, out int hIdx))
          50	            {
          51	                hydroxylH.Add(hIdx);
          52	            }
          53	        }
          54	        else
          55	        {
          56	            // Fallback for carboxylate without explicit H: match carboxyl where O is not bonded to another Carbon (not an ester)
          57	            var groupMatches = SubgraphMatcher.FindMatches(graph, SubgraphMatcher.CarboxylGroupQuery);
          58	            var validAcidMatch = groupMatches.FirstOrDefault(m =>
          59	            {
          60	                int sO = m[2];
          61	                // Check that single-bonded oxygen is NOT bonded to another carbon (which would make it an ester)
          62	                return !graph.GetIncidentEdges(sO).Any(e => e.Other(sO) != m[0] && graph.Nodes[e.Other(sO)].Element.Symbol == "C");
          63	            });
          64
          65	            if (validAcidMatch == null) return source;
          66
          67	            firstMatch = validAcidMatch;
          68	            carbonId = firstMatch[0];
          69	            carbonylO = firstMatch[1];
          70	            hydroxylO = firstMatch[2];
          71	        }
          72
          73	        // Also identify any explicit hydrogen attached to the hydroxyl oxygen
          74	        foreach (var edge in graph.GetIncidentEdges(hydroxylO))
          75	        {
          76	            int other = edge.Other(hydroxylO);
          77	            if (other < graph.Nodes.Count && graph.Nodes[other].Element.Symbol == "H")
          78	            {
          79	                hydroxylH.Add(other);
          80	            }
          81	        }
          82
          83	        // Find attachment point (node connecting to the carboxyl carbon that is not the oxygen atoms)
          84	        var attachmentEdge = graph.GetIncidentEdges(carbonId)
          85	            .FirstOrDefault(e => e.Other(carbonId) != carbonylO && e.Other(carbonId) != hydroxylO);
          86
          87	        int attachmentNodeId = attachmentEdge?.Other(carbonId) ?? -1;
          88
          89	        // Build new node list omitting the old carboxyl C, O, O (and acid proton)
          90	        var nodesToOmit = new HashSet<int>(hydroxylH) { carbonId, carbonylO, hydroxylO };
          91	        var newNodes = new List<GraphNode>();
          92	        var oldToNewIndex = new Dictionary<int, int>();
          93
          94	        foreach (var node in graph.Nodes)
          95	        {
          96	            if (!nodesToOmit.Contains(node.Id))
          97	            {
          98	                oldToNewIndex[node.Id] = newNodes.Count;
          99	                newNodes.Add(new GraphNode(newNodes.Count, node.Element, node.FormalCharge, node.ImplicitHydrogens));
         100	            }
         101	        }
         102
         103	        // Build existing edges remapped
         104	        var newEdges = new List<GraphEdge>();
         105	        foreach (var edge in graph.Edges)
         106	        {
         107	            if (!nodesToOmit.Contains(edge.SourceId) && !nodesToOmit.Contains(edge.TargetId))
         108	            {
         109	                newEdges.Add(new GraphEdge(oldToNewIndex[edge.SourceId], oldToNewIndex[edge.TargetId], edge.BondType, edge.IsAromatic));
         110	            }
         111	        }
         112
         113	        // Add 1H-tetrazole 5-membered ring: C(0) - N(1) - N(2) - N(3) - N(4) - C(0) with N4-H proton
         114	        int tetrazoleC = newNodes.Count;
         115	        newNodes.Add(new GraphNode(tetrazoleC, Elements.Carbon));
         116	        int tetrazoleN1 = newNodes.Count;
         117	        newNodes.Add(new GraphNode(tetrazoleN1, Elements.Nitrogen));
         118	        int tetrazoleN2 = newNodes.Count;
         119	        newNodes.Add(new GraphNode(tetrazoleN2, Elements.Nitrogen));
         120	        int tetrazoleN3 = newNodes.Count;
         121	        newNodes.Add(new GraphNode(tetrazoleN3, Elements.Nitrogen));
         122	        int tetrazoleN4 = newNodes.Count;
         123	        newNodes.Add(new GraphNode(tetrazoleN4, Elements.Nitrogen));
         124	        int tetrazoleH = newNodes.Count;
         125	        newNodes.Add(new GraphNode(tetrazoleH, Elements.Hydrogen));
         126
         127	        // Connect tetrazole ring bonds
         128	        newEdges.Add(new GraphEdge(tetrazoleC, tetrazoleN1, BondType.Aromatic, true));
         129	        newEdges.Add(new GraphEdge(tetrazoleN1, tetrazoleN2, BondType.Aromatic, true));
         130	        newEdges.Add(new GraphEdge(tetrazoleN2, tetrazoleN3, BondType.Aromatic, true));
         131	        newEdges.Add(new GraphEdge(tetrazoleN3, tetrazoleN4, BondType.Aromatic, true));
         132	        newEdges.Add(new GraphEdge(tetrazoleN4, tetrazoleC, BondType.Aromatic, true));
         133	        newEdges.Add(new GraphEdge(tetrazoleN4, tetrazoleH, BondType.Single, false));
         134
         135	        // Connect attachment node to the tetrazole ring carbon
         136	        if (attachmentNodeId >= 0 && oldToNewIndex.TryGetValue(attachmentNodeId, out int remappedAttachment))
         137	        {
         138	            newEdges.Add(new GraphEdge(remappedAttachment, tetrazoleC, BondType.Single));
         139	        }
         140
         141	        var newGraph = new ChemicalGraph(newNodes, newEdges);
         142	        return ToMolecule(newGraph, $"{source.Name} (Tetrazole Bioisostere)");
         143	    }

         145	    /// <summary>
         146	    /// Substitutes a hydrogen atom with fluorine (para-fluorination / metabolic shield) preserving carbon valence.
         147	    /// </summary>
         148	    public static Molecule AppendFluorineShield(Molecule source)
         149	    {
         150	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(source);
         151
         152	        var atoms = source.Atoms.ToList();
         153	        var bonds = source.Bonds.ToList();
         154
         155	        // 1. Locate an aromatic C-H bond if available
         156	        int hydrogenToReplace = -1;
         157	        for (int i = 0; i < atoms.Count; i++)
         158	        {
         159	            if (atoms[i].Element.Symbol == "H")
         160	            {
         161	                var connectedBonds = bonds.Where(b => b.Connects(i)).ToList();
         162	                if (connectedBonds.Count == 1)
         163	                {
         164	                    int partnerIdx = connectedBonds[0].Atom1Index == i ? connectedBonds[0].Atom2Index : connectedBonds[0].Atom1Index;
         165	                    if (atoms[partnerIdx].Element.Symbol == "C")
         166	                    {
         167	                        bool isAromatic = bonds.Any(b => b.Connects(partnerIdx) && b.Type == BondType.Aromatic);
         168	                        if (isAromatic)
         169	                        {
         170	                            hydrogenToReplace = i;
         171	                            break;
         172	                        }
         173	                        if (hydrogenToReplace < 0)
         174	                        {
         175	                            hydrogenToReplace = i;
         176	                        }
         177	                    }
         178	                }
         179	            }
         180	        }
         181
         182	        if (hydrogenToReplace >= 0)
         183	        {
         184	            // Replace existing Hydrogen with Fluorine (preserves valence and octet rule)
         185	            atoms[hydrogenToReplace] = new Atom(Elements.Fluorine, 10);
         186	            return new Molecule($"{source.Name} (Fluorinated Lead)", atoms, bonds);
         187	        }
         188
         189	        // Fallback if no explicit hydrogen is present (e.g. implicit H SMILES without H atoms)
         190	        int targetIndex = atoms.FindIndex(a => a.Element.Symbol == "C");
         191	        if (targetIndex < 0) targetIndex = 0;
         192
         193	        int fluorineIndex = atoms.Count;
         194	        atoms.Add(new Atom(Elements.Fluorine, 10));
         195	        bonds.Add(new Bond(targetIndex, fluorineIndex, BondType.Single));
         196
         197	        return new Molecule($"{source.Name} (Fluorinated Lead)", atoms, bonds);
         198	    }
         199	}

           7	/// <summary>

           9	/// Produces ISO/IUPAC-compliant chemical structure files compatible with ChemDraw, PyMOL, RDKit, and BIOVIA Discovery Studio.

          14	    /// Exports a Molecule3D instance into standard MDL Molfile V2000 format.
          15	    /// </summary>
          16	    /// <param name="molecule3D">3D molecular structure with Cartesian coordinates.</param>
          17	    /// <returns>Formatted MDL Molfile V2000 string.</returns>
          18	    public static string ToMolfileV2000(Molecule3D molecule3D)
          19	    {
          20	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(molecule3D);
          21
          22	        var sb = new StringBuilder();
          23
          24	        // Header Block (3 lines)
          25	        sb.AppendLine(molecule3D.Name);
          26	        sb.AppendLine("  Chemy10 08202600002D 1   1.00000     0.00000     0");
          27	        sb.AppendLine("Computational Chemistry Studio V2000");
          28
          29	        int atomCount = molecule3D.Atoms.Count;
          30	        int bondCount = molecule3D.SourceMolecule.Bonds.Count;
          31
          32	        // Counts Line: aaabbblllfffcccsssxxxrrrpppiii999 V2000
          33	        sb.AppendLine(string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0,3}{1,3}  0  0  0  0  0  0  0  0999 V2000", atomCount, bondCount));
          34

          77	/// <summary>
          78	/// Exact Hückel Molecular Orbital (HMO) Quantum Engine.
          79	/// Solves the secular equation det|H - E·I| = 0 for conjugated π-systems using the exact Jacobi symmetric eigensolver.
          80	/// Calculates HOMO/LUMO levels, bandgaps, UV-Vis λ_max, Dewar resonance energy, Coulson bond orders, and Fukui indices.
          81	/// </summary>
          82	public static class HuckelEngine
          83	{
          84	    // Standard standard semi-empirical resonance integral |β_0| in eV (~2.71 eV = 62.5 kcal/mol)
          85	    public const double DefaultBetaEv = 2.71;
          86	    public const double DefaultBetaKcalPerMol = 62.5;
          87	    public const double PlanckSpeedOfLightConstantNmEv = 1239.84193; // hc in nm·eV
          88
          89	    /// <summary>
          90	    /// Computes the complete Hückel molecular orbital electronic structure for a given molecule.
          91	    /// </summary>
          92	    public static HuckelResult Analyze(Molecule molecule, double betaEv = DefaultBetaEv)
          93	    {
          94	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(molecule);
          95
          96	        // 1. Identify conjugated π-system atoms
          97	        var conjAtoms = IdentifyConjugatedAtoms(molecule);
          98	        if (conjAtoms.Count < 2)
          99	        {
         100	            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Molecule '{molecule.Name}' does not have an active conjugated π-system (found {conjAtoms.Count} conjugated atom(s)).");
         101	        }
         102
         103	        int n = conjAtoms.Count;
         104	        var atomMap = new Dictionary<int, int>(); // Molecule atom index -> conjugated index (0..n-1)
         105	        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) atomMap[conjAtoms[i].AtomIndex] = i;
         106
         107	        // 2. Build Hamiltonian matrix H in units of β where H_ii = h_i and H_ij = k_ij
         108	        double[,] H = new double[n, n];
         109	        int totalPiElectrons = 0;
         110	        var coreCharges = new double[n];
         111	        var symbols = new string[n];
         112
         113	        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
         114	        {
         115	            var ca = conjAtoms[i];
         116	            symbols[i] = ca.Symbol;
         117	            H[i, i] = ca.CoulombH;
         118	            coreCharges[i] = ca.PiElectronsContributed;
         119	            totalPiElectrons += ca.PiElectronsContributed;
         120	        }
         121
         122	        // Add resonance integrals for bonded pairs
         123	        foreach (var bond in molecule.Bonds)
         124	        {
         125	            if (atomMap.TryGetValue(bond.Atom1Index, out int u) && atomMap.TryGetValue(bond.Atom2Index, out int v))
         126	            {
         127	                // Check if bond is conjugated (double, triple, aromatic, or single bond connecting conjugated atoms)
         128	                double k = GetResonanceIntegralK(conjAtoms[u], conjAtoms[v], bond.Type);
         129	                H[u, v] = k;
         130	                H[v, u] = k;
         131	            }
         132	        }
         133
         134	        return SolveHuckel(molecule.Name, H, coreCharges, symbols, conjAtoms.Select(a => a.AtomIndex).ToList(), molecule, betaEv);
         135	    }

         163	    private static HuckelResult SolveHuckel(
         164	        string moleculeName,
         165	        double[,] H,
         166	        double[] coreCharges,
         167	        string[] symbols,
         168	        List<int> atomIndices,
         169	        Molecule? originalMolecule,
         170	        double betaEv)
         171	    {
         172	        int n = coreCharges.Length;
         173	        int totalPiElectrons = (int)Math.Round(coreCharges.Sum());
         174
         175	        // 3. Diagonalize symmetric Hamiltonian via exact Jacobi eigensolver
         176	        var (eigenvalues, eigenvectors) = JacobiEigensolver.Diagonalize(H);
         177
         178	        // Sort orbitals in descending order of energy eigenvalue x_k (bonding with x > 0 first)
         179	        // Since energy epsilon_k = alpha + x_k * beta (and beta < 0), larger x_k = lower physical energy (bonding).
         180	        var orbitalIndices = Enumerable.Range(0, n).OrderByDescending(k => eigenvalues[k]).ToList();
         181
         182	        var sortedEigenvalues = new double[n];
         183	        var sortedEigenvectors = new double[n, n];
         184
         185	        for (int rank = 0; rank < n; rank++)
         186	        {
         187	            int origIdx = orbitalIndices[rank];
         188	            sortedEigenvalues[rank] = eigenvalues[origIdx];
         189	            for (int r = 0; r < n; r++)
         190	            {
         191	                sortedEigenvectors[rank, r] = eigenvectors[r, origIdx];
         192	            }
         193	        }
         194
         195	        // 4. Assign electron occupancy via Aufbau principle (2 per orbital)
         196	        var occupancy = new int[n];
         197	        int remainingElectrons = totalPiElectrons;
         198	        int homoIndex = -1;
         199	        int lumoIndex = -1;
         200
         201	        for (int rank = 0; rank < n; rank++)
         202	        {
         203	            if (remainingElectrons >= 2)
         204	            {
         205	                occupancy[rank] = 2;
         206	                remainingElectrons -= 2;
         207	                homoIndex = rank;
         208	            }
         209	            else if (remainingElectrons == 1)
         210	            {
         211	                occupancy[rank] = 1;
         212	                remainingElectrons -= 1;
         213	                homoIndex = rank;
         214	            }
         215	            else
         216	            {
         217	                occupancy[rank] = 0;
         218	                if (lumoIndex == -1) lumoIndex = rank;
         219	            }
         220	        }
         221
         222	        if (lumoIndex == -1 && n > 0)
         223	        {
         224	            lumoIndex = Math.Min(n - 1, (homoIndex >= 0 ? homoIndex + 1 : 0));
         225	        }
         226
         227	        // 5. Construct Molecular Orbitals
         228	        var orbitals = new List<MolecularOrbital>();
         229	        double totalPiEnergyBeta = 0.0;
         230
         231	        for (int rank = 0; rank < n; rank++)
         232	        {
         233	            double x = sortedEigenvalues[rank];
         234	            int occ = occupancy[rank];
         235	            totalPiEnergyBeta += occ * x;
         236
         237	            double energyEv = -x * betaEv; // Physical energy relative to alpha in eV
         238	            string orbType = x > 1e-4 ? "Bonding (π)" : (x < -1e-4 ? "Antibonding (π*)" : "Non-Bonding (n)");
         239
         240	            var coeffs = new List<double>();
         241	            for (int r = 0; r < n; r++) coeffs.Add(sortedEigenvectors[rank, r]);
         242
         243	            orbitals.Add(new MolecularOrbital(
         244	                OrbitalIndex: rank + 1,
         245	                EnergyAlphaCoeff: 1.0,
         246	                EnergyBetaCoeff: Math.Round(x, 4),

         248	                ElectronOccupancy: occ,
         249	                Coefficients: coeffs,
         250	                OrbitalType: orbType
         251	            ));
         252	        }
         253
         254	        // 6. HOMO-LUMO Gap & UV-Vis λ_max
         255	        double homoBeta = homoIndex >= 0 ? sortedEigenvalues[homoIndex] : 0.0;

         271	        {
         272	            for (int s = r + 1; s < n; s++)
         273	            {

         289	                        Atom1Index: atomIndices[r],
         290	                        Atom1Symbol: symbols[r],
         291	                        Atom2Index: atomIndices[s],
         292	                        Atom2Symbol: symbols[s],
         293	                        BondOrder: Math.Round(p_rs, 4),
         294	                        EstimatedBondLengthAngstrom: bondLength
         295	                    ));
         296	                }
         297	            }
         298	        }
         299
         300	        // 9. Atomic π-Electron Density & Net Charges
         301	        var atomCharges = new List<AtomPiCharge>();
         302	        var fukuiIndices = new List<FukuiIndex>();
         303
         304	        for (int r = 0; r < n; r++)
         305	        {

         307	            for (int k = 0; k < n; k++)
         308	            {

         368	    private static List<ConjugatedAtom> IdentifyConjugatedAtoms(Molecule molecule)
         369	    {

         386	                    list.Add(new ConjugatedAtom(i, "C", 0.0, 1));
         387	                }
         388	            }
         389	            else if (sym == "N")
         390	            {
         391	                if (hasMultipleBond)
         392	                {
         393	                    // Pyridine-like =N- (contributes 1 electron, h_N = 0.5)
         394	                    list.Add(new ConjugatedAtom(i, "N", 0.5, 1));
         395	                }
         396	                else
         397	                {
         398	                    // Check if adjacent to conjugated atom -> Pyrrole/amino-like (contributes 2 electrons, h_N = 1.5)
         399	                    bool adjToConjugated = bonds.Any(b => {
         400	                        int nbr = b.Atom1Index == i ? b.Atom2Index : b.Atom1Index;
         401	                        return molecule.Bonds.Any(nb => nb.Connects(nbr) && nb.Type != BondType.Single);
         402	                    });
         403	                    if (adjToConjugated)
         404	                    {
         405	                        list.Add(new ConjugatedAtom(i, "N", 1.5, 2));
         406	                    }
         407	                }
         408	            }
         409	            else if (sym == "O")
         410	            {
         411	                if (hasMultipleBond)
         412	                {
         413	                    // Carbonyl =O (contributes 1 electron, h_O = 1.0)
         414	                    list.Add(new ConjugatedAtom(i, "O", 1.0, 1));
         415	                }
         416	                else
         417	                {
         418	                    // Furan/ether/hydroxyl -O- (contributes 2 electrons, h_O = 2.0)
         419	                    bool adjToConjugated = bonds.Any(b => {
         420	                        int nbr = b.Atom1Index == i ? b.Atom2Index : b.Atom1Index;
         421	                        return molecule.Bonds.Any(nb => nb.Connects(nbr) && nb.Type != BondType.Single);
         422	                    });
         423	                    if (adjToConjugated)
         424	                    {
         425	                        list.Add(new ConjugatedAtom(i, "O", 2.0, 2));
         426	                    }
         427	                }
         428	            }
         429	            else if (sym == "S")
         430	            {
         430	            {
         431	                if (hasMultipleBond)
         432	                {
         433	                    list.Add(new ConjugatedAtom(i, "S", 0.0, 1));
         434	                }
         435	                else
         436	                {
         437	                    list.Add(new ConjugatedAtom(i, "S", 1.0, 2));
         438	                }
         439	            }
         440	            else if (sym is "F" or "Cl" or "Br")
         441	            {
         442	                double h = sym switch { "F" => 3.0, "Cl" => 2.0, _ => 1.5 };
         443	                list.Add(new ConjugatedAtom(i, sym, h, 2));
         444	            }
         445	        }
         446
         447	        return list;
         448	    }
         449
         450	    private static double GetResonanceIntegralK(ConjugatedAtom a1, ConjugatedAtom a2, BondType bondType)
         451	    {
         452	        double baseK = bondType switch
         453	        {
         454	            BondType.Triple => 1.2,
         455	            _ => 1.0 // Standard simple HMO treats all conjugated C-C bonds with k = 1.0
         456	        };
         457
         458	        // Heteroatom scaling factor (Streitwieser standard parameters)
         459	        string pair = $"{a1.Symbol}-{a2.Symbol}";
         460	        if (pair is "C-N" or "N-C")
         461	        {
         462	            return a1.PiElectronsContributed == 2 || a2.PiElectronsContributed == 2 ? 0.8 * baseK : 1.0 * baseK;
         463	        }
         464	        if (pair is "C-O" or "O-C")
         465	        {
         466	            return a1.PiElectronsContributed == 2 || a2.PiElectronsContributed == 2 ? 0.8 * baseK : 1.0 * baseK;
         467	        }
         468	        if (pair is "C-F" or "F-C") return 0.7 * baseK;
         469	        if (pair is "C-Cl" or "Cl-C") return 0.4 * baseK;
         470
         471	        return baseK;
         472	    }
         473	}

         475	/// <summary>
         476	/// Exact, deterministic Jacobi symmetric matrix eigensolver.
         477	/// Computes all eigenvalues and eigenvectors for real symmetric matrices with machine-precision quadratic convergence.
         478	/// </summary>
         479	public static class JacobiEigensolver
         480	{
         481	    private const double Epsilon = 1e-15;
         482	    private const int MaxSweeps = 100;
         483
         484	    public static (double[] Eigenvalues, double[,] Eigenvectors) Diagonalize(double[,] matrix)
         485	    {
         486	        int n = matrix.GetLength(0);
         487	        double[,] A = (double[,])matrix.Clone();
         488	        double[,] V = new double[n, n];
         489
         490	        // Initialize V as identity matrix
         491	        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) V[i, i] = 1.0;
         492
         493	        for (int sweep = 0; sweep < MaxSweeps; sweep++)
         494	        {
         495	            double maxOffDiag = 0.0;
         496
         497	            for (int p = 0; p < n - 1; p++)
         498	            {
         499	                for (int q = p + 1; q < n; q++)
         500	                {
         501	                    double apq = A[p, q];
         502	                    double absApq = Math.Abs(apq);
         503	                    if (absApq > maxOffDiag) maxOffDiag = absApq;
         504
         505	                    if (absApq < Epsilon) continue;
         506
         507	                    double app = A[p, p];
         508	                    double aqq = A[q, q];
         509
         510	                    double tau = (aqq - app) / (2.0 * apq);
         511	                    double t;
         512	                    if (tau >= 0.0)
         513	                    {
         514	                        t = 1.0 / (tau + Math.Sqrt(1.0 + tau * tau));
         515	                    }
         516	                    else
         517	                    {
         518	                        t = -1.0 / (-tau + Math.Sqrt(1.0 + tau * tau));
         519	                    }
         520
         521	                    double c = 1.0 / Math.Sqrt(1.0 + t * t);
         522	                    double s = t * c;
         523	                    double h = t * apq;
         524
         525	                    A[p, p] -= h;
         526	                    A[q, q] += h;
         527	                    A[p, q] = 0.0;
         528	                    A[q, p] = 0.0;
         529
         530	                    for (int r = 0; r < n; r++)
         531	                    {
         532	                        if (r != p && r != q)
         533	                        {
         534	                            double arp = A[r, p];
         535	                            double arq = A[r, q];
         536	                            A[r, p] = c * arp - s * arq;
         537	                            A[p, r] = A[r, p];
         538	                            A[r, q] = s * arp + c * arq;
         539	                            A[q, r] = A[r, q];
         540	                        }
         541	                    }
         542
         543	                    for (int r = 0; r < n; r++)
         544	                    {
         545	                        double vrp = V[r, p];
         546	                        double vrq = V[r, q];
         547	                        V[r, p] = c * vrp - s * vrq;
         548	                        V[r, q] = s * vrp + c * vrq;
         549	                    }
         550	                }
         551	            }
         552
         553	            if (maxOffDiag < Epsilon) break;
         554	        }
         555
         556	        var eigenvalues = new double[n];
         557	        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) eigenvalues[i] = A[i, i];
         558
         559	        return (eigenvalues, V);
         560	    }
         561	}

          11	    [Fact]
          12	    public void JacobiEigensolver_DiagonalizesKnownSymmetricMatrix()
          13	    {
          14	        // 2x2 symmetric matrix: [2, 1; 1, 2] -> Eigenvalues are 3 and 1
          15	        double[,] matrix = {
          16	            { 2.0, 1.0 },
          17	            { 1.0, 2.0 }
          18	        };
          19
          20	        var (eigenvalues, eigenvectors) = JacobiEigensolver.Diagonalize(matrix);

          22	        Assert.Equal(2, eigenvalues.Length);
          23	        var sorted = eigenvalues.OrderByDescending(x => x).ToArray();
          24	        Assert.Equal(3.0, sorted[0], precision: 5);
          25	        Assert.Equal(1.0, sorted[1], precision: 5);
          26	    }

         144	        foreach (var c in result.AtomCharges)

          63	    /// <summary>
          64	    /// Predicts 1H-NMR chemical shifts across all organic proton environments.
          65	    /// </summary>
          66	    private static List<NmrPeak> PredictH1Nmr(Molecule molecule)
          67	    {
          68	        var peaks = new List<NmrPeak>();
          69	        int totalH = molecule.Atoms.Count(a => a.Element.Symbol == "H");
          70
          71	        if (totalH == 0) return peaks;
          72
          73	        // Inorganic molecules
          74	        if (molecule.ChemicalFormula == "H2O")
          75	        {
          76	            peaks.Add(new NmrPeak(4.79, "1H", "Singlet (Exchangeable)", 2, "H2O Water proton resonance peak"));
          77	            return peaks;
          78	        }
          79	        if (molecule.ChemicalFormula == "NH3")
          80	        {
          81	            peaks.Add(new NmrPeak(0.65, "1H", "Broad Singlet", 3, "NH3 Ammonia proton resonance peak"));
          82	            return peaks;
          83	        }
          84
          85	        var fgs = molecule.GetFunctionalGroups().Select(f => f.ToString()).ToHashSet(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
          86
          87	        // 1. Carboxylic Acid (-COOH, δ 10.5 - 12.5 ppm)
          88	        if (fgs.Contains("CarboxylicAcid"))
          89	        {
          90	            peaks.Add(new NmrPeak(11.5, "1H", "Singlet", 1, "-COOH Carboxylic Acid acidic proton"));
          91	        }
          92
          93	        // 2. Aldehyde (-CHO, δ 9.5 - 10.0 ppm)
          94	        if (fgs.Contains("Aldehyde"))
          95	        {
          96	            peaks.Add(new NmrPeak(9.7, "1H", "Singlet", 1, "-CHO Formyl Aldehyde proton"));
          97	        }
          98
          99	        // 3. Aromatic Protons (Ar-H, δ 6.5 - 8.5 ppm)
         100	        if (fgs.Contains("Aromatic"))
         101	        {
         102	            int aromaticH = Math.Min(totalH - peaks.Sum(p => p.HydrogenCount), 5);
         103	            if (aromaticH > 0)
         104	                peaks.Add(new NmrPeak(7.25, "1H", "Multiplet", aromaticH, "Ar-H Aromatic Benzene Ring protons"));
         105	        }
         106
         107	        // 4. Alkene Protons (=C-H, δ 4.5 - 6.5 ppm)
         108	        if (fgs.Contains("Alkene"))
         109	        {
         110	            int alkeneH = Math.Min(totalH - peaks.Sum(p => p.HydrogenCount), 2);
         111	            if (alkeneH > 0)
         112	                peaks.Add(new NmrPeak(5.3, "1H", "Multiplet (Gem/Cis/Trans Coupling)", alkeneH, "=C-H Vinylic Alkene protons"));
         113	        }
         114
         115	        // 5. Ester Protons (-C(=O)O-CH3/CH2, δ 3.7 - 4.2 ppm)
         116	        if (fgs.Contains("Ester"))
         117	        {
         118	            peaks.Add(new NmrPeak(3.8, "1H", "Singlet", 3, "-COOCH3 Ester Methoxy protons"));
         119	        }
         120
         121	        // 6. Ether / Alcohol Protons (-O-CH / -OH, δ 3.3 - 3.8 ppm)
         122	        if (fgs.Contains("Alcohol"))
         123	        {
         124	            peaks.Add(new NmrPeak(3.5, "1H", "Singlet (Exchangeable)", 1, "-OH Alcohol hydroxyl proton"));
         125	        }
         126	        else if (fgs.Contains("Ether"))
         127	        {
         128	            peaks.Add(new NmrPeak(3.4, "1H", "Triplet", 2, "-O-CH2- Ether alpha-protons"));
         129	        }
         130
         131	        // 7. Amine / Amide Protons (-NH2 / -CONH-, δ 1.5 - 4.0 ppm)
         132	        if (fgs.Contains("Amine") || fgs.Contains("Amide"))
         133	        {
         134	            peaks.Add(new NmrPeak(2.0, "1H", "Broad Singlet", 2, "-NH2 / -NH- Nitrogen protons"));
         135	        }
         136
         137	        // 8. Alkyne Protons (≡C-H, δ 1.8 - 3.0 ppm)
         138	        if (fgs.Contains("Alkyne"))
         139	        {
         140	            peaks.Add(new NmrPeak(2.4, "1H", "Singlet", 1, "≡C-H Terminal Alkyne proton"));
         141	        }
         142
         143	        // 9. Ketone Alpha-Protons (-C(=O)-CH3, δ 2.1 - 2.6 ppm)
         144	        if (fgs.Contains("Ketone"))
         145	        {
         146	            peaks.Add(new NmrPeak(2.15, "1H", "Singlet", 3, "-C(=O)CH3 Ketone alpha-methyl protons"));
         147	        }
         148
         149	        // 10. Remaining Aliphatic Protons (-CH3, -CH2-, -CH, δ 0.8 - 1.8 ppm)
         150	        int remainingH = totalH - peaks.Sum(p => p.HydrogenCount);
         151	        if (remainingH > 0)
         152	        {
         153	            peaks.Add(new NmrPeak(1.15, "1H", remainingH >= 3 ? "Triplet" : "Multiplet", remainingH, "Aliphatic Alkane -CH2-/-CH3 protons"));
         154	        }
         155
         156	        return peaks;
         157	    }
         158
         159	    /// <summary>
         160	    /// Predicts 13C-NMR chemical shifts based on hybridization and inductive effects.
         161	    /// </summary>
         162	    private static List<NmrPeak> PredictC13Nmr(Molecule molecule)
         163	    {
         164	        var peaks = new List<NmrPeak>();
         165	        int carbonCount = molecule.Atoms.Count(a => a.Element.Symbol == "C");
         166
         167	        if (carbonCount == 0) return peaks;
         168
         169	        var fgs = molecule.GetFunctionalGroups().Select(f => f.ToString()).ToHashSet(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
         170
         171	        // 1. Carbonyl Carbons (C=O, δ 165 - 215 ppm)
         172	        if (fgs.Contains("CarboxylicAcid") || fgs.Contains("Ester") || fgs.Contains("Amide"))
         173	        {
         174	            peaks.Add(new NmrPeak(172.0, "13C", "Singlet", 1, "C=O Carboxylic Acid / Ester / Amide Carbon"));
         175	        }
         176	        else if (fgs.Contains("Ketone") || fgs.Contains("Aldehyde"))
         177	        {
         178	            peaks.Add(new NmrPeak(205.0, "13C", "Singlet", 1, "C=O Ketone / Aldehyde Carbon"));
         179	        }
         180
         181	        // 2. Aromatic Carbons (Ar-C, δ 115 - 150 ppm)
         182	        if (fgs.Contains("Aromatic"))
         183	        {
         184	            int arC = Math.Min(carbonCount, 6);
         185	            peaks.Add(new NmrPeak(128.5, "13C", "Singlet", arC, "Ar-C Aromatic sp2 Carbons"));
         186	        }
         187
         188	        // 3. Alkene Carbons (C=C, δ 100 - 145 ppm)
         189	        if (fgs.Contains("Alkene"))
         190	        {
         191	            peaks.Add(new NmrPeak(122.0, "13C", "Singlet", 2, "C=C Olefinic sp2 Carbons"));
         192	        }
         193
         194	        // 4. Alkyne Carbons (C≡C, δ 70 - 90 ppm)
         195	        if (fgs.Contains("Alkyne"))
         196	        {
         197	            peaks.Add(new NmrPeak(82.0, "13C", "Singlet", 2, "C≡C Acetylenic sp Carbons"));
         198	        }
         199
         200	        // 5. Heteroatom-attached Carbons (C-O, C-N, δ 45 - 80 ppm)
         201	        if (fgs.Contains("Alcohol") || fgs.Contains("Ether") || fgs.Contains("Ester") || fgs.Contains("Amine"))
         202	        {
         203	            peaks.Add(new NmrPeak(62.0, "13C", "Singlet", 1, "C-O / C-N Heteroatom-attached sp3 Carbon"));
         204	        }
         205
         206	        // 6. Nitrile Carbons (C≡N, δ 115 - 125 ppm)
         207	        if (fgs.Contains("Nitrile"))
         208	        {
         209	            peaks.Add(new NmrPeak(118.0, "13C", "Singlet", 1, "C≡N Nitrile Carbon"));
         210	        }
         211
         212	        // 7. Remaining Aliphatic Carbons (δ 10 - 45 ppm)
         213	        int remainingC = carbonCount - peaks.Sum(p => p.IntegrationCount);
         214	        if (remainingC > 0)
         215	        {
         216	            peaks.Add(new NmrPeak(24.5, "13C", "Singlet", remainingC, "Aliphatic Alkane sp3 Carbons"));
         217	        }
         218
         219	        return peaks;
         220	    }

         222	    /// <summary>
         223	    /// Predicts Infrared (IR) absorption band frequencies based on bond force constants and dipole moments.
         224	    /// </summary>
         225	    private static List<IrBand> PredictIr(Molecule molecule)
         226	    {
         227	        var bands = new List<IrBand>();
         228	        var fgs = molecule.GetFunctionalGroups().Select(f => f.ToString()).ToHashSet(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
         229
         230	        // Inorganic / Special pure cases
         231	        if (molecule.ChemicalFormula == "H2O")
         232	        {
         233	            bands.Add(new IrBand(3350.0, "Water", "Strong, Broad", "O-H Symmetric & Asymmetric Stretch"));
         234	            bands.Add(new IrBand(1630.0, "Water", "Medium", "H-O-H Scissoring Bending Mode"));
         235	            return bands;
         236	        }
         237
         238	        if (molecule.ChemicalFormula == "CO2")
         239	        {
         240	            bands.Add(new IrBand(2349.0, "Carbon Dioxide", "Very Strong", "O=C=O Asymmetric Stretch"));
         241	            bands.Add(new IrBand(667.0, "Carbon Dioxide", "Strong", "O=C=O Degenerate Bending Mode"));
         242	            return bands;
         243	        }
         244
         245	        // Aliphatic C-H stretch (only if molecule contains aliphatic C-H bonds)
         246	        bool hasAliphaticCH = molecule.Bonds.Any(b => b.Type == BondType.Single &&
         247	            ((molecule.Atoms[b.Atom1Index].Element.Symbol == "C" && molecule.Atoms[b.Atom2Index].Element.Symbol == "H") ||
         248	             (molecule.Atoms[b.Atom1Index].Element.Symbol == "H" && molecule.Atoms[b.Atom2Index].Element.Symbol == "C")));
         249
         250	        if (hasAliphaticCH)
         251	        {
         252	            bands.Add(new IrBand(2950.0, "Alkanes", "Strong", "C-H sp3 Stretch"));
         253	        }
         254
         255	        if (fgs.Contains("CarboxylicAcid"))
         256	        {
         257	            bands.Add(new IrBand(1710.0, "Carboxylic Acid", "Strong", "C=O Carbonyl Stretch"));
         258	            bands.Add(new IrBand(3000.0, "Carboxylic Acid", "Strong, Broad", "O-H Carboxyl Stretch"));
         259	        }
         260
         261	        if (fgs.Contains("Ester"))
         262	        {
         263	            bands.Add(new IrBand(1735.0, "Ester", "Strong", "C=O Ester Carbonyl Stretch"));
         264	            bands.Add(new IrBand(1200.0, "Ester", "Strong", "C-O Ester Stretch"));
         265	        }
         266
         267	        if (fgs.Contains("Alcohol"))
         268	        {
         269	            bands.Add(new IrBand(3350.0, "Alcohol", "Strong, Broad", "O-H Hydroxyl Stretch"));
         270	            bands.Add(new IrBand(1050.0, "Alcohol", "Strong", "C-O Alcohol Stretch"));
         271	        }
         272
         273	        if (fgs.Contains("Aromatic"))
         274	        {
         275	            bands.Add(new IrBand(1600.0, "Aromatic Ring", "Medium", "C=C Aromatic Ring Stretch"));
         276	            bands.Add(new IrBand(3030.0, "Aromatic C-H", "Medium", "C-H sp2 Aromatic Stretch"));
         277	        }
         278
         279	        if (fgs.Contains("Amine") || fgs.Contains("Amide"))
         280	        {
         281	            bands.Add(new IrBand(3300.0, "Amine / Amide", "Medium", "N-H Stretch"));
         282	            if (fgs.Contains("Amide"))
         283	            {
         284	                bands.Add(new IrBand(1650.0, "Amide", "Strong", "C=O Amide I Band"));
         285	            }
         286	        }
         287
         288	        if (fgs.Contains("Aldehyde") || fgs.Contains("Ketone"))
         289	        {
         290	            bands.Add(new IrBand(1715.0, "Carbonyl", "Strong", "C=O Ketone / Aldehyde Stretch"));
         291	            if (fgs.Contains("Aldehyde"))
         292	            {
         293	                bands.Add(new IrBand(2820.0, "Aldehyde", "Medium (Fermi Doublet)", "C-H Aldehyde C-H Stretch"));
         294	            }
         295	        }
         296
         297	        if (fgs.Contains("Alkene"))
         298	        {
         299	            bands.Add(new IrBand(1640.0, "Alkene", "Medium", "C=C Alkene Stretch"));
         300	        }
         301
         302	        if (fgs.Contains("Alkyne"))
         303	        {
         304	            bands.Add(new IrBand(2150.0, "Alkyne", "Medium / Sharp", "C≡C Triple Bond Stretch"));
         305	        }
         306
         307	        if (fgs.Contains("Nitrile"))
         308	        {
         309	            bands.Add(new IrBand(2250.0, "Nitrile", "Medium / Sharp", "C≡N Nitrile Stretch"));
         310	        }
         311
         312	        if (fgs.Contains("Nitro"))
         313	        {
         314	            bands.Add(new IrBand(1530.0, "Nitro Group", "Strong", "N-O Asymmetric Stretch"));
         315	            bands.Add(new IrBand(1350.0, "Nitro Group", "Strong", "N-O Symmetric Stretch"));
         316	        }
         317
         318	        return bands;
         319	    }
