      using Chemy.Core;
      using Chemy.Core.Graph;
      using Chemy.Core.Pharmacology;
      using Chemy.Core.Spectroscopy;
      using Chemy.Core.Structure;
      using Xunit;
      
      public class Phase1ChemoinformaticsTests
      {
          [Fact]
          public void ErtlTpsa_Ethanol_ReturnsCorrectPolarArea()
          {
              // Ethanol: C2H6O -> -OH contribution = 20.23 Å²
              var mol = SmilesParser.Parse("CCO");
              var result = ErtlTpsa.Calculate(mol);
      
              Assert.Equal(20.23, result.TotalTpsa);
              Assert.Single(result.AtomContributions);
              Assert.Equal("O", result.AtomContributions[0].ElementSymbol);
          }
      
          [Fact]
          public void ErtlTpsa_AceticAcid_ReturnsCorrectPolarArea()
          {
              // Acetic Acid: CC(=O)O -> =O (17.07) + -OH (20.23) = 37.30 Å²
              var mol = SmilesParser.Parse("CC(=O)O");
              var result = ErtlTpsa.Calculate(mol);
      
              Assert.Equal(37.30, result.TotalTpsa);
              Assert.Equal(2, result.AtomContributions.Count);
          }
      
          [Fact]
          public void ErtlTpsa_Acetamide_ReturnsCorrectPolarArea()
          {
              // Acetamide: CC(=O)N -> =O (17.07) + -CONH2 (43.09) = 60.16 Å² (standard Ertl) or primary amide
              var mol = SmilesParser.Parse("CC(=O)N");
              var result = ErtlTpsa.Calculate(mol);
      
              Assert.True(result.TotalTpsa > 50.0);
          }
      
          [Fact]
          public void WildmanCrippenLogP_MethaneAndEthane_CalculatesPositiveLogP()
          {
              var methane = SmilesParser.Parse("C");
              var ethane = SmilesParser.Parse("CC");
      
              var resMethane = WildmanCrippenLogP.Calculate(methane);
              var resEthane = WildmanCrippenLogP.Calculate(ethane);
      
              Assert.True(resMethane.CalculatedLogP > 0.0);
              Assert.True(resEthane.CalculatedLogP > resMethane.CalculatedLogP);
              Assert.True(resEthane.CalculatedMr > resMethane.CalculatedMr);
          }
      
          [Fact]
          public void WildmanCrippenLogP_Benzene_MatchesAromaticParameters()
          {
              // Benzene: c1ccccc1 -> 6 * C18 (0.1582) + 6 * H3 (0.1130) = 6 * 0.2712 = 1.6272 ≈ 1.63
              var mol = SmilesParser.Parse("c1ccccc1");
              var result = WildmanCrippenLogP.Calculate(mol);
      
              Assert.InRange(result.CalculatedLogP, 1.50, 1.80);
          }
      
          [Fact]
          public void BickertonQed_CalculatesValidScoreBetweenZeroAndOne()
          {
              var aspirin = SmilesParser.Parse("CC(=O)Oc1ccccc1C(=O)O");
              var qedResult = BickertonQed.Calculate(aspirin);
      
              Assert.InRange(qedResult.QedScore, 0.10, 0.95);
              Assert.Equal(8, qedResult.DescriptorDesirabilities.Count);
              Assert.True(qedResult.DescriptorDesirabilities.ContainsKey("MolecularWeight"));
              Assert.True(qedResult.DescriptorDesirabilities.ContainsKey("ALogP"));
              Assert.True(qedResult.DescriptorDesirabilities.ContainsKey("TPSA"));
          }
      
          [Fact]
          public void WeisfeilerLehman_Acetone_SymmetryClasses_IdentifiesEquivalentMethylProtons()
          {
              // Acetone: CC(=O)C (has 6 protons, 2 methyl carbons, 1 carbonyl carbon, 1 carbonyl oxygen)
              var mol = SmilesParser.Parse("CC(=O)C");
              var partition = WeisfeilerLehman.Partition(mol);
      
              // Hydrogens should be partitioned into exactly 1 equivalence class of size 6
              var hIndices = mol.Atoms.Select((a, i) => (a, i)).Where(t => t.a.Element.Symbol == "H").Select(t => t.i).ToList();
              var distinctHClasses = hIndices.Select(h => partition.SymmetryClasses[h]).Distinct().ToList();
      
              Assert.Equal(6, hIndices.Count);
              Assert.Single(distinctHClasses); // All 6 protons are topologically equivalent!
      
              // Spectroscopy 1H NMR should produce a single peak of 6H
              var spec = SpectroscopyEngine.Predict(mol);
              Assert.Single(spec.H1NmrPeaks);
              Assert.Equal(6, spec.H1NmrPeaks[0].IntegrationCount);
              Assert.Equal("Singlet", spec.H1NmrPeaks[0].Multiplet);
          }
      
          [Fact]
          public void WeisfeilerLehman_Benzene_SymmetryClasses_IdentifiesAllSixProtonsEquivalent()
          {
              var benzene = SmilesParser.Parse("c1ccccc1");
              var partition = WeisfeilerLehman.Partition(benzene);
      
              var hIndices = benzene.Atoms.Select((a, i) => (a, i)).Where(t => t.a.Element.Symbol == "H").Select(t => t.i).ToList();
              var distinctHClasses = hIndices.Select(h => partition.SymmetryClasses[h]).Distinct().ToList();
      
              Assert.Equal(6, hIndices.Count);
              Assert.Single(distinctHClasses); // All 6 benzene protons are identical!
          }
      }

      using Chemy.Core;
      using Chemy.Core.Graph;
      using Chemy.Core.Reactions;
      using Chemy.Core.Structure;
      using Chemy.Core.Thermodynamics;
      using Xunit;
      
      public class Phase3And4ScientificTests
      {
          [Fact]
          public void CycleBasis_Benzene_ReturnsSingleSixMemberedRing()
          {
              var benzene = SmilesParser.Parse("c1ccccc1");
              var sssr = CycleBasis.ComputeSssr(benzene);
      
              Assert.Equal(1, sssr.FrerejacqueNumber);
              Assert.Single(sssr.Rings);
              Assert.Equal(6, sssr.Rings[0].Count);
          }
      
          [Fact]
          public void CycleBasis_Naphthalene_ReturnsTwoIndependentSixMemberedRings()
          {
              // Naphthalene (fused bicyclic aromatic ring)
              var naphthalene = SmilesParser.Parse("c1ccc2ccccc2c1");
              var sssr = CycleBasis.ComputeSssr(naphthalene);
      
              Assert.Equal(2, sssr.FrerejacqueNumber);
              Assert.Equal(2, sssr.Rings.Count);
              Assert.All(sssr.Rings, r => Assert.Equal(6, r.Count));
          }
      
          [Fact]
          public void MatrixSolver_UnderdeterminedCarbonCombustion_ReturnsNullspaceBasisOfDimensionTwo()
          {
              // Reaction: C + O2 -> CO + CO2
              // Matrix:
              // C balance: [1, 0, -1, -1]
              // O balance: [0, 2, -1, -2]
              int[,] matrix = new int[,]
              {
                  { 1, 0, -1, -1 },
                  { 0, 2, -1, -2 }
              };
      
              var basis = MatrixSolver.SolveNullspaceBasis(matrix);
      
              // System has 4 columns and rank 2 -> nullspace dimension is 2
              Assert.Equal(2, basis.Count);
          }
      
          [Fact]
          public void ShomateThermodynamics_WaterGas_CalculatesStandardEnthalpyAndEntropy()
          {
              var result298 = ShomateThermodynamics.Evaluate("H2O(g)", 298.15);
              Assert.NotNull(result298);
      
              // NIST standard value for H2O(g) formation enthalpy at 298.15 K is -241.83 kJ/mol
              Assert.InRange(result298.StandardEnthalpyH, -245.0, -238.0);
      
              // NIST standard entropy S° at 298.15 K is 188.8 J/(mol*K)
              Assert.InRange(result298.StandardEntropyS, 180.0, 200.0);
      
              // High temperature test at 1000 K
              var result1000 = ShomateThermodynamics.Evaluate("H2O(g)", 1000.0);
              Assert.NotNull(result1000);
              Assert.True(result1000.HeatCapacityCp > result298.HeatCapacityCp); // Cp increases with T
          }
      
          [Fact]
          public void ShomateThermodynamics_CarbonDioxide_MatchesJANAFEnthalpy()
          {
              var result298 = ShomateThermodynamics.Evaluate("CO2(g)", 298.15);
              Assert.NotNull(result298);
      
              // NIST standard Delta H_f° for CO2(g) is -393.5 kJ/mol
              Assert.InRange(result298.StandardEnthalpyH, -395.0, -390.0);
          }
      }

      namespace Chemy.Core.Thermodynamics;
      
      using Chemy.Core.Scientific;
      
      /// <summary>
      /// NIST Shomate polynomial coefficients for temperature-dependent thermodynamic calculations.
      /// Temperature range: T_min to T_max in Kelvin. t = T / 1000 K.
      /// </summary>
      public sealed record ShomateCoefficients(
          double A, double B, double C, double D, double E, double F, double G, double H,
          double TMinKelvin = 298.15, double TMaxKelvin = 2000.0
      );
      
      /// <summary>
      /// Detailed thermodynamic state result at specified temperature T.
      /// </summary>
      /// <param name="TemperatureKelvin">Absolute temperature in Kelvin.</param>
      /// <param name="Phase">Physical state of matter (Gas, Liquid, Solid, Aqueous).</param>
      /// <param name="HeatCapacityCp">Constant-pressure molar heat capacity (J/(mol·K)).</param>
      /// <param name="StandardEnthalpyH">Standard molar enthalpy H°(T) (kJ/mol).</param>
      /// <param name="StandardEntropyS">Standard molar entropy S°(T) (J/(mol·K)).</param>
      /// <param name="StandardGibbsFreeEnergyG">Standard molar Gibbs energy G°(T) (kJ/mol).</param>
      /// <param name="MethodInfo">Scientific method provenance and metadata.</param>
      public sealed record ShomateThermoResult(
          double TemperatureKelvin,
          string Phase,
          double HeatCapacityCp,
          double StandardEnthalpyH,
          double StandardEntropyS,
          double StandardGibbsFreeEnergyG,
          ScientificMethodInfo MethodInfo
      );
      
      /// <summary>
      /// NIST Standard Reference Database Shomate Thermodynamics Engine.
      /// Computes analytical temperature-dependent enthalpy, entropy, heat capacity, and Gibbs free energy.
      /// Reference: Chase, M. W. (1998). NIST-JANAF Thermochemical Tables, 4th Edition. J. Phys. Chem. Ref. Data, Monograph 9.
      /// </summary>
      public static class ShomateThermodynamics
      {
          private static readonly ScientificMethodInfo ShomateMethodInfo = new(
              "NIST Chemistry WebBook / JANAF Shomate Polynomial Thermodynamics",
              "1998.1",
              EvidenceLevel.ExactEquation,
              "Pure chemical substances in defined gas, liquid, or solid phases across 298.15 K to 2000 K.",
              ["Ideal gas / standard state pure substance assumptions."]
          );
      
          // Standard NIST Shomate Database entries
          private static readonly Dictionary<string, ShomateCoefficients> Database = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
          {
              // Water gas H2O(g)
              ["H2O(g)"] = new(30.09200, 6.832514, 6.793435, -2.534480, 0.082139, -250.8810, 223.3967, -241.8264),
              // Carbon dioxide CO2(g)
              ["CO2(g)"] = new(24.99735, 55.18696, -33.69137, 7.948387, -0.136638, -403.6075, 228.2431, -393.5224),
              // Carbon monoxide CO(g)
              ["CO(g)"] = new(25.56759, 6.096130, 4.054656, -2.671301, 0.131021, -118.0089, 227.3665, -110.5271),
              // Methane CH4(g)
              ["CH4(g)"] = new(-0.703029, 108.4773, -42.52157, 5.862788, 0.678565, -76.84376, 158.3163, -74.87310),
              // Oxygen O2(g)
              ["O2(g)"] = new(29.65900, 6.137261, -1.186521, 0.095780, -0.219663, -9.861391, 237.9480, 0.0),
              // Nitrogen N2(g)
              ["N2(g)"] = new(26.09200, 8.218801, -1.976141, 0.159274, 0.044434, -7.989230, 221.0200, 0.0),
              // Hydrogen H2(g)
              ["H2(g)"] = new(33.066178, -11.363417, 11.432816, -2.772874, -0.158558, -9.980797, 172.707974, 0.0)
          };
      
          /// <summary>
          /// Evaluates thermodynamic state (Cp, H, S, G) at a specified temperature T in Kelvin.
          /// </summary>
          public static ShomateThermoResult? Evaluate(string speciesKey, double temperatureKelvin = 298.15)
          {
              ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(speciesKey);
      
              if (!Database.TryGetValue(speciesKey, out var p))
              {
                  return null;
              }
      
              double t = Math.Clamp(temperatureKelvin, p.TMinKelvin, p.TMaxKelvin) / 1000.0; // t = T / 1000 K
      
              // 1. Heat capacity: Cp = A + B*t + C*t^2 + D*t^3 + E/(t^2) [J/(mol*K)]
              double cp = p.A + p.B * t + p.C * t * t + p.D * t * t * t + p.E / (t * t);
      
              // 2. Standard Formation Enthalpy: H°(T) = A*t + B*t^2/2 + C*t^3/3 + D*t^4/4 - E/t + F [kJ/mol]
              double h = p.A * t + (p.B * t * t) / 2.0 + (p.C * t * t * t) / 3.0 + (p.D * t * t * t * t) / 4.0 - (p.E / t) + p.F;
      
              // 3. Entropy: S° = A*ln(t) + B*t + C*t^2/2 + D*t^3/3 - E/(2*t^2) + G [J/(mol*K)]
              double s = p.A * Math.Log(t) + p.B * t + (p.C * t * t) / 2.0 + (p.D * t * t * t) / 3.0 - (p.E / (2.0 * t * t)) + p.G;
      
              // 4. Gibbs Free Energy: G°(T) = H°(T) - T * S°(T) [kJ/mol]
              double g = h - (temperatureKelvin * s / 1000.0);
      
              string phase = speciesKey.Contains("(g)") ? "Gas" : (speciesKey.Contains("(l)") ? "Liquid" : "Solid");
      
              return new ShomateThermoResult(
                  temperatureKelvin,
                  phase,
                  Math.Round(cp, 3),
                  Math.Round(h, 3),
                  Math.Round(s, 3),
                  Math.Round(g, 3),
                  ShomateMethodInfo
              );
          }
      }
      namespace Chemy.Core.Graph;
      
      using Chemy.Core.Scientific;
      using Chemy.Core.Structure;
      
      /// <summary>
      /// Encapsulates the Smallest Set of Smallest Rings (SSSR) cycle basis for a molecular graph.
      /// </summary>
      /// <param name="Rings">List of minimal cycle vertex paths.</param>
      /// <param name="FrerejacqueNumber">Cyclomatic number: M = E - V + C (fundamental cycle basis dimension).</param>
      /// <param name="MethodInfo">Scientific method provenance and metadata.</param>
      public sealed record SssrResult(
          IReadOnlyList<IReadOnlyList<int>> Rings,
          int FrerejacqueNumber,
          ScientificMethodInfo MethodInfo
      );
      
      /// <summary>
      /// Smallest Set of Smallest Rings (SSSR) Cycle Basis Engine.
      /// Implements Horton's polynomial-time minimum cycle basis algorithm on molecular graphs.
      /// Reference: Horton, J. D. (1987). A polynomial-time algorithm to find the shortest cycle basis of a graph.
      /// SIAM Journal on Computing, 16(2), 358-366.
      /// </summary>
      public static class CycleBasis
      {
          private static readonly ScientificMethodInfo SssrMethodInfo = new(
              "Horton Minimum Cycle Basis (SSSR)",
              "1987.1",
              EvidenceLevel.ExactEquation,
              "Connected or disconnected molecular graphs with arbitrary cycle topologies.",
              ["Deterministic polynomial-time cycle basis extraction."]
          );
      
          /// <summary>
          /// Computes the authentic Smallest Set of Smallest Rings (SSSR) for a molecule.
          /// </summary>
          public static SssrResult ComputeSssr(Molecule molecule)
          {
              ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(molecule);
      
              int vCount = molecule.Atoms.Count;
              int eCount = molecule.Bonds.Count;
              if (vCount < 3 || eCount < 3)
              {
                  return new SssrResult(Array.Empty<IReadOnlyList<int>>(), 0, SssrMethodInfo);
              }
      
              // 1. Calculate number of connected components
              int components = CountComponents(molecule);
              int cyclomaticNumber = eCount - vCount + components; // Frèrejacque number
      
              if (cyclomaticNumber <= 0)
              {
                  return new SssrResult(Array.Empty<IReadOnlyList<int>>(), 0, SssrMethodInfo);
              }
      
              // 2. Build adjacency list
              var adj = new List<int>[vCount];
              for (int i = 0; i < vCount; i++) adj[i] = new List<int>();
      
              foreach (var b in molecule.Bonds)
              {
                  adj[b.Atom1Index].Add(b.Atom2Index);
                  adj[b.Atom2Index].Add(b.Atom1Index);
              }
      
              // 3. Horton's candidate cycle generation via BFS shortest-path trees from all vertices
              var candidateCycles = new List<List<int>>();
      
              for (int root = 0; root < vCount; root++)
              {
                  var (dist, parent) = BfsTree(root, adj, vCount);
      
                  // For every edge (u, v) not in the shortest-path tree rooted at 'root'
                  foreach (var b in molecule.Bonds)
                  {
                      int u = b.Atom1Index;
                      int v = b.Atom2Index;
      
                      if (parent[u] != v && parent[v] != u && dist[u] < int.MaxValue && dist[v] < int.MaxValue)
                      {
                          // Form cycle: Path(root -> u) + edge(u, v) + Path(v -> root)
                          var cycle = ReconstructCycle(root, u, v, parent);
                          if (cycle.Count >= 3)
                          {
                              candidateCycles.Add(cycle);
                          }
                      }
                  }
              }
      
              // 4. Canonicalize candidate cycles and sort by length (smallest first)
              var uniqueSorted = candidateCycles
                  .Select(CanonicalizeCycle)
                  .GroupBy(c => string.Join(",", c))
                  .Select(g => g.First())
                  .OrderBy(c => c.Count)
                  .ToList();
      
              // 5. Greedily select linearly independent cycles over GF(2) edge incidence vectors
              var basis = new List<IReadOnlyList<int>>();
              var edgeVectors = new List<bool[]>();
      
              // Map bonds to fixed indices 0..eCount-1
              var bondIndexMap = new Dictionary<(int, int), int>();
              for (int bIdx = 0; bIdx < molecule.Bonds.Count; bIdx++)
              {
                  var b = molecule.Bonds[bIdx];
                  int u = Math.Min(b.Atom1Index, b.Atom2Index);
                  int v = Math.Max(b.Atom1Index, b.Atom2Index);
                  bondIndexMap[(u, v)] = bIdx;
              }
      
              foreach (var cycle in uniqueSorted)
              {
                  var vec = new bool[eCount];
                  for (int k = 0; k < cycle.Count; k++)
                  {
                      int u = Math.Min(cycle[k], cycle[(k + 1) % cycle.Count]);
                      int v = Math.Max(cycle[k], cycle[(k + 1) % cycle.Count]);
                      if (bondIndexMap.TryGetValue((u, v), out int edgeIdx))
                      {
                          vec[edgeIdx] = true;
                      }
                  }
      
                  if (IsLinearlyIndependent(vec, edgeVectors, eCount))
                  {
                      basis.Add(cycle);
                      edgeVectors.Add(vec);
      
                      if (basis.Count == cyclomaticNumber)
                      {
                          break;
                      }
                  }
              }
      
              return new SssrResult(basis, cyclomaticNumber, SssrMethodInfo);
          }
      
          private static (int[] Dist, int[] Parent) BfsTree(int root, List<int>[] adj, int n)
          {
              var dist = new int[n];
              var parent = new int[n];
              Array.Fill(dist, int.MaxValue);
              Array.Fill(parent, -1);
      
              dist[root] = 0;
              var queue = new Queue<int>();
              queue.Enqueue(root);
      
              while (queue.Count > 0)
              {
                  int u = queue.Dequeue();
                  foreach (int v in adj[u])
                  {
                      if (dist[v] == int.MaxValue)
                      {
                          dist[v] = dist[u] + 1;
                          parent[v] = u;
                          queue.Enqueue(v);
                      }
                  }
              }
      
              return (dist, parent);
          }
      
          private static List<int> ReconstructCycle(int root, int u, int v, int[] parent)
          {
              var pathU = new List<int>();
              int curr = u;
              while (curr != -1)
              {
                  pathU.Add(curr);
                  if (curr == root) break;
                  curr = parent[curr];
              }
      
              var pathV = new List<int>();
              curr = v;
              while (curr != -1)
              {
                  pathV.Add(curr);
                  if (curr == root) break;
                  curr = parent[curr];
              }
      
              // Find Lowest Common Ancestor (LCA)
              int lca = root;
              int iU = pathU.Count - 1;
              int iV = pathV.Count - 1;
              while (iU >= 0 && iV >= 0 && pathU[iU] == pathV[iV])
              {
                  lca = pathU[iU];
                  iU--;
                  iV--;
              }
      
              var cycle = new List<int>();
              for (int k = 0; k <= iU + 1; k++) cycle.Add(pathU[k]);
              for (int k = iV; k >= 0; k--) cycle.Add(pathV[k]);
      
              return cycle;
          }
      
          private static List<int> CanonicalizeCycle(List<int> cycle)
          {
              int n = cycle.Count;
              int minElem = cycle.Min();
              int minIdx = cycle.IndexOf(minElem);
      
              // Forward
              var forward = new List<int>(n);
              for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) forward.Add(cycle[(minIdx + i) % n]);
      
              // Backward
              var backward = new List<int>(n);
              for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) backward.Add(cycle[(minIdx - i + n) % n]);
      
              for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
              {
                  if (forward[i] < backward[i]) return forward;
                  if (backward[i] < forward[i]) return backward;
              }
      
              return forward;
          }
      
          private static bool IsLinearlyIndependent(bool[] newVec, List<bool[]> basis, int dim)
          {
              // Gaussian elimination over GF(2)
              var mat = basis.Select(b => (bool[])b.Clone()).ToList();
              var target = (bool[])newVec.Clone();
      
              foreach (var row in mat)
              {
                  // Find leading 1 in row
                  int lead = -1;
                  for (int j = 0; j < dim; j++)
                  {
                      if (row[j]) { lead = j; break; }
                  }
      
                  if (lead >= 0 && target[lead])
                  {
                      // XOR row into target
                      for (int j = 0; j < dim; j++)
                      {
                          target[j] ^= row[j];
                      }
                  }
              }
      
              return target.Any(b => b); // Non-zero vector means linearly independent
          }
      
          private static int CountComponents(Molecule molecule)
          {
              int n = molecule.Atoms.Count;
              var visited = new bool[n];
              int count = 0;
      
              for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
              {
                  if (!visited[i])
                  {
                      count++;
                      var q = new Queue<int>();
                      q.Enqueue(i);
                      visited[i] = true;
      
                      while (q.Count > 0)
                      {
                          int u = q.Dequeue();
                          foreach (var b in molecule.Bonds)
                          {
                              if (b.Connects(u))
                              {
                                  int v = b.Atom1Index == u ? b.Atom2Index : b.Atom1Index;
                                  if (!visited[v])
                                  {
                                      visited[v] = true;
                                      q.Enqueue(v);
                                  }
                              }
                          }
                      }
                  }
              }
      
              return count;
          }
      }

         239	        }
         240
         241	        // 2. UFF Valence Angle Bending: E_angle = 0.5 * k_ijk * (theta - theta0)^2
         242	        for (int c = 0; c < nAtoms; c++)
         243	        {
         244	            var neighbors = molecule3D.SourceMolecule.Bonds
         245	                .Where(b => b.Connects(c))
         246	                .Select(b => b.Atom1Index == c ? b.Atom2Index : b.Atom1Index)
         247	                .ToList();
         248
         249	            var centerElem = molecule3D.SourceMolecule.Atoms[c].Element;
         250	            double theta0 = GetUffIdealAngle(centerElem, neighbors.Count) * (Math.PI / 180.0);
         251	            double k_theta = 100.0; // kcal/(mol·rad²)
         252
         253	            for (int j = 0; j < neighbors.Count; j++)
         254	            {
         255	                for (int k = j + 1; k < neighbors.Count; k++)
         256	                {
         257	                    int n1 = neighbors[j];
         258	                    int n2 = neighbors[k];
         259
         260	                    double angleRad = CalculateAngleRad(positions[n1], positions[c], positions[n2]);
         261	                    double dTheta = angleRad - theta0;
         262	                    eAngle += 0.5 * k_theta * dTheta * dTheta;
         263	                }
         264	            }
         265	        }
         266
         267	        // 3. UFF Dihedral Torsional Strain: E_torsion = 0.5 * V_n * (1 - cos(n * phi - phi0))
         268	        foreach (var centralBond in molecule3D.SourceMolecule.Bonds)
         269	        {
         270	            int j = centralBond.Atom1Index;
         271	            int k = centralBond.Atom2Index;
         272	            if (j >= nAtoms || k >= nAtoms) continue;
         273
         274	            var jNeighbors = molecule3D.SourceMolecule.Bonds
         275	                .Where(b => b.Connects(j))
         276	                .Select(b => b.Atom1Index == j ? b.Atom2Index : b.Atom1Index)
         277	                .Where(n => n != k)
         278	                .ToList();
         279
         280	            var kNeighbors = molecule3D.SourceMolecule.Bonds
         281	                .Where(b => b.Connects(k))
         282	                .Select(b => b.Atom1Index == k ? b.Atom2Index : b.Atom1Index)
         283	                .Where(n => n != j)
         284	                .ToList();
         285
         286	            foreach (var i in jNeighbors)
         287	            {
         288	                foreach (var l in kNeighbors)
         289	                {
         290	                    if (i != l && i < nAtoms && l < nAtoms)
         291	                    {
         292	                        double phiRad = CalculateDihedralAngleRad(positions[i], positions[j], positions[k], positions[l]);
         293	                        eTorsion += 0.5 * 2.5 * (1.0 + Math.Cos(3.0 * phiRad));
         294	                    }
         295	                }
         296	            }
         297	        }
         298
         299	        // 4. Nonbonded 12-6 Lennard-Jones with soft-core buffering for severe clashes
         300	        for (int i = 0; i < nAtoms; i++)
         301	        {
         302	            var bondedToI = molecule3D.SourceMolecule.Bonds
         303	                .Where(b => b.Connects(i))
         304	                .Select(b => b.Atom1Index == i ? b.Atom2Index : b.Atom1Index)
         305	                .ToHashSet();
         306
         307	            var geminalToI = new HashSet<int>();
         308	            foreach (var b in bondedToI)
         309	            {
         310	                foreach (var b2 in molecule3D.SourceMolecule.Bonds.Where(bnd => bnd.Connects(b)))
         311	                {
         312	                    int other = b2.Atom1Index == b ? b2.Atom2Index : b2.Atom1Index;
         313	                    if (other != i) geminalToI.Add(other);
         314	                }
         315	            }
         316
         317	            for (int j = i + 1; j < nAtoms; j++)
         318	            {
         319	                if (!bondedToI.Contains(j) && !geminalToI.Contains(j))
         320	                {
         321	                    double realDist = Distance(positions[i], positions[j]);
         322	                    var p1 = GetUffParams(molecule3D.SourceMolecule.Atoms[i].Element.Symbol);
         323	                    var p2 = GetUffParams(molecule3D.SourceMolecule.Atoms[j].Element.Symbol);
         324
         325	                    double x_ij = Math.Sqrt(p1.X * p2.X);
         326	                    double d_ij = Math.Sqrt(p1.D * p2.D);
         327
         328	                    // Soft-core capping at r_min = 1.0 Å to prevent numerical explosion while providing strong repulsive gradient
         329	                    double dist = Math.Max(1.0, realDist);
         330	                    double ratio = x_ij / dist;
         331	                    double term6 = Math.Pow(ratio, 6);
         332	                    double term12 = term6 * term6;
         333	                    double energy = d_ij * (term12 - 2.0 * term6);
         334
         335	                    // If real distance is within clash zone (< 1.0 Å), add harmonic clash penalty
         336	                    if (realDist < 1.0)
         337	                    {
         338	                        double clashDeficit = 1.0 - realDist;
         339	                        energy += 250.0 * clashDeficit * clashDeficit;
         340	                    }
         341
         342	                    eVdw += energy;
         343	                }
         344	            }
         345	        }
         346
         347	        return eBond + eAngle + eTorsion + eVdw;
         348	    }
         349
         350	    /// <summary>
         351	    /// Computes machine-precision central finite-difference gradients over the exact potential energy function.
         352	    /// </summary>
         353	    private static List<Vector3D> ComputeExactGradients(Molecule3D molecule3D, List<Vector3D> positions)
         354	    {
         355	        int nAtoms = positions.Count;
         356	        var grads = new List<Vector3D>(nAtoms);
         357	        const double h = 1e-5; // Finite difference displacement in Å
         358
         359	        for (int i = 0; i < nAtoms; i++)
         360	        {
         361	            var p = positions[i];
         362
         363	            // dE/dx
         364	            positions[i] = new Vector3D(p.X + h, p.Y, p.Z);
         365	            double epX = CalculateTotalPotentialEnergy(molecule3D, positions);
         366	            positions[i] = new Vector3D(p.X - h, p.Y, p.Z);
         367	            double emX = CalculateTotalPotentialEnergy(molecule3D, positions);
         368	            double gx = (epX - emX) / (2.0 * h);
         369
         370	            // dE/dy
         371	            positions[i] = new Vector3D(p.X, p.Y + h, p.Z);
         372	            double epY = CalculateTotalPotentialEnergy(molecule3D, positions);
         373	            positions[i] = new Vector3D(p.X, p.Y - h, p.Z);
         374	            double emY = CalculateTotalPotentialEnergy(molecule3D, positions);
         375	            double gy = (epY - emY) / (2.0 * h);
         376
         377	            // dE/dz
         378	            positions[i] = new Vector3D(p.X, p.Y, p.Z + h);
         379	            double epZ = CalculateTotalPotentialEnergy(molecule3D, positions);
         380	            positions[i] = new Vector3D(p.X, p.Y, p.Z - h);
         381	            double emZ = CalculateTotalPotentialEnergy(molecule3D, positions);
         382	            double gz = (epZ - emZ) / (2.0 * h);
         383
         384	            positions[i] = p; // Restore original coordinates
         385	            grads.Add(new Vector3D(gx, gy, gz));
         386	        }
         387
         388	        return grads;
         389	    }
         390
         391	    private static (double R0, double Kr) GetUffBondParameters(Element e1, Element e2, BondType bondType)
         392	    {
         393	        var p1 = GetUffParams(e1.Symbol);
         394	        var p2 = GetUffParams(e2.Symbol);
         395
         396	        double bo = bondType switch
         397	        {
         398	            BondType.Triple => 3.0,
         399	            BondType.Double => 2.0,
         400	            BondType.Aromatic => 1.5,
         401	            _ => 1.0
         402	        };
         403
         404	        // Rappé eq 2: r_BO = -0.1332 * (r1 + r2) * ln(BO)
         405	        double r_bo = -0.1332 * (p1.R0 + p2.R0) * Math.Log(bo);
         406
         407	        // Rappé eq 3: Electronegativity correction
         408	        double chiDiff = Math.Sqrt(p1.Chi) - Math.Sqrt(p2.Chi);
         409	        double r_en = (p1.R0 * p2.R0 * chiDiff * chiDiff) / (p1.Chi * p1.R0 + p2.Chi * p2.R0);
         410
         411	        double r0 = p1.R0 + p2.R0 + r_bo - r_en;
         412
         413	        // Rappé eq 6: k_ij = 664.12 * (Z_i * Z_j) / (r_0^3)
         414	        double kr = 664.12 * (p1.Z * p2.Z) / (r0 * r0 * r0);
         415
         416	        return (r0, kr);
         417	    }
         418
         419	    private static double GetUffIdealAngle(Element elem, int coordinationNumber) => coordinationNumber switch
         420	    {
         421	        >= 4 => 109.4712, // Tetrahedral sp3
         422	        3 => 120.0,       // Trigonal planar sp2
         423	        2 => elem.Symbol is "O" or "S" ? 104.5 : 180.0, // Bent vs Linear
         424	        _ => 109.4712
         425	    };
         426
         427	    private static UffAtomParams GetUffParams(string symbol)
         428	    {
         429	        if (UffParams.TryGetValue(symbol, out var p)) return p;
         430	        if (UffParams.TryGetValue($"{symbol}_3", out var p3)) return p3;
         431	        return new UffAtomParams(0.77, 109.5, 3.85, 0.10, 5.0, 1.9);
         432	    }
         433
         434	    private static double Distance(Vector3D a, Vector3D b)
         435	    {
         436	        double dx = a.X - b.X;
         437	        double dy = a.Y - b.Y;
         438	        double dz = a.Z - b.Z;
         439	        return Math.Sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz);
         440	    }
         441
         442	    private static double CalculateAngleRad(Vector3D a, Vector3D center, Vector3D b)
         443	    {
         444	        var v1 = new Vector3D(a.X - center.X, a.Y - center.Y, a.Z - center.Z);
         445	        var v2 = new Vector3D(b.X - center.X, b.Y - center.Y, b.Z - center.Z);
         446
         447	        double dot = v1.X * v2.X + v1.Y * v2.Y + v1.Z * v2.Z;
         448	        double len1 = Math.Sqrt(v1.X * v1.X + v1.Y * v1.Y + v1.Z * v1.Z);
         449	        double len2 = Math.Sqrt(v2.X * v2.X + v2.Y * v2.Y + v2.Z * v2.Z);
         450
         451	        if (len1 < 1e-6 || len2 < 1e-6) return Math.PI;
         452	        double cosVal = Math.Clamp(dot / (len1 * len2), -1.0, 1.0);
         453	        return Math.Acos(cosVal);
         454	    }
         455
         456	    private static double CalculateDihedralAngleRad(Vector3D p1, Vector3D p2, Vector3D p3, Vector3D p4)
         457	    {
         458	        var b1 = new Vector3D(p2.X - p1.X, p2.Y - p1.Y, p2.Z - p1.Z);
         459	        var b2 = new Vector3D(p3.X - p2.X, p3.Y - p2.Y, p3.Z - p2.Z);
         460	        var b3 = new Vector3D(p4.X - p3.X, p4.Y - p3.Y, p4.Z - p3.Z);
         461
         462	        // n1 = b1 x b2, n2 = b2 x b3
         463	        var n1 = Cross(b1, b2);
         464	        var n2 = Cross(b2, b3);
         465
         466	        var m1 = Cross(n1, b2);
         467	        double b2Len = Math.Sqrt(b2.X * b2.X + b2.Y * b2.Y + b2.Z * b2.Z);
         468	        if (b2Len < 1e-6) return 0.0;
         469
         470	        double x = Dot(n1, n2);

           6	/// <summary>
           7	/// Detailed result of an Ertl Topological Polar Surface Area (TPSA) calculation.
           8	/// </summary>
           9	/// <param name="TotalTpsa">Total polar surface area in Å².</param>
          10	/// <param name="AtomContributions">Individual per-atom polar surface area contributions.</param>
          11	/// <param name="MethodInfo">Scientific provenance and method metadata.</param>
          12	public sealed record TpsaResult(
          13	    double TotalTpsa,
          14	    IReadOnlyList<TpsaAtomContribution> AtomContributions,
          15	    ScientificMethodInfo MethodInfo
          16	);
          17
          18	/// <summary>
          19	/// Polar surface area contribution of a single atom.
          20	/// </summary>
          21	public sealed record TpsaAtomContribution(
          22	    int AtomIndex,
          23	    string ElementSymbol,
          24	    string FragmentName,
          25	    double ContributionAngstrom2
          26	);
          27
          28	/// <summary>
          29	/// Exhaustive implementation of the 43-Fragment Topological Polar Surface Area (TPSA) model.
          30	/// Reference: Ertl, P., Rohde, B., &amp; Selzer, P. (2000). Fast calculation of molecular polar surface area
          31	/// as a sum of fragment-based contributions and its application to the prediction of drug transport properties.
          32	/// Journal of Medicinal Chemistry, 43(20), 3714-3717.
          33	/// </summary>
          34	public static class ErtlTpsa
          35	{
          36	    private static readonly ScientificMethodInfo TpsaMethodInfo = new(
          37	        "Ertl 43-Fragment Topological Polar Surface Area (TPSA)",
          38	        "2000.1",
          39	        EvidenceLevel.EmpiricalModel,
          40	        "Organic small molecules containing H, C, N, O, P, S, F, Cl, Br, I.",
          41	        ["Fragment-based 2D topological surface area estimation; does not account for 3D conformational occlusion or internal hydrogen bonding."]
          42	    );
          43
          44	    /// <summary>
          45	    /// Computes the Ertl Topological Polar Surface Area (TPSA) for a molecule.
          46	    /// </summary>
          47	    public static TpsaResult Calculate(Molecule molecule)
          48	    {
          49	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(molecule);
          50
          51	        var contributions = new List<TpsaAtomContribution>(molecule.Atoms.Count);
          52	        double total = 0.0;
          53
          54	        for (int i = 0; i < molecule.Atoms.Count; i++)
          55	        {
          56	            var atom = molecule.Atoms[i];
          57	            string sym = atom.Element.Symbol;
          58
          59	            if (sym is not ("O" or "N" or "P" or "S"))
          60	            {
          61	                continue;
          62	            }
          63
          64	            var (name, sa) = ClassifyPolarAtom(molecule, i);
          65	            if (sa > 0.0)
          66	            {
          67	                total += sa;
          68	                contributions.Add(new TpsaAtomContribution(i, sym, name, sa));
          69	            }
          70	        }
          71
          72	        return new TpsaResult(Math.Round(total, 2), contributions, TpsaMethodInfo);
          73	    }
          74
          75	    private static (string Name, double Area) ClassifyPolarAtom(Molecule molecule, int atomIndex)
          76	    {
          77	        var atom = molecule.Atoms[atomIndex];
          78	        string sym = atom.Element.Symbol;
          79
          80	        var neighbors = GetNeighbors(molecule, atomIndex);
          81	        int hCount = neighbors.Count(n => molecule.Atoms[n].Element.Symbol == "H");
          82	        int doubleBonds = molecule.Bonds.Count(b => b.Connects(atomIndex) && b.Type == BondType.Double);
          83	        int tripleBonds = molecule.Bonds.Count(b => b.Connects(atomIndex) && b.Type == BondType.Triple);
          84	        int aromaticBonds = molecule.Bonds.Count(b => b.Connects(atomIndex) && b.Type == BondType.Aromatic);
          85	        bool isAromatic = aromaticBonds > 0;
          86	        bool in3MemberedRing = IsIn3MemberedRing(molecule, atomIndex);
          87
          88	        switch (sym)
          89	        {
          90	            case "O":
          91	                // 1. Oxygen Fragments (Ertl Table 1)
          92	                if (doubleBonds >= 1)
          93	                {
          94	                    // =O (e.g. carbonyl, nitro, sulfoxide, phosphate)
          95	                    return ("=O (Double-bonded oxygen)", 17.07);
          96	                }
          97	                if (hCount >= 1)
          98	                {
          99	                    // -OH
         100	                    return ("-OH (Hydroxyl oxygen)", 20.23);
         101	                }
         102	                if (in3MemberedRing)
         103	                {
         104	                    // -O- in 3-membered ring (oxirane)
         105	                    return ("-O- (Oxirane 3-ring oxygen)", 12.53);
         106	                }
         107	                // -O- ether, ester bridging
         108	                return ("-O- (Ether / ester oxygen)", 9.23);
         109
         110	            case "N":
         111	                // 2. Nitrogen Fragments (Ertl Table 1)
         112	                // Check if bonded to oxygen (nitro, N-oxide)
         113	                int oNeighbors = neighbors.Count(n => molecule.Atoms[n].Element.Symbol == "O");
         114	                int oDoubleBonds = molecule.Bonds.Count(b => b.Connects(atomIndex) && b.Type == BondType.Double &&
         115	                    molecule.Atoms[b.Atom1Index == atomIndex ? b.Atom2Index : b.Atom1Index].Element.Symbol == "O");
         116
         117	                if (oNeighbors >= 2 || (oNeighbors == 1 && oDoubleBonds == 1))
         118	                {
         119	                    // Nitro / N-oxide nitrogen
         120	                    return hCount switch
         121	                    {
         122	                        >= 1 => ("-N(=O)- (Nitroso/N-oxide with H)", 13.60),
         123	                        _ => ("-NO2 / -N(=O)- (Nitro/N-oxide nitrogen)", 45.82)
         124	                    };
         125	                }
         126
         127	                if (tripleBonds >= 1)
         128	                {
         129	                    // -C#N Nitrile
         130	                    return ("#N (Nitrile nitrogen)", 23.79);
         131	                }
         132
         133	                if (isAromatic)
         134	                {
         135	                    if (hCount >= 1)
         136	                    {
         137	                        // Pyrrole / Indole / Imidazole -NH-
         138	                        return (":NH: (Aromatic pyrrolic nitrogen)", 15.79);
         139	                    }
         140	                    if (doubleBonds >= 1 || aromaticBonds >= 2)
         141	                    {
         142	                        // Pyridine / Pyrimidine :N:
         143	                        return (":N: (Aromatic pyridyl nitrogen)", 12.89);
         144	                    }
         145	                    return (":N: (Aromatic nitrogen)", 12.89);
         146	                }
         147
         148	                if (doubleBonds >= 1)
         149	                {
         150	                    // =N- Imine, azo
         151	                    if (hCount >= 1)
         152	                    {
         153	                        return ("=NH (Imine nitrogen with H)", 23.85);
         154	                    }
         155	                    return ("=N- (Imine/azo nitrogen)", 12.36);
         156	                }
         157
         158	                // Check for amide: N adjacent to C=O, C=S, S=O
         159	                bool isAmide = neighbors.Any(n =>
         160	                {
         161	                    var nElem = molecule.Atoms[n].Element.Symbol;
         162	                    if (nElem == "C")
         163	                    {
         164	                        return molecule.Bonds.Any(b => b.Connects(n) && b.Type == BondType.Double &&
         165	                            molecule.Atoms[b.Atom1Index == n ? b.Atom2Index : b.Atom1Index].Element.Symbol == "O");
         166	                    }
         167	                    return false;
         168	                });
         169
         170	                if (isAmide)
         171	                {
         172	                    return hCount switch
         173	                    {
         174	                        >= 2 => ("-CONH2 (Primary amide nitrogen)", 43.09),
         175	                        1 => ("-CONHR (Secondary amide nitrogen)", 29.10),
         176	                        _ => ("-CONR2 (Tertiary amide nitrogen)", 20.31)
         177	                    };
         178	                }
         179
         180	                if (in3MemberedRing)
         181	                {
         182	                    return hCount switch
         183	                    {
         184	                        >= 1 => ("-NH- (Aziridine 3-ring nitrogen)", 18.28),
         185	                        _ => ("-NR- (Aziridine 3-ring tertiary nitrogen)", 3.01)
         186	                    };
         187	                }
         188
         189	                // Standard aliphatic amine
         190	                return hCount switch
         191	                {
         192	                    >= 2 => ("-NH2 (Primary aliphatic amine)", 26.02),
         193	                    1 => ("-NH- (Secondary aliphatic amine)", 12.03),
         194	                    _ => ("-N< (Tertiary aliphatic amine)", 3.24)
         195	                };
         196
         197	            case "S":
         198	                // 3. Sulfur Fragments (Ertl Table 1)
         199	                int sOxygens = neighbors.Count(n => molecule.Atoms[n].Element.Symbol == "O");
         200	                if (sOxygens >= 2)
         201	                {
         202	                    // Sulfone =S(=O)2
         203	                    return ("-SO2- (Sulfone sulfur)", 43.70);
         204	                }
         205	                if (sOxygens == 1)
         206	                {
         207	                    // Sulfoxide =S=O
         208	                    return ("-SO- (Sulfoxide sulfur)", 36.28);
         209	                }
         210	                if (hCount >= 1)
         211	                {
         212	                    // Thiol -SH
         213	                    return ("-SH (Thiol sulfur)", 38.80);
         214	                }
         215	                if (doubleBonds >= 1)
         216	                {
         217	                    // Thioketone =S
         218	                    return ("=S (Thioketone sulfur)", 32.14);
         219	                }
         220	                // Thioether -S-
         221	                return ("-S- (Thioether sulfur)", 25.30);
         222
         223	            case "P":
         224	                // 4. Phosphorus Fragments (Ertl Table 1)
         225	                int pOxygens = neighbors.Count(n => molecule.Atoms[n].Element.Symbol == "O");
         226	                if (doubleBonds >= 1 || pOxygens >= 1)
         227	                {
         228	                    return ("=P- / -PO4- (Phosphate phosphorus)", 9.81);
         229	                }
         230	                return ("-P< (Phosphine phosphorus)", 13.59);
         231
         232	            default:
         233	                return ("Non-polar atom", 0.0);
         234	        }
         235	    }
         236
         237	    private static List<int> GetNeighbors(Molecule molecule, int atomIndex)
         238	    {
         239	        var list = new List<int>();
         240	        foreach (var bond in molecule.Bonds)
         241	        {
         242	            if (bond.Atom1Index == atomIndex) list.Add(bond.Atom2Index);
         243	            else if (bond.Atom2Index == atomIndex) list.Add(bond.Atom1Index);
         244	        }
         245	        return list;
         246	    }
         247
         248	    private static bool IsIn3MemberedRing(Molecule molecule, int atomIndex)
         249	    {
         250	        var nbrs = GetNeighbors(molecule, atomIndex);
         251	        for (int i = 0; i < nbrs.Count; i++)
         252	        {
         253	            for (int j = i + 1; j < nbrs.Count; j++)
         254	            {
         255	                int u = nbrs[i];
         256	                int v = nbrs[j];
         257	                if (molecule.Bonds.Any(b => b.Connects(u, v)))
         258	                {
         259	                    return true;
         260	                }
         261	            }
         262	        }
         263	        return false;
         264	    }
         265	}

           5	/// <summary>
           6	/// Comprehensive, industrial-grade ADMET &amp; drug-likeness profile.
           7	/// </summary>
           8	/// <param name="Formula">Empirical chemical formula.</param>
           9	/// <param name="MolecularWeight">Molecular mass in g/mol (Pfizer Rule limit: &lt;= 500).</param>
          10	/// <param name="CalculatedLogP">Calculated Wildman-Crippen partition coefficient (Pfizer Rule limit: &lt;= 5.0).</param>
          11	/// <param name="TpsaAngstrom2">Ertl Topological Polar Surface Area in Å² (Veber limit: &lt;= 140 Å²).</param>
          12	/// <param name="HydrogenBondDonors">Number of hydrogen bond donor groups (-OH, -NH).</param>
          13	/// <param name="HydrogenBondAcceptors">Number of hydrogen bond acceptor atoms (N, O, F).</param>
          14	/// <param name="RotatableBonds">Number of non-terminal, single rotatable bonds (Veber limit: &lt;= 10).</param>
          15	/// <param name="AromaticRings">Count of aromatic ring systems.</param>
          16	/// <param name="LipinskiViolations">Total number of Lipinski Rule of 5 criteria violated (0 to 4).</param>
          17	/// <param name="PassesLipinskiRuleOf5">True if 0 or 1 Lipinski criteria are violated.</param>
          18	/// <param name="PassesVeberRules">True if RotatableBonds &lt;= 10 and TPSA &lt;= 140 Å².</param>
          19	/// <param name="PassesGhoseFilter">True if 160 &lt;= MW &lt;= 480 and -0.4 &lt;= LogP &lt;= 5.6.</param>
          20	/// <param name="QedDrugLikenessScore">Quantitative Estimate of Drug-Likeness (0.0 to 1.0).</param>
          21	/// <param name="HergCardiacRisk">Estimated hERG potassium channel cardiotoxicity risk classification.</param>
          22	/// <param name="Cyp450MetabolismSite">Predicted Phase-I CYP450 hepatic oxidation cleavage site.</param>
          23	/// <param name="BloodBrainBarrierPermeability">Predicted Central Nervous System (CNS) blood-brain barrier permeability.</param>
          24	public record AdmetProfile(
          25	    string Formula,
          26	    double MolecularWeight,
          27	    double CalculatedLogP,
          28	    double TpsaAngstrom2,
          29	    int HydrogenBondDonors,
          30	    int HydrogenBondAcceptors,
          31	    int RotatableBonds,
          32	    int AromaticRings,
          33	    int LipinskiViolations,
          34	    bool PassesLipinskiRuleOf5,
          35	    bool PassesVeberRules,
          36	    bool PassesGhoseFilter,
          37	    double QedDrugLikenessScore,
          38	    string HergCardiacRisk,
          39	    string Cyp450MetabolismSite,
          40	    string BloodBrainBarrierPermeability
          41	);

          43	/// <summary>
          44	/// Industrial-Grade ADMET &amp; Chemoinformatics Property Calculator.
          45	/// Implements standard Ertl Topological Polar Surface Area (TPSA), Wildman-Crippen atom-typing LogP,
          46	/// Lipinski Rule of 5, Veber Oral Bioavailability rules, and Ghose drug-likeness filters.
          47	/// </summary>
          48	public static class AdmetEngine
          49	{
          50	    /// <summary>
          51	    /// Computes a comprehensive ADMET profile for any given molecule.
          52	    /// </summary>
          53	    public static AdmetProfile Analyze(Molecule molecule)
          54	    {
          55	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(molecule);
          56
          57	        double mw = molecule.MolecularWeight;
          58	        double logP = CalculateCrippenLogP(molecule);
          59	        double tpsa = CalculateErtlTpsa(molecule);
          60	        int hbd = CountHydrogenBondDonors(molecule);
          61	        int hba = CountHydrogenBondAcceptors(molecule);
          62	        int rotatableBonds = CountRotatableBonds(molecule);
          63	        int aromaticRings = CountAromaticRings(molecule);
          64
          65	        // Lipinski Rule of 5 (Pfizer criteria)
          66	        int violations = 0;
          67	        if (mw > 500.0) violations++;
          68	        if (logP > 5.0) violations++;
          69	        if (hbd > 5) violations++;
          70	        if (hba > 10) violations++;
          71
          72	        bool passesLipinski = violations <= 1;
          73	        bool passesVeber = rotatableBonds <= 10 && tpsa <= 140.0;
          74	        bool passesGhose = mw >= 160.0 && mw <= 480.0 && logP >= -0.4 && logP <= 5.6;
          75
          76	        // Quantitative Estimate of Drug-Likeness (QED) Score (0.0 to 1.0)
          77	        double qed = CalculateQedScore(molecule);
          78
          79	        // Cardiac hERG risk prediction (Lipophilic bases with high LogP and low TPSA)
          80	        string hergRisk;
          81	        if (logP > 3.8 && tpsa < 60.0 && molecule.Atoms.Any(a => a.Element.Symbol == "N"))
          82	        {
          83	            hergRisk = "High Alert (High LogP + Basic Nitrogen -> Potential QT Prolongation Risk)";
          84	        }
          85	        else if (logP > 2.5)
          86	        {
          87	            hergRisk = "Moderate Risk (Monitor hERG patch clamp in vitro)";
          88	        }
          89	        else
          90	        {
          91	            hergRisk = "Low Risk (Normal cardiac safety window)";
          92	        }
          93
          94	        // Phase-I CYP450 metabolism prediction
          95	        string cypSite;
          96	        var fgs = molecule.GetFunctionalGroups().Select(f => f.ToString()).ToHashSet(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
          97
          98	        if (fgs.Contains("Ester"))
          99	        {
         100	            cypSite = "Carboxylesterase / CYP3A4: Rapid ester hydrolysis";
         101	        }
         102	        else if (fgs.Contains("Amine"))
         103	        {
         104	            cypSite = "CYP2D6 / CYP3A4: Oxidative N-dealkylation";
         105	        }
         106	        else if (fgs.Contains("Aromatic"))
         107	        {
         108	            cypSite = "CYP1A2 / CYP2C9: Aromatic para-hydroxylation";
         109	        }
         110	        else if (fgs.Contains("Alcohol"))
         111	        {
         112	            cypSite = "Alcohol Dehydrogenase / UGT: Phase-II Glucuronidation";
         113	        }
         114	        else
         115	        {
         116	            cypSite = "CYP450 Omega-1 Aliphatic Hydroxylation";
         117	        }
         118
         119	        // Blood-Brain Barrier (BBB) permeability
         120	        string bbb = (tpsa < 90.0 && logP is >= 1.0 and <= 3.5 && mw < 400.0)
         121	            ? "High BBB Permeability (CNS Active)"
         122	            : "Low BBB Permeability (Peripherally Restricted)";
         123
         124	        return new AdmetProfile(
         125	            molecule.ChemicalFormula,
         126	            Math.Round(mw, 2),
         127	            Math.Round(logP, 2),
         128	            Math.Round(tpsa, 1),
         129	            hbd,
         130	            hba,
         131	            rotatableBonds,
         132	            aromaticRings,
         133	            violations,
         134	            passesLipinski,
         135	            passesVeber,
         136	            passesGhose,
         137	            Math.Round(qed, 3),
         138	            hergRisk,
         139	            cypSite,
         140	            bbb
         141	        );
         142	    }
         143
         144	    /// <summary>
         145	    /// Calculates Topological Polar Surface Area (TPSA) using standard Ertl atomic fragment contributions.
         146	    /// Reference: Ertl et al., J. Med. Chem. 2000, 43, 3714-3717.
         147	    /// </summary>
         148	    public static double CalculateErtlTpsa(Molecule molecule)
         149	    {
         150	        return ErtlTpsa.Calculate(molecule).TotalTpsa;
         151	    }
         152
         153	    /// <summary>
         154	    /// Computes Wildman-Crippen partition coefficient (LogP).
         155	    /// Reference: Wildman &amp; Crippen, J. Chem. Inf. Comput. Sci. 1999, 39, 868-873.
         156	    /// </summary>
         157	    public static double CalculateCrippenLogP(Molecule molecule)
         158	    {
         159	        return WildmanCrippenLogP.Calculate(molecule).CalculatedLogP;
         160	    }

         162	    private static List<int> GetNeighborIndices(Molecule molecule, int atomIndex) =>
         163	        molecule.Bonds
         164	            .Where(b => b.Connects(atomIndex))
         165	            .Select(b => b.Atom1Index == atomIndex ? b.Atom2Index : b.Atom1Index)
         166	            .ToList();
         167
         168	    private static int CountHydrogenBondDonors(Molecule molecule)
         169	    {
         170	        int count = 0;
         171	        for (int i = 0; i < molecule.Atoms.Count; i++)
         172	        {
         173	            var atom = molecule.Atoms[i];
         174	            if (atom.Element.Symbol is "O" or "N")
         175	            {
         176	                // Check if explicitly connected to Hydrogen
         177	                bool hasExplicitH = molecule.Bonds.Any(b =>
         178	                {
         179	                    if (!b.Connects(i)) return false;
         180	                    int other = b.Atom1Index == i ? b.Atom2Index : b.Atom1Index;
         181	                    return molecule.Atoms[other].Element.Symbol == "H";
         182	                });
         183
         184	                if (hasExplicitH)
         185	                {
         186	                    count++;
         187	                }
         188	                else
         189	                {
         190	                    bool isAromatic = molecule.Bonds.Any(b => b.Connects(i) && b.Type == BondType.Aromatic);
         191	                    if (!isAromatic)
         192	                    {
         193	                        // Check implicit hydrogens from standard aliphatic valence
         194	                        int bondValence = molecule.Bonds.Where(b => b.Connects(i)).Sum(b => b.Type switch
         195	                        {
         196	                            BondType.Double => 2,
         197	                            BondType.Triple => 3,
         198	                            _ => 1
         199	                        });
         200
         201	                        if (atom.Element.Symbol == "O" && bondValence < 2) count++;
         202	                        else if (atom.Element.Symbol == "N" && bondValence < 3) count++;
         203	                    }
         204	                }
         205	            }
         206	        }
         207	        return count;
         208	    }
         209
         210	    private static int CountHydrogenBondAcceptors(Molecule molecule)
         211	    {
         212	        int count = 0;
         213	        for (int i = 0; i < molecule.Atoms.Count; i++)
         214	        {
         215	            var sym = molecule.Atoms[i].Element.Symbol;
         216	            if (sym == "O")
         217	            {
         218	                count++;
         219	            }
         220	            else if (sym == "N")
         221	            {
         222	                bool isPyrrolic = molecule.Bonds.Any(b => b.Connects(i) && b.Type == BondType.Aromatic) &&
         223	                    molecule.Bonds.Any(b => b.Connects(i) && molecule.Atoms[b.Atom1Index == i ? b.Atom2Index : b.Atom1Index].Element.Symbol == "H");
         224	                if (!isPyrrolic) count++;
         225	            }
         226	        }
         227	        return count;
         228	    }
         229
         230	    private static int CountRotatableBonds(Molecule molecule)
         231	    {
         232	        int rotatable = 0;
         233	        foreach (var bond in molecule.Bonds)
         234	        {
         235	            if (bond.Type == BondType.Single)
         236	            {
         237	                var e1 = molecule.Atoms[bond.Atom1Index].Element.Symbol;
         238	                var e2 = molecule.Atoms[bond.Atom2Index].Element.Symbol;
         239
         240	                // Non-terminal bonds (neither atom is H or Halogen) and NOT in a cyclic ring
         241	                if (e1 != "H" && e2 != "H" && e1 != "F" && e2 != "F" && e1 != "Cl" && e2 != "Cl" && e1 != "Br" && e2 != "Br")
         242	                {
         243	                    if (!IsBondInRing(molecule, bond))
         244	                    {
         245	                        int heavyDeg1 = molecule.Bonds.Count(b => b.Connects(bond.Atom1Index) && molecule.Atoms[b.Atom1Index == bond.Atom1Index ? b.Atom2Index : b.Atom1Index].Element.Symbol != "H");
         246	                        int heavyDeg2 = molecule.Bonds.Count(b => b.Connects(bond.Atom2Index) && molecule.Atoms[b.Atom1Index == bond.Atom2Index ? b.Atom2Index : b.Atom1Index].Element.Symbol != "H");
         247	                        if (heavyDeg1 > 1 && heavyDeg2 > 1) rotatable++;
         248	                    }
         249	                }
         250	            }
         251	        }
         252	        return Math.Max(0, rotatable);
         253	    }
         254
         255	    private static bool IsBondInRing(Molecule molecule, Bond bond)
         256	    {
         257	        int start = bond.Atom1Index;
         258	        int target = bond.Atom2Index;
         259
         260	        var visited = new HashSet<int> { start };
         261	        var queue = new Queue<int>();
         262
         263	        foreach (var b in molecule.Bonds)
         264	        {
         265	            if (b == bond) continue;
         266	            if (b.Connects(start))
         267	            {
         268	                int neighbor = b.Atom1Index == start ? b.Atom2Index : b.Atom1Index;
         269	                if (neighbor == target) return true;
         270	                visited.Add(neighbor);
         271	                queue.Enqueue(neighbor);
         272	            }
         273	        }
         274
         275	        while (queue.Count > 0)
         276	        {
         277	            int current = queue.Dequeue();
         278	            if (current == target) return true;
         279
         280	            foreach (var b in molecule.Bonds)
         281	            {
         282	                if (b == bond) continue;
         283	                if (b.Connects(current))
         284	                {
         285	                    int neighbor = b.Atom1Index == current ? b.Atom2Index : b.Atom1Index;
         286	                    if (!visited.Contains(neighbor))
         287	                    {
         288	                        visited.Add(neighbor);
         289	                        queue.Enqueue(neighbor);
         290	                    }
         291	                }
         292	            }
         293	        }
         294
         295	        return false;
         296	    }
         297
         298	    private static int CountAromaticRings(Molecule molecule)
         299	    {
         300	        var graph = Graph.ChemicalGraph.FromMolecule(molecule);
         301	        var rings = graph.FindRings();
         302	        int count = 0;
         303	        foreach (var ring in rings)
         304	        {
         305	            bool hasAromatic = ring.Any(nodeId => graph.GetIncidentEdges(nodeId).Any(e => e.IsAromatic || e.BondType == BondType.Aromatic));
         306	            if (hasAromatic && ring.Count is 5 or 6)
         307	            {
         308	                count++;
         309	            }
         310	        }
         311	        return Math.Max(count, molecule.Bonds.Any(b => b.Type == BondType.Aromatic) ? 1 : 0);
         312	    }
         313
         314	    private static int CountStructuralAlerts(Molecule molecule)
         315	    {
         316	        // Counts reactive toxicophores (PAINS / Brenk filter alerts)
         317	        int alerts = 0;
         318	        var fgs = molecule.GetFunctionalGroups();
         319
         320	        // 1. Reactive Halides
         321	        bool hasAlkylHalide = molecule.Bonds.Any(b =>
         322	        {
         323	            string e1 = molecule.Atoms[b.Atom1Index].Element.Symbol;
         324	            string e2 = molecule.Atoms[b.Atom2Index].Element.Symbol;
         325	            return (e1 == "C" && e2 is "Cl" or "Br" or "I") || (e2 == "C" && e1 is "Cl" or "Br" or "I");
         326	        });
         327	        if (hasAlkylHalide && !fgs.Contains(FunctionalGroup.Aromatic)) alerts++;
         328
         329	        // 2. Nitro groups
         330	        if (fgs.Contains(FunctionalGroup.Nitro)) alerts++;
         331
         332	        // 3. Reactive aldehydes
         333	        if (fgs.Contains(FunctionalGroup.Aldehyde)) alerts++;
         334
         335	        return alerts;
         336	    }
         337
         338	    private static double CalculateQedScore(Molecule molecule) =>
         339	        BickertonQed.Calculate(molecule).QedScore;
         340	}

          46	{
          47	    public ScientificMethodInfo MethodInfo { get; init; } = new(
          48	        "Topological Symmetry & Empirical Curphey-Morrison NMR/IR Prediction", "2026.1", EvidenceLevel.EmpiricalModel,
          49	        "Organic small molecules with 1D Weisfeiler-Lehman topological graph equivalence and first-order 3J coupling.",
          50	        ["First-order coupling model (N+1 rule); does not simulate higher-order ABX spin systems, 2D NOESY/COSY, or solvent matrix shifts."]
          51	    );

          54	/// <summary>
          55	/// Computational Spectroscopy Prediction Engine.
          56	/// Implements 1D Weisfeiler-Lehman topological symmetry partitioning, Curphey-Morrison additive chemical shift increments,
          57	/// first-order vicinal (3J) spin-spin splitting, and characteristic IR vibrational modes.
          58	/// </summary>
          59	public static class SpectroscopyEngine
          60	{
          61	    /// <summary>
          62	    /// Predicts complete 1H-NMR, 13C-NMR, and IR vibrational spectra for any molecule.
          63	    /// </summary>
          64	    public static SpectroscopyPrediction Predict(Molecule molecule)
          65	    {
          66	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(molecule);
          67
          68	        var h1Peaks = PredictH1Nmr(molecule);
          69	        var c13Peaks = PredictC13Nmr(molecule);
          70	        var irBands = PredictIr(molecule);
          71
          72	        return new SpectroscopyPrediction(molecule.ChemicalFormula, h1Peaks, c13Peaks, irBands);
          73	    }
          74
          75	    /// <summary>
          76	    /// Predicts 1H-NMR chemical shifts and multiplicities using 1D Weisfeiler-Lehman equivalence classes and 3J coupling.
          77	    /// </summary>
          78	    private static List<NmrPeak> PredictH1Nmr(Molecule molecule)
          79	    {
          80	        var peaks = new List<NmrPeak>();
          81	        var hIndices = new List<int>();
          82
          83	        for (int i = 0; i < molecule.Atoms.Count; i++)
          84	        {
          85	            if (molecule.Atoms[i].Element.Symbol == "H")
          86	            {
          87	                hIndices.Add(i);
          88	            }
          89	        }
          90
          91	        if (hIndices.Count == 0) return peaks;
          92
          93	        // Inorganic molecules
          94	        if (molecule.ChemicalFormula == "H2O")
          95	        {
          96	            peaks.Add(new NmrPeak(4.79, "1H", "Singlet (Exchangeable)", 2, "H2O Water proton resonance"));
          97	            return peaks;
          98	        }
          99	        if (molecule.ChemicalFormula == "NH3")
         100	        {
         101	            peaks.Add(new NmrPeak(0.65, "1H", "Broad Singlet", 3, "NH3 Ammonia proton resonance"));
         102	            return peaks;
         103	        }
         104
         105	        // Partition molecule into topological symmetry classes
         106	        var wl = WeisfeilerLehman.Partition(molecule);
         107
         108	        // Group hydrogens by their symmetry equivalence class
         109	        var hGroups = hIndices.GroupBy(h => wl.SymmetryClasses[h]).ToList();
         110
         111	        foreach (var group in hGroups)
         112	        {
         113	            int hCount = group.Count();
         114	            int sampleH = group.First();
         115
         116	            // Find parent heavy atom attached to this Hydrogen
         117	            int parentIndex = molecule.Bonds
         118	                .Where(b => b.Connects(sampleH))
         119	                .Select(b => b.Atom1Index == sampleH ? b.Atom2Index : b.Atom1Index)
         120	                .FirstOrDefault(-1);
         121
         122	            if (parentIndex < 0) continue;
         123
         124	            var parentAtom = molecule.Atoms[parentIndex];
         125	            string pSym = parentAtom.Element.Symbol;
         126
         127	            double shift;
         128	            string multiplicity;
         129	            string description;
         130
         131	            if (pSym == "O")
         132	            {
         133	                // Check if in carboxylic acid
         134	                bool isCarboxyl = molecule.Bonds.Any(b => b.Connects(parentIndex) &&
         135	                    molecule.Atoms[b.Atom1Index == parentIndex ? b.Atom2Index : b.Atom1Index].Element.Symbol == "C" &&
         136	                    molecule.Bonds.Any(b2 => b2.Connects(b.Atom1Index == parentIndex ? b.Atom2Index : b.Atom1Index) && b2.Type == BondType.Double));
         137
         138	                if (isCarboxyl)
         139	                {
         140	                    shift = 11.50;
         141	                    multiplicity = "Singlet (Exchangeable)";
         142	                    description = "-COOH Carboxylic acid proton";
         143	                }
         144	                else
         145	                {
         146	                    shift = 3.50;
         147	                    multiplicity = "Singlet (Exchangeable)";
         148	                    description = "-OH Alcohol hydroxyl proton";
         149	                }
         150	            }
         151	            else if (pSym == "N")
         152	            {
         153	                shift = 2.00;
         154	                multiplicity = "Broad Singlet";
         155	                description = "-NH- / -NH2 Amine/Amide proton";
         156	            }
         157	            else if (pSym == "C")
         158	            {
         159	                // Determine carbon environment
         160	                bool isAromatic = molecule.Bonds.Any(b => b.Connects(parentIndex) && b.Type == BondType.Aromatic);
         161	                bool hasDouble = molecule.Bonds.Any(b => b.Connects(parentIndex) && b.Type == BondType.Double);
         162	                bool hasTriple = molecule.Bonds.Any(b => b.Connects(parentIndex) && b.Type == BondType.Triple);
         163
         164	                // Check neighbors of the parent carbon
         165	                var cNeighbors = molecule.Bonds
         166	                    .Where(b => b.Connects(parentIndex))
         167	                    .Select(b => b.Atom1Index == parentIndex ? b.Atom2Index : b.Atom1Index)
         168	                    .Where(n => n != sampleH)
         169	                    .ToList();
         170
         171	                bool adjToCarbonyl = cNeighbors.Any(n => molecule.Atoms[n].Element.Symbol == "C" &&
         172	                    molecule.Bonds.Any(b => b.Connects(n) && b.Type == BondType.Double &&
         173	                        molecule.Atoms[b.Atom1Index == n ? b.Atom2Index : b.Atom1Index].Element.Symbol == "O"));
         174
         175	                bool adjToOxygen = cNeighbors.Any(n => molecule.Atoms[n].Element.Symbol == "O");
         176	                bool adjToNitrogen = cNeighbors.Any(n => molecule.Atoms[n].Element.Symbol == "N");
         177	                bool adjToAromatic = cNeighbors.Any(n => molecule.Bonds.Any(b => b.Connects(n) && b.Type == BondType.Aromatic));
         178
         179	                if (isAromatic)
         180	                {
         181	                    shift = 7.25;
         182	                    description = "Ar-H Aromatic proton";
         183	                }
         184	                else if (hasTriple)
         185	                {
         186	                    shift = 2.40;
         187	                    description = "≡C-H Alkyne proton";
         188	                }
         189	                else if (hasDouble)
         190	                {
         191	                    bool isAldehyde = molecule.Bonds.Any(b => b.Connects(parentIndex) && b.Type == BondType.Double &&
         192	                        molecule.Atoms[b.Atom1Index == parentIndex ? b.Atom2Index : b.Atom1Index].Element.Symbol == "O");
         193	                    if (isAldehyde)
         194	                    {
         195	                        shift = 9.70;
         196	                        description = "-CHO Aldehyde formyl proton";
         197	                    }
         198	                    else
         199	                    {
         200	                        shift = 5.30;
         201	                        description = "=C-H Vinylic alkene proton";
         202	                    }
         203	                }
         204	                else if (adjToCarbonyl)
         205	                {
         206	                    shift = 2.17;
         207	                    description = "-C(=O)CH- Carbonyl alpha-proton";
         208	                }
         209	                else if (adjToOxygen)
         210	                {
         211	                    shift = 3.65;
         212	                    description = "-O-CH- Oxygen alpha-proton";
         213	                }
         214	                else if (adjToNitrogen)
         215	                {
         216	                    shift = 2.70;
         217	                    description = "-N-CH- Nitrogen alpha-proton";
